| `PayBlockCostsEffect` | `(PendingInteraction.BlockerDeclaration declaration, List<Integer> blockerIndices, List<Integer> attackerIndices, String declaringPlayerName)` | Internal optional-payment continuation when another player proposes blocks: the defender accepts to pay and complete the declaration, or declines to return the proposal to its chooser without spending resources. | Berserker's Frenzy (AFC 29) |

> `SPELL` in this file means the card's spell ability (CR 113.3a), written `addSpellEffect(e)`,
> `addSimultaneousSpellEffects(a, b)` or `target(f).addSpellEffect(e)`. A `…Cost` listed under `SPELL`
> is a casting cost (CR 601.2b, 601.2f), written `addCastingCost(c)`; it is not part of the spell ability.

> `STATIC` in this file means a static ability (CR 113.3d), written `addStaticEffect(e)`, or
> `target(f).addStaticEffect(e)` for an Aura's enchant ability. It functions from the zones its effect's
> rule names (`CardEffect.staticAbilityZones()`): the battlefield, the stack for kicker, buyback, gift,
> "can't be countered" and "costs less to cast", the hand for splice, mulligan-time actions and opening-hand
> actions (`MayEffect(PregameChoiceEffect)`), and the graveyard for dredge. "Enters with" and "as this enters"
> abilities (CR 614.1c) are static abilities too, never `Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)`. An ability that states its
> zones, such as Eminence, is written `addStaticEffect(AbilityZones.of(...), e)`. In a token's or a
> copy's ability list it is `StaticAbility.of(e)`, next to `new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.x(), e)` for
> a trigger. Readers use `getStaticEffects()`.

> Who an effect acts on is a `PermanentSubject` or `PlayerSubject` built with `Subjects` (`source()`,
> `attached()`, `controllerOf(triggering())`, ...) and resolved only by `SubjectResolutionService`: see
> [SUBJECTS_REFERENCE.md](SUBJECTS_REFERENCE.md).

# EFFECTS_INDEX

## Verbs and their subjects

An effect is a **verb** (what happens) with a **subject** (who or what it happens to). Pick the verb from the
table, then the subject from [SUBJECTS_REFERENCE.md](SUBJECTS_REFERENCE.md); never add a record for a new
combination of the two. Only a subject's target variant (`target()`, `targetPlayer()`, `targetCard(...)`)
declares a target. Text that fuses two instructions ("destroy it. Its controller draws a card", "sacrifice
… If you do, …") is several steps that talk through the resolution's step results (`HappenedThisWay`,
`AmountThisWay`, `thisWay(kind)`, `playersThisWay(kind)`, `cardsThisWay(kind)`): see "Composing fused
text from steps" in [CARD_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAYBOOK.md](CARD_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAYBOOK.md).

| Verb | Record (factories) | Subject |
|---|---|---|
| put counters | `PutCountersEffect` (`onSelf`, `onEachYouControl`, `onEach`, `onEachTargetPlayerControls`, `placedByEachController()`, `.evaluatedForEach()`) | `PermanentSubject` (one permanent, a set, `createdThisResolution()`, `returnedThisResolution()`, `thisWay(kind)`) |
| remove counters | `RemoveCountersEffect` (`fromSelf`, `fromTarget`, `allFromSelf`, `allFrom`, `allFromTarget`) | `PermanentSubject` |
| damage | `DealDamageEffect` (`toAnyTarget`, `toTargetCreature`, `to(subject, n)`, `toEach`, `toEachTarget`, `toEachCreature`, `eachEvaluatedFor`, riders `dealtBy`, `andTo`, `excessToControllerInstead()`) | a `Recipient` kind over a `PermanentSubject` or `PlayerSubject`; the dealer `dealtBy(PermanentSubject)` |
| boost | `BoostEffect` (`self`, `of`, `target`, `each`, `creaturesYouControl`, `allCreatures`, `creaturesTargetPlayerControls`) | `PermanentSubject` |
| keywords | `GrantKeywordEffect(keywords, subject, …, duration)` | `PermanentSubject` |
| can't be blocked | `MakeCreatureUnblockableEffect` (`self`, `of`, `targetPermanent`, `.byCreaturesYourOpponentsControl()`) | one `PermanentSubject` |
| goad | `GoadTargetCreatureUntilNextTurnEffect` (`eachCreature`, `creaturesControlledBy`, `creaturesTargetPlayerControls`) | `PermanentSubject` |
| destroy | `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect` (`all`, `allTargetPlayerControls`, `sparing`, `readingTarget`, `eachTarget`, `eachTargetMatching`) | `PermanentSubject` |
| exile a permanent | `ExileTargetPermanentEffect` (`all`) | `PermanentSubject` |
| return to hand | `ReturnToHandEffect` (`target`, `self`, `enchanted`, `allPermanentsMatching`, …) | `PermanentSubject` |
| tap / untap | `TapPermanentsEffect`, `UntapPermanentsEffect` | `PermanentSubject` |
| sacrifice | `SacrificePermanentsEffect(count, filter, player)` (a player chooses), `SacrificeSelfEffect(subject, sacrificer)` (that permanent) | `PlayerSubject` / `PermanentSubject` |
| phase out | `PhaseOutEffect(subject)` | `PermanentSubject` |
| draw | `DrawCardEffect(n[, player])`, `eachEvaluatedFor(amount, players)` | `PlayerSubject` |
| discard | `DiscardEffect(amount, player, random)` | `PlayerSubject` |
| mill | `MillEffect(amount, player)` | `PlayerSubject` |
| gain / lose life | `GainLifeEffect(amount, player)`, `LoseLifeEffect(amount, player, controllerGainsLifeLost)` | `PlayerSubject` |
| poison | `GivePoisonCountersEffect(amount, player)` | `PlayerSubject` |
| a rule on a player | `GrantStaticEffectToPlayerEffect` (`untilEndOfTurn`, `untilYourNextTurn`), `PlayerRestrictionEffect(players, restriction, duration)` | `PlayerSubject` |
| put onto the battlefield | `PutCardsOntoBattlefieldEffect` (`underControlOf`, `withCounters`, `attachedTo`, `manifested()`) | `CardSubject` (`sourceObjectCard()`, `triggeringCards()`, `cardsThisWay(kind)`, ...) |
| put into a hand | `PutCardsIntoHandEffect(cards)` | `CardSubject` |
| put into a library | `PutCardsIntoLibraryEffect` (`shuffledIn`, `onBottomInRandomOrder`) | `CardSubject` |
| exile graveyard cards | `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect.cards(cards)` | `CardSubject` |
| perpetual changes | `PerpetuallyBoostCardEffect.toCards`, `PerpetuallyGrantAbilitiesEffect`, `PerpetuallyChangeCastCostEffect`, `PerpetuallyGrantCardCharacteristicsEffect` | `CardSubject` (`cardsOf(...)`, `sourceObjectCard()`: the same object only, CR 400.7) |
| conjure | `ConjureCardsEffect` + `ConjureDestination` (`intoHand()`, `intoLibrary()`, `ontoBattlefield()`); `.into(players)`, `.conjuredBy(players)` | `PlayerSubject` (whose zone, who conjures) |
| token copy | `CreateTokenCopyOfTargetPermanentEffect` (`forController(PlayerSubject)`, `withSubject(...)`) | `PermanentSubject` |
| "[do X] unless [P] pays" | `UnlessPaysEffect(payer, ransom, ifNotPaid, ifPaid)` (`counterUnlessPays`, `youMayPay`, `unlessPays`, `forEach`, `forEachCard`, `eachUnless`, `.payingTogether()`) | the payer is a `PlayerSubject`; the ransom a `CostEffect` |
| choose | `ChoosePermanentsEffect`, `ChooseCardEffect`, `ChoosePlayerEffect` (record CHOOSE, read by `thisWay(CHOOSE)` / `cardsThisWay(CHOOSE)` / `playersThisWay(CHOOSE)`) | the candidates are a subject |

`DraftCardFromSpellbookEffect` supports exiling the selected card with an end-of-turn play permission, or putting it directly onto the battlefield (Garruk, Wrath of the Wilds, YMID 47).
`DraftCardFromSpellbookToExileEffect` offers three spellbook cards and exiles the selected card with the source permanent; its default is face down, with the boolean overload supporting face-up source-linked cards (The Mystical Archive, YSOS 30; Loose in the Park, YSNC 14). As a static effect it is an "as this enters, draft a card from its spellbook and exile it" (CR 614.12): the draft is asked as the permanent enters, before its other entry abilities, land or not (The Mystical Archive, Protean War Engine).
`PerpetuallyGrantCardCharacteristicsEffect` records card types, subtypes, and activated abilities on the source's own card identity and reapplies them when that card returns to the battlefield; for a drafted or chosen card, `.to(Subjects.cardsThisWay(StepKind.CONJURE | CHOOSE))`.
`PerpetuallyGrantCardCharacteristicsEffect.becomingCreatureTypes(...)` replaces the card's creature types instead of adding to them.
A granted damage-to-player ability that triggers only for one player is the event condition `TargetPlayerIs(playerId)`, judged against the player dealt damage (Hellish Rebuke).

records `StepKind.SEEK` (the cards in the zone each went to, the permanents they became): "it perpetually gets" / "manifest it" / "choose one of them" read `cardsThisWay(SEEK)`; a `CardSharesCardTypeWithCardsPredicate` or `CardManaValueAtMostAmountPredicate` in the filter is bound as the seek applies ("a card with greater / lesser mana value than the discarded card"); `triggersSeekAbilities = false` (set by `randomExileWithSource`) takes the cards at random without seeking them, so "whenever you seek" abilities do not trigger (Tezzeret's Reckoning); an optional dynamic mana-value bound filters the sought cards, `faceDown` applies to source-tracked exile, `grantPlayUntilNextTurn` permits play of sought exiled cards through the next turn, `grantSubtype` adds a subtype to each sought permanent entering the battlefield, and `battlefieldCloaked` makes sought battlefield cards enter cloaked | Pool Resources (YBLB 6); - `LoseLifeEqualToLifeTotalAsEntersEffect()` implements `ReplacementEffect`; `LoseLifeEqualToLifeTotalAsEntersEffectHandler` registers with `EntryReplacementHandlerRegistry` and applies the positive current life total as life loss through `LifeSupport` before battlefield entry. It respects life-change restrictions and life-loss replacements and never queues an ETB trigger. Used by Lich (2ED 114).
- `SacrificePermanentsOrLoseGameEffect(DynamicAmount count, PermanentPredicate filter)` is a non-targeting controller effect. Its handler evaluates the required count, checks whether the full sacrifice is possible, and delegates to `SacrificePermanentsEffectHandler`. An insufficient sacrifice performs as much as possible before resolving `ControllerLosesGameEffect`, respecting loss prevention/replacement. Sufficient choices reuse the existing multi-permanent interaction. The delegate's `withSimultaneousChoices()` also makes automatic single-player sacrifices simultaneous. Used by Lich with `EventValue` on `Triggers.youAreDealtDamage()` and a nontoken filter; the damage amount is recorded on the stack entry as the ability triggers.

Purpose: cut token usage when implementing cards by quickly mapping "card text intent" to existing reusable effects and their constructor signatures.

`BoostEffect.creaturesYouControl` accepts an optional `Duration`; the default is end of turn, while `Duration.UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN` is represented by floating layer effects on the creatures present when the effect resolves.

`MoveCountersFromAllCreaturesToSourceEffect(CounterType)` is an untargeted effect that moves all counters of the given kind from every creature on every battlefield onto the source permanent, including the source when it is a creature. The source must still be on the battlefield; the handler uses shared counter placement for counter locks, replacement effects, and counter triggers. Spike Cannibal uses `PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE`.
`CantAttackUnlessReturnToHandEffect` is a STATIC additional attack cost read directly by `AttackReturnToHandCostService`; pair it with a `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessEffect.attack(ControlsPermanentCount(count, filter), …)` legality gate.
Thought Prison combines the hand-reveal imprint overload of `ChooseCardsFromTargetHandEffect` with `StackEntrySharesColorOrManaValueWithImprintedCardPredicate` in an `Triggers.playerCastsSpell()` trigger.

| `KrarksThumbEffect` | `()` | Static replacement effect for Krark's Thumb: each logical coin flip made by its controller flips two coins and ignores one result. Multiple copies apply once each to the same logical flip. |
| `EdgarKingOfFigaroEffect` | `()` | Static replacement effect for Edgar, King of Figaro: the controller's first coin-flip event each turn makes every coin come up heads and counts those flips as wins. The shared coin-flip service tracks the turn-scoped event, including effects that flip multiple coins at once. |
| `PokeyTheScallywaggEffect` | `()` | Static replacement effect for Pokey, the Scallywagg: the controller's coin flips use d20 results and the controller's d20 rolls use coin results, with the shared services preserving the replacement's event type for triggers. |

`DistributeCountersAmongTargetsEffect.chosenAmongTargetCreaturesEtb(CounterType, int)` is the fixed chosen counter-distribution form for ETB abilities; it reads target-to-counter assignments from the shared ETB assignment buffer and skips targets that are gone or no longer creatures (Wurmskin Forger).

`DistributeCountersAmongTargetsEffect.chosenUpToAmongAnyNumberOfTargetCreatures(CounterType, DynamicAmount, PermanentPredicate)` is the partial chosen-distribution form for abilities such as Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn: each selected target receives at least one counter, but the controller may assign fewer than the evaluated total, including choosing no targets.

| `EachOpponentChoosesCreatureToTapAndGoadEffect` | `()` | Non-targeting: each opponent chooses one creature they control in APNAP order; after all choices, the selected creatures are tapped and goaded until the spell controller's next turn. Resolution is handled by `EachOpponentChoosesCreatureToTapAndGoadEffectHandler`. Used by Fell Beast's Shriek (`LTC` 508) |
| `RaidingPartyEffect` | `()` | Each player chooses any number of untapped white creatures they control to tap, then chooses up to two Plains per creature tapped; every unchosen Plains is destroyed after all choices. Resolution is handled by `RaidingPartyEffectHandler`. Used by Raiding Party |
| `CopyTriggeringSpellOrAbilityEffect` | `()`, `.withCopies(n)` ("copy that spell or ability twice"), `.permanentSpellCopiesAreTokens()` | "copy that spell or ability. You may choose new targets for the copy" (Bill Potts, one ability of a cast and an activation condition with `TriggerLimit.ONCE_EACH_TURN`) and "copy that ability" of the activation triggers (Rings of Brighthearth, Kurkesh, Illusionist's and Battlemage's Bracers, Chandra's Regulator, Rowan's Talent, Sala, Ertha Jo, Leori, Unbound Flourishing, Locus of Enlightenment, Verrak, Ashnod): copies the stack entry's triggering spell, or the activated ability an activation trigger was about (`StackEntry.getTriggeringActivatedAbility()`, through `CopyControllerActivatedAbilityEffectHandler`) for this ability's controller, or the triggered ability of an attacking creature that triggered Firebender Ascension (`Triggers.attackingCreatureYouControlAbilityTriggers()`, the entry's triggering spell snapshot a `TRIGGERED_ABILITY` entry). Written alone or behind a `MayEffect`, `UnlessPaysEffect` (Verrak's `youMayPayLife(new EventValue(), …)`: the life paid to activate it is the entry's event value) or `ConditionalEffect`; `SpellTriggers` judges the trigger's `withStackEntryFilter` and `withPayment` once the activated ability is on the stack and records the activation the same way for an ability with any other effect |
| `TriggeringCardInExile` (condition) | `()` | the triggering card (for a delayed step ability, its lone referent card) is a card in exile: "if you haven't played it". Used as the event condition of Grinning Totem's delayed ability, which is judged as the ability triggers; the card is read from the ability's context ( `RulesEventPipeline.putStepAbility` ) |
| `CardsStillInZone` (condition) | `(Zone zone, Map<UUID, Long> entryVersions)` | at least one of the cards is still in the zone (`HAND`: the controller's hand; `EXILE`: any exile) in the same stay, judged by the hand or exile entry version recorded when the condition was made (CR 400.7): "if that card is in your hand" (Thoughtweft's Call), "if any of those cards remain exiled" (Glimpse the Impossible, Bank Job, Mnemonic Betrayal, Elkin Lair). Used as the intervening-if of delayed step abilities, checked as they trigger and resolve (CR 603.4) |
| `TriggeringCardMatches` (condition) | `(CardPredicate predicate)` | `ConditionalEffect(new TriggeringCardMatches(p), effect)`: an "if" of an effect on the card that triggered the ability, checked as it resolves against the stack entry's triggering card ("if that creature was a Villain", Venom, Eddie Brock; "if that spell was all colors", Jenson Carthalion; "if it's a Samurai card", Oathkeeper). A filter on what triggers the ability is the trigger's (`.withFilter(...)`, `Triggers.creatureDies(filter, relation)`, `Triggers.exiledFrom(Set.of(Zone.BATTLEFIELD), null, THIS)`, `Triggers.diesWithoutBeingSacrificed(...)`, `TargetTrigger.withSource(...)`) |
| `TriggeringCardManaValueIsUncrossedChosenDigit` (condition) | `()` | Duelists' Convocation International's intervening "if" (`TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(...)`): the mana value of the triggering spell as it is on the stack (X the number chosen, 0 cast face down), else of the triggering card (the land played), is one of the source's chosen digits not crossed out. It is judged as the spell is cast or the land played, and again as the ability resolves |
| `SourceLibraryPlayPermissionUsedThisTurn` (condition) | `()` | the source's `PlayLandOrCastSpellFromTopOfLibraryOncePerTurnEffect` permission was used this turn: The Fourth Doctor's "when you do" as the event condition (`withEventCondition`) of its cast and land-play triggers, with `TriggerLimit.ONCE_EACH_TURN` |
| `TriggeringSpellMatches` (condition) | `(StackEntryPredicate filter)` | `ConditionalEffect(new TriggeringSpellMatches(p), effect)`: an "if" of a cast trigger's effect on the triggering spell, judged as it resolves (the live spell, else as it last existed on the stack) from the ability's controller and source ("copy that spell if it targets a permanent or player", Shiko and Narset, Unified). Top-level effects only; a condition of the cast is the trigger's `withStackEntryFilter(...)`. As a cast trigger's intervening "if" (`TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(...)`) it is judged on the spell as it is cast and again as it resolves (Spellweaver Helix) |
| `TriggeringPermanentMatches` (condition) | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | `ConditionalEffect(new TriggeringPermanentMatches(p), effect)`: an "if" of an effect on the stack entry's triggering permanent, checked as the effect resolves (as it last existed once it left the battlefield): "draw a card if that creature has a +1/+1 counter on it" (Marcus, Mutant Mayor). A filter on what triggers the ability is the trigger's own |
| `BendOrBreakEffect` | `()` | Each player separates their nontoken lands into two piles in active-player order, chooses an opponent, and that opponent chooses one pile. All lands in chosen piles are destroyed, then all lands in the other piles are tapped. The queued `PendingBendOrBreak` flow carries each player's piles and choices through multi-permanent, player, and may prompts. After the last choice the destruction is the step the parked resolution resumes with (`StepDepartureSupport.departAfterChoice`), so every CR 616.1 question is asked before any land leaves; the lands to tap are recorded as the scratchpad's picks (`StackEntry.recordPicks`) and tapped by the `ContinueAfterDepartureEffect` step after it. Resolved by `BendOrBreakEffectHandler`. Used by Bend or Break |

`ProtectionFromMulticoloredEffect(PermanentSubject subject[, ColorCount colors])` grants protection from sources with
a number of colors: `MULTICOLORED` two or more (the default; use `Subjects.attachedCreature()` for an Aura that
protects its host), `.enemyColoredMulticolored()` exactly two enemy colors (sources with more than two colors do not
qualify; Frenemy of the Guildpact), `.monocolored()` exactly one color (Guardian of the Guildpact),
`.colorless()` no color (the payload of a resolved "gains protection from colorless" protection choice, a floating
`GrantEffectEffect(…, Subjects.target())` on the permanent).
`ProtectionFromColoredSpellsEffect()` grants protection specifically from colored spells, not from
colored permanents or abilities of colored permanents.

`DamageDealtByTargetPlayerSorceryThisTurn()` — total actual damage dealt by the chosen sorcery
spell cast by the targeted player this turn, summed across all recipients. Prevented damage and
copies are excluded; pair with `Divided(..., 2)` for Backdraft's rounded-down half.

For `LookAtTopCardsOfTargetLibraryEffect`, the optional third `graveyardCount` argument generalizes
the graveyard actions to choose that many cards from the same revealed group before moving them
as one event. Bamboozle uses count four and graveyardCount two, then reorders the remaining cards.

## How to use this index
- `GainActivatedAbilitiesOfTargetCreatureUntilEndOfTurnEffect()` — on resolution, the source gains the target creature's currently effective activated abilities until end of turn; benign CREATURE target, granted as `Duration.UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` floating ability grants (`GameData.grantAbilityToPermanent`) (Quicksilver Elemental)

| `ChooseOpponentGainsControlOfSourceEffect` | `()` | non-targeting (`ControlStealingEffect`): the ability controller chooses one opponent; that player gains permanent control of the source permanent. One opponent is automatic; multiple opponents use a player choice. Handler `ChooseOpponentGainsControlOfSourceEffectHandler`. Used by Goblin Festival |
| `GoadSourceCreatureWhileControllerControlsItEffect` | `()` | source-bound `CombatAttackRequirementEffect`: goads the source creature while the controller who created the floating effect controls it; ends when that source changes controllers. Handler `GoadSourceCreatureWhileControllerControlsItEffectHandler`. Used by Vislor Turlough |
| `TapAndChooseOpponentGainsControlOfSourceAndMatchingPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | non-targeting (`ControlStealingEffect`): taps the source and all permanents matching the filter, then has the ability controller choose an opponent to gain permanent control of all affected permanents. Handler `TapAndChooseOpponentGainsControlOfSourceAndMatchingPermanentsEffectHandler`. Used by Rohgahh of Kher Keep |

`PutAttackingCreaturesOnTopOrBottomOfLibraryEffect()` puts each attacking creature on the top or bottom of its owner's library after a resolution-time choice by that creature's owner. It is non-targeting and is used by Aetherspouts.

1. Parse card text into primitive actions (damage, draw, bounce, etc.): one verb per instruction.
2. Pick each verb (the table "Verbs and their subjects" at the top, then its section below), then its subject (`SUBJECTS_REFERENCE.md`); compose fused text from steps over the step results.
3. Only add new effect records when no existing effect can express the behavior.
4. If you add a new effect record, create a `<EffectName>EffectHandler` `@Component` implementing `NormalEffectHandlerBean` in `service/effect/normalfx/`. `GameEngineConfig` auto-registers `@Component` handlers for production, card tests (`GameTestEngineContext`), and headless simulation (`HeadlessSimulationContext`). See provider map at bottom.
5. If your new effect targets something, override `targetSpec()` on the effect record to return a non-NONE `TargetSpec` (category + harmful flag + optional predicate � see targeting section below). The engine's declarative interpreter offers and type-checks the target from the spec; you do NOT add a validator for ordinary structural targeting.
6. If the new effect's `targetSpec()` includes permanents and it is a spell effect (`addSpellEffect`) or an effect of `addTrigger(Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS), …)`, the AI must know which board to aim it at: add a rule or map entry to `TargetPolarityClassifier` (`magical-vibes-ai`). `TargetPolarityGuardTest` scans the whole card pool and fails the build if the shape is unclassified � its failure message explains the polarity choices.
7. Only if legal targeting depends on a NON-structural rule the spec cannot express (opponent-relation, controller/owner compare, chosen-source, null-target tolerance) add a `@ValidatesTarget`-annotated method in the appropriate validator class under `service/validate/` � AND still declare the structural `targetSpec()` (see target validator map at bottom).

Implementation note: `ExileTargetPermanentUntilSourceLeavesEffect` accepts an optional `PermanentPredicate` for a narrowed harmful permanent target and an `exileIfSourceAlreadyLeft` mode for separate enter/leave triggers whose enter trigger can resolve after the source left. `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect` grants `Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)` abilities to an entering permanent through the normal ETB collection path, alongside native ETB effects.

### Permanent type changes

- `AnimatePermanentsEffect.sourceBecomesCreature(int power, int toughness, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords)` — "this permanent becomes a 2/4 Soldier creature [with flying]" with no duration: floating layer-4 effects from its own timestamp make the source only a creature (CR 205.1a; the first creature type replaces its creature types), layer-6 keywords and a 7b base P/T. Not copiable values, so a copy of it or a later copy effect on it keeps or ignores them as CR 707.2 says (Opal Acrolith, Hidden Stag, Lurking Evil). `sourceBecomesCreature(DynamicAmount, DynamicAmount, subtypes, keywords)` evaluates the base P/T once as it resolves (Veiled Sentry: `new TargetSpellManaValue()` for both). Add protection with `GrantEffectToTargetEffect.toSourcePermanent(StaticAbility.of(new ProtectionFromColorsEffect(...)))` (Opal Guardian); "becomes a [type] artifact creature ... it isn't an Equipment" is the 9-argument non-overriding form with `{ARTIFACT}` plus `LoseAllLandTypesEffect.subtypes({EQUIPMENT}, Subjects.source(), PERMANENT)` (Dancing Sword).

"This permanent becomes an enchantment" (Opal Acrolith, Hidden Stag) is `SetCardTypesEffect(Set.of(ENCHANTMENT), Subjects.source())`: a newer layer-4 type-setting effect over the animation.

`GrantProtectionFromTriggeringSpellColorsEffect()` is a non-targeting source effect for spell-cast triggers. Once the triggering spell has left the stack it reads that spell's last-known colors, falling back to the stack entry's triggering spell (the spell as the ability triggered), so it still grants a permanent floating `ProtectionFromColorsEffect`. While the spell remains on the stack, resolution uses its current effective colors.

## Marker interfaces

| Interface | Extends | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|---------|
| `AggregateManaValueTargetEffect` | `CardEffect` | Capability for targeted effects whose selected targets share one total mana-value limit. Target-selection services enforce the cap while choices are made, and the concrete handler rechecks it on resolution. Supports either a fixed `maxTotalManaValue()` or a dynamic `dynamicMaxTotalManaValue()` cap. |
| `CostEffect` | `CardEffect` | Marks effects that represent additional costs (sacrifice, discard, exile, counter removal, tap creature). Cost effects are filtered out during effect snapshotting and excluded from mana ability detection. Implement this instead of `CardEffect` for new cost effects. Also carries DESCRIPTIVE AI cost-valuation facets (all default to neutral): `consumedPermanentFilter()` (`PermanentPredicate` for a payer-chosen sacrifice/return/counter-placement target; mandatory for any spell cost paid via `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId`), `consumesSourcePermanent()`, `sacrificesChosenCreature()`, `lifePaid(int)`, `sourceCountersRemoved()`, `consumedGraveyardCardCount()`, `consumedGraveyardCardType()`, and `tracksSacrificedCard()` for effects that need the sacrificed card on the activated ability's stack entry. Let `GameSimulator` (payment-planning) and `HardAiDecisionEngine` (cost scoring) read what a cost consumes without `instanceof`-ing each concrete record. Overridden by `SacrificeCreatureCost`, `SacrificePermanentCost`, `ReturnCreatureToHandCost`, `PutCounterOnControlledCreatureCost`, `SacrificeSelfCost`, `PayLifeCost`, `RemoveCounterFromSourceCost`, `ExileNCardsFromGraveyardCost`, `ExileNCardsFromSingleGraveyardCost`; other cost records inherit defaults. Payment execution stays concrete in `AbilityActivationService`. |
| `ManaProducingEffect` | `CardEffect` | Marks effects that produce mana. Used to identify mana abilities (CR 605.1a) without listing individual effect types. Implement this instead of `CardEffect` for new mana-producing effects. |
| `TriggeredManaAbilityEffect` | `CardEffect` | Marks an effect that adds mana as a "whenever a player taps a land for mana" ability resolves; with no target the ability is a triggered mana ability (CR 605.1b) that resolves at once (CR 605.4a), so `TapTriggers` takes a judged intervening "if" off it (Barbflare Gremlin). Implemented by the land-tap mana effects. |
| `TriggeredManaAbilityEffect` | `CardEffect` | Marks an effect that adds mana as a "whenever a player taps a land for mana" ability resolves; with no target the ability is a triggered mana ability (CR 605.1b) that resolves at once (CR 605.4a), so `TapTriggers` takes a judged intervening "if" off it (Barbflare Gremlin). Implemented by the land-tap mana effects. |
| `ConditionalManaEffect` | `(Condition condition, ManaColor ifMetColor, ManaColor ifNotMetColor[, DynamicAmount amount])` | Adds one of two colors based on the condition at resolution as a single mana-producing effect; use for replacement-style mana abilities such as River of Tears. |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` (amount forms) | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | "Add one mana of any color. If [condition], add N mana of any one color instead" is `new FixedIfCondition(condition, N, 1)` (Brood Astronomer, Ilysian Caryatid; the estimator models the smaller number); "choose a color, add one mana of that color for each different power among creatures you control" is `new DistinctPowersAmongControlledCreatures()` (Selvala, Eager Trailblazer); "equal to the number of creatures you control of the chosen type" is `PermanentCount(creature + PermanentHasSourceChosenSubtypePredicate, CONTROLLER)` (Three Tree City). One colour for the batch; no prompt for 0 |
| `DamageDealingEffect` | `CardEffect` | Descriptive capability for effects that deal a single evaluated `DynamicAmount` to one target category: `damageAmount()`, `canDamageCreatures()`, `canDamagePlayers()`, plus optional `triggeredTargetFilter()`, which the stack door doesn't read: a triggered ability's "target opponent" is the card's `target(...)` (Brash Taunter, Donna Noble). Lets AI evaluators score burn without `instanceof`-ing each concrete type. Implemented by `DealDamageEffect`, `DealDamageToAnyTargetThenPerpetuallyGrantStaticEffectIfCreatureEffect`, `DealDamageToAnyTargetThenPerpetuallyGrantStaticEffectsIfCreatureDamagedEffect`, `DealDamageToOneOfTwoTargetCreaturesThenOtherCantBlockEffect`, `DealDamageToAnyOtherTargetThenLockPlayerLifeGainEffect`. Not for split damage (`DealDividedDamageEffect`) or amount-less X burn; `DealDamageEffect`'s set and each-target kinds answer no to both `canDamage…` methods. |
| `GlobalDamageMultiplyingEffect` | `CardEffect` | Descriptive capability for a static permanent that multiplies ALL damage dealt in the game, regardless of source/target/controller (Furnace of Rath): `damageMultiplierFactor()` (2 for a plain doubler; multiple stack multiplicatively). Read by `GameQueryService.getDamageMultiplier` and the `GlobalDamageMultiplier` replacement options of the damage pool. Implemented by `DoubleDamageEffect`. Deliberately narrow � the selective doublers (`DoubleControllerDamageEffect`, `DoubleDamageToOpponentsAndTheirPermanentsEffect` (enchanted player), Goldnight Castigator, `DoubleEquippedCreatureCombatDamageEffect`) each pick out a different permanent subset in their own dedicated query methods and remain concrete. |
| `ControllerRecipientDamageMultiplyingEffect` | `CardEffect` | Descriptive capability for a static permanent that multiplies damage only when a source controlled by the effect controller would damage an opponent or an opponent's permanent: `damageMultiplier()`. `appliesToOpponentPermanents()` narrows it to player recipients when false. Read by `GameQueryService.getDamageToRecipientMultiplier` with both source and recipient controllers. Implemented by `DoubleControllerDamageToOpponentsAndTheirPermanentsEffect` (Twinflame Tyrant); multiple instances stack multiplicatively. |
| `BoardWipeEffect` | `CardEffect` | Recognition-only capability for board sweeps: `sweepsBoard()` (true when the current config is a mass sweep). Lets the AI's phase / defensive-pressure multipliers detect a wipe without naming the concrete type; the per-type wipe SCORING stays concrete (each sweep is valued differently). Implemented by `DealDamageEffect` (a set over every player's permanents, `controlledBy(eachPlayer(), …)`), `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect.all` (always), `DestroyOtherPermanentsWithEnteringNameEffect` (always), `SeasonOfTheWitchEffect` (always), `ReturnToHandEffect` (only for a `controlledBy(eachPlayer(), filter)` subject). |
| `RemovalEffect` | `CardEffect` | Descriptive capability for single-target removal: `removalKind()` returns `RemovalKind` (`DESTROY`/`EXILE`/`BOUNCE`) or `null` when the config isn't single-target removal (e.g. mass bounce). Read by `GameQueryService.computeGrantedHandAbilitiesForOwnedCard`; appended after a card's printed hand abilities by `AbilityActivationService` and `CardViewFactory`. Impl `GrantHandActivatedAbilityToCardsEffect` (Homing Sliver). |
| `SpellCastingAbilityGrantingEffect` | `CardEffect` | `filter()` and `grantedAbility()` for static abilities granted to matching spells. Read by the spell-casting/action-availability gates; `DEMONSTRATE` is consumed by the cast trigger pipeline (`SpellTriggers`). Impl `GrantSpellCastingAbilityToSpellsEffect`. |
| `GrantSpellCastingAbilityToFirstMatchingSpellEachTurnEffect` | `(Keyword grantedAbility, CardPredicate filter[, Zone sourceZone])` or `(Keyword grantedAbility, int abilityValue, CardPredicate filter)` | STATIC: the source controller's first matching spell each turn has `grantedAbility`; `abilityValue` configures valued abilities such as casualty 2; `sourceZone == null` means any casting zone. Reuses `SpellCastingAbilityGrantingEffect` and the existing cast-cost gates. Used by The Fifteenth Doctor and Anhelo, the Painter. |

Used for casualty 2 on Spelldrain Assassin (YSNC 29). |

Impl `GrantMiracleToCardsInHandEffect` for a fixed cost and `GrantMiracleReducedByManaCostEffect` for a per-card mana-cost reduction. |
| `CounterSpellingEffect` | `CardEffect` | Marker: "counter target spell". Impl `CounterSpellEffect`, `CounterMatchingSpellsEffect` (`UnlessPaysEffect` is read through `counters()`). |
| `CounterSpellingEffect` | `CardEffect` | Marker: "counter target spell". Impl `CounterSpellEffect`, `CounterMatchingSpellsEffect`. |

| `ProtectionGrantingEffect` | `CardEffect` | Descriptive capability for static "protection from �", read by the engine query layer (`GameQueryService`) not the AI: `protectionFromColors()` + `protectionScope()` (`PermanentSubject` null=self / `Subjects.attachedCreature()`), `protectionFromCardTypes()`, `protectionFromModifiedCreatures()`, `protectionFromSubtypes()` + `subtypeProtectionRequiresCreatureSource()`, `protectionFromManaValueAtLeast()` (`OptionalInt`), `protectionFromManaValueAtMost()`, and `protectionFromManaValuesOtherThanChosen()`; a record fills only its facet, inheriting empty/self defaults. `protectionFromColorless()`, `protectionFromPlayers()`. The engine evaluates the returned predicates and supplies engine-computed facts (attacking-alone, historic-spell-cast, shared-type creature groups) itself. Implemented by `CantBlockEffect`, `CanBlockOnlyIfAttackerMatchesPredicateEffect`, `MatchingCreaturesCantBlockMatchingCreaturesEffect`. |

Passing the blocker allows self-state-dependent taxes. Block-side counterpart of the attack tax; the block is legal, only the cost gates it. Implemented by `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessPaysEffect` (Hipparion, Myr Prototype). |

Implemented by `CanAttackAsThoughNoDefenderEffect`, `MatchingCreaturesCanAttackAsThoughNoDefenderEffect`. |

Attack-side counterpart of `BlockCostEffect`; the attack is legal, only the cost gates it. Implemented by `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessPaysEffect` (Phyrexian Marauder). |

Implemented by `MatchingCreaturesCantBlockMatchingCreaturesUnlessPaysLifeEffect` (Heat Wave). |

Named abilities use `creatureName()`/`PermanentNamedPredicate`; predicate abilities use `creatureFilter()` for the quality shared by every creature in the band. Consumed by `GameQueryService` and combat declaration/damage assignment. Used by Master of the Hunt's Wolves of the Hunt tokens and Adventurers' Guildhouse. |

The requirement comes from an active ability, not the Flagbearer subtype itself; changelings can satisfy it without creating it. Used by Standard Bearer and Coalition Honor Guard. |

The descriptive interfaces above let the AI (and engine query layer) read a FACT about an effect
instead of `instanceof`-ing the concrete type; implement the matching one when adding an effect to
that family (see `EFFECTS_QUICK_REFERENCE.md`). `CostEffect` is both a marker (cost snapshotting /
mana-ability exclusion) and a descriptive capability (its AI cost-valuation facets). Keep new
concrete-effect `instanceof` out of files outside `service/effect/**` / `service/validate/**` � no
build check enforces that any more, it is a convention the author has to honour.

### Target predicate � the `TargetSpec.predicate()` field

Effects that target permanents can optionally restrict valid targets by putting a `PermanentPredicate` in their `targetSpec()`'s `predicate` field (`benign(TargetPredicates.creature(), predicate)` / `harmful(TargetPredicates.permanent(), predicate)`). The declarative interpreter enforces it at cast, and saga-chapter / end-step targeting pipelines read it through `EffectResolution.targetPredicateOf(effect)`. Absent = `null` (no restriction).

Dual note: `PutCountersEffect.withTargetRestriction(CounterType, int count, PermanentPredicate)` keeps the predicate on a dedicated record COMPONENT (its `targetSpec()` carries a `null` predicate, so there is no cast-time gate); it is honoured only by the saga/end-step pipelines via `EffectResolution.targetPredicateOf`. `GrantKeywordEffect` carries its `filter` in the spec's predicate when `scope == TARGET` or `Subjects.withCreaturesSharingAColor(Subjects.target())`.

### Self-targeting � the `TargetSpec.selfTargeting()` field

Effects that implicitly target their source permanent (boost-self, animate-self, regenerate-self, etc.) set `selfTargeting = true` in their `targetSpec()` — written `new TargetSpec(null, false, null, true, 1)`. `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService` reads `targetSpec().selfTargeting()` to auto-assign the source as the target when no explicit target is provided.

Effects doing so: `BoostEffect.self` (only with `source()` or `attachedOrSource()`), `DoubleSelfPowerToughnessEffect`, `TapPermanentsEffect`/`UntapPermanentsEffect` (only when `subject` is `Subjects.source()`), `AnimatePermanentsEffect`/`SetCardTypesUntilEndOfTurnEffect` (only when `scope == Subjects.source()`), `PutCountersEffect.onSelf`, `PutSlimeCounterAndCreateOozeTokenEffect`, `RegenerateEffect` (when `!targetsPermanent()`), `GrantKeywordEffect` (when `scope == SELF`).

### `isPowerToughnessDefining()` default method on `CardEffect`

Effects that are characteristic-defining abilities (CDAs) for power/toughness (`*/*` effects) override `isPowerToughnessDefining()` to return `true`. Per CR 707.9d, when a copy effect provides specific P/T values (e.g. "except it's 7/7"), CDAs that define P/T are not copied. Used by `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect` with `powerOverride`/`toughnessOverride`.

Effects returning `true`: `SetPowerToughnessToAmountEffect` (the single CDA record for "P/T are each equal to …").

---
| `TappedBlockPermissionEffect` | `CardEffect` | `tappedBlockMatcher()` returns a `PermanentPredicate` selecting creatures that may block while tapped, or `null` (the default). `BlockLegalityService` evaluates the matcher relative to the permanent carrying the effect, so a controller-relative permission stays correct after control changes. Implemented by `ControlledCreaturesCanBlockAsThoughUntappedEffect` (Masako the Humorless). |

## Effect targeting declarations
- `TargetingRestrictionEffect.hexproofFromMonocolored()` is the static factory for "hexproof from
  monocolored"; use `GrantEffectEffect(..., Subjects.attachedCreature())` when an Equipment grants it.

An effect declares what it targets by overriding the single `targetSpec()` method on `CardEffect` to
return a `TargetSpec` (a `TargetPredicate` + a `harmful` flag + an optional `PermanentPredicate` + the
`selfTargeting` / `playerTargetCount` fields). The eleven legacy `canTarget*` / `isSelfTargeting` /
`isDamageOrDestruction` / `targetPredicate` / `requiredPlayerTargetCount` booleans were DELETED
(TargetSpec migration, July 2026) � `targetSpec()` is now the ONE source of truth, and everything
(`EffectResolution.needsTarget(card)` / `needsSpellTarget(card)`, the AI, the stack door's target choice, the
`TargetValidationService` interpreter) derives from it. Never call
`setNeedsTarget`/`setNeedsSpellTarget`. For kicker/modal spells use
`EffectResolution.resolveEffects(effects, kicked, modeIndex)` first to get the resolved effect list.

**Modal triggered abilities** (e.g. a "choose one" upkeep trigger, Etherwrought Page; Graviton,
Fundamental Force; Grenzo, Havoc Raiser): write the `ChooseOneEffect` as the ability's effect
(`addTrigger(Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU), new ChooseOneEffect(...))`). A trigger
path that pushes it onto the stack as a raw `ChooseOneEffect` has its mode announced before any player
receives priority (CR 603.3c): `StackedModalTriggerService.announceNextMode`, called from
`AutoPassService`, offers only modes with a legal target (`ChoiceContext.StackedModalTriggerModeChoice`),
then that mode's single player/permanent target (`PermanentChoiceContext.StackedModalTriggerTarget`), and
removes the ability from the stack when no mode is legal. The stack entry keeps its trigger context
(damaged player, event value); only its effects, target and target filter change. Combat-damage modes that
act on "that player" reuse the damaged player bound on the entry. Optional, multi-mode, multi-target and
graveyard/exile/spell-target modals are not announced there and still pick their mode on resolution via
`ChooseOneEffectHandler` (`ChoiceContext.ChooseModeChoice`); use `ChooseOneAtTriggerTimeEffect` for those.
A trigger-time modal (`TriggeredModalTrigger`: a cast trigger's or an enchanted-permanent tap trigger's bare
`ChooseOneEffect`, any `ChooseOneAtTriggerTimeEffect`) offers a mode that targets a spell only while a spell its
`StackEntryPredicateTargetFilter` admits is on the stack, and chooses that spell as the ability goes on the stack
(`ETBSpellTargetTrigger`, CR 603.3c, 603.3d): Hullbreaker Horror's "return target spell you don't control"
.
A cast trigger's lone `ChooseOneAtTriggerTimeEffect(modal, maximumChoices)` ("choose up to X", Riku of Many Paths' `TriggeringSpellModeCount`) has its maximum evaluated against the triggering spell as the ability goes on the stack; a maximum of 0 offers no mode, and the ability is removed (CR 700.2b). The modal goes to the mode choice as the card wrote it; the number of modes the event set rides on the choice (`TriggeredModalTrigger.withModeCount`), as does an enters or beginning-of-combat modal's "choose both instead" condition judged as the ability triggers.

**Modal triggered abilities with targets** ("choose one that hasn't been chosen", Demonic Pact): use `ChooseOneEffect.notYetChosen(List<ChooseOneOption>)` in `Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU)` ("this turn": `.notYetChosenThisTurn`; "that wasn't chosen during your last combat": `.notChosenDuringLastCombat`). The stack door parks the ability for its mode as it goes on the stack (`PermanentChoiceContext.TriggeredModalTrigger`, whose `consumeModes` / `modesResetEachTurn` / `rememberLastChosenMode` the restriction sets), then the chosen mode's targets; a mode's own `ChooseOneOption.targetFilter` overrides the card's. A plain "choose one" whose modes take at most one player or permanent target is announced once on the stack (`StackedModalTriggerService`); any other (a graveyard target, "choose both instead" with its condition judged as it triggers) the door asks as it goes there (CR 603.3c). The chosen mode is recorded on the source permanent (`chosenModeLabels`, `chosenModeLabelsThisTurn`, `chosenMode`), so it counts as chosen even if the ability is countered; a new object starts over.

A restricted `ChooseOneEffect` may also be the sole effect of a filtered cast trigger, an enter, discard, attack or combat damage trigger, or a step trigger: the stack door parks it as a `TriggeredModalTrigger`, so the mode is chosen as the ability is put on the stack and the selected mode's effects resolve normally; one put straight on the stack (Teval's Judgment) is announced by `StackedModalTriggerService`, which reads the restriction too.

**Factories** (all on `TargetSpec`): `harmful(target)` / `benign(target)` and the predicate-carrying
`harmful(target, predicate)` / `benign(target, predicate)`, where `target` comes from a
`TargetPredicates` factory; plus `TargetSpec.NONE` (targets nothing). Use the full canonical
constructor for self-targeting or a two-player count:
`new TargetSpec(null, false, null, /*selfTargeting*/ true, 1)`,
`new TargetSpec(TargetPredicates.player(), false, null, false, /*playerTargetCount*/ 2)`.

**`harmful`** = true exactly when the effect damages / fights / destroys / exiles / sacrifices its
target (i.e. the target must survive a `checkProtection` test � protection means "can't be
targeted"). Counters, bounces, control-changes, boosts, taps, text changes are `benign`.

`TargetPredicates` factories and what each offers/type-checks. **Build the declared target from one
of these**: the named values are interned, so a spec compares and hashes cheaply and the readers that
mean one specific declaration (`TargetSpec.declares(...)`) match by value. A hand-composed
`TargetPredicate` is legal where no factory fits — a cross-kind target is an `anyOf` of at most one
leaf per kind — but prefer adding a named factory when a second card wants the same shape:

| Factory | Legal target |
|---------|--------------|
| `null` / `TargetSpec.NONE` | nothing (default) |
| `TargetPredicates.player()` | a player |
| `TargetPredicates.playerOrPermanent()` | a player or any permanent — declares **no** restriction; see the warning below |
| `TargetPredicates.permanent()` | any permanent |
| `TargetPredicates.creature()` | a creature (layer-aware) |
| `TargetPredicates.land()` | a land (layer-aware) |
| `TargetPredicates.creatureOrPlaneswalker()` | a creature or planeswalker (layer-aware) |
| `TargetPredicates.playerOrPlaneswalker()` | a player or planeswalker (layer-aware) |
| `TargetPredicates.anyTarget()` | any target (player / creature / planeswalker / battle — CR 115.4), layer-aware |
| `TargetPredicates.spellOnStack()` | a spell on the stack (validated on the stack path) |
| `TargetPredicates.graveyardCard(scope)` | a card in a graveyard — `scope` is a `GraveyardSearchScope` (`CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD` / `OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD` / `ALL_GRAVEYARDS`) |
| `TargetPredicates.exileCard()` | a card in exile |

> **The graveyard scope is a declaration, not a hint.** Every enumeration and validation path reads
> it through `TargetSpec.graveyardScope()` and expands it with
> `GraveyardSearchScope.graveyardOwners(orderedPlayerIds, controllerId)` — there is no second place
> that decides which graveyards to search. Declare exactly what the oracle text names: "from your
> graveyard" is `CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD`, "from an opponent's graveyard" is `OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD`,
> "from a graveyard" is `ALL_GRAVEYARDS`. An effect whose scope varies per card carries a
> `GraveyardSearchScope` component and passes it straight through
> (`ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.source`, `CastTargetInstantOrSorceryFromGraveyardEffect.scope`,
> `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect.source`); never hard-code one scope in
> `targetSpec()` and rely on a `@ValidatesTarget` validator to catch the difference.

Fine-grained narrowing (artifact-only, nonland, a subtype) is the spec's `PermanentPredicate` field,
NOT a new category. Conditional effects (a `scope` / `recipient` that sometimes targets nothing)
compute a per-instance spec, e.g. `recipient == TARGET_PLAYER ? benign(player()) : NONE`.

> **`playerOrPermanent()` restricts nothing — never reach for it to buy tolerance.** It is the
> honest spelling for a multi-target effect whose per-position `TargetFilter`s carry the real
> restriction (Fight, Brass Squire, the fight/attach/move-counter families). It is NOT a way to make
> the spec interpreter leave an effect alone: an effect whose targets ride on
> `StackEntry.damageAssignments` gets its null-`targetId` tolerance from
> `EffectResolution.distributesAmountsAmongTargets` and still declares what it really targets
> (`DealDividedDamageEffect`, `DistributeCountersAmongTargetsEffect`, `PreventDividedDamageEffect`).
> Declaring `playerOrPermanent()` on a slot with no `TargetFilter` means every permanent — lands,
> artifacts, enchantments — is a legal target of that slot.

**A target slot with no `TargetFilter` is restricted by what its effects declare.** For a spell or
ability position that carries neither a card/ability-level `TargetFilter` nor a per-position one,
`EffectResolution.declaredPermanentRestriction` conjoins every permanent restriction the slot's
effects declare, and both target enumeration (`ValidTargetService`) and cast/activation validation
(`TargetLegalityService`) evaluate it. "Any target" (CR 115.4 — a creature, player or planeswalker)
is therefore a declaration, not something inferred from an effect also accepting players. A slot no
effect restricts keeps the legacy creature-only default when it is multi-target.

"Layer-aware" means the type test is `GameQueryService.isCreature` / `isLand` / `isPlaneswalker`
after the CR 613 pass, never the printed type line: an animated land is a legal "target creature",
a creature a type-**replacing** effect turned into a land is a legal "target land", and a
planeswalker that stopped being one is not a legal "any target" (CR 613.1d, CR 115.4). The
interpreter reaches all of them through one composed `PermanentPredicate` — the declared target's
own restriction and the spec's narrowing predicate folded together by `TargetSpec.targetPredicate()`.

**How to ask a spec a question.** There is no target-category enum any more; `TargetSpec` exposes
three readers and each answers a different question:

| Reader | Question | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| `admits(TargetPredicate.Kind.X)` | can a target of this kind ever be legal? | the stack door (`TriggeredAbilityStackService`), `StepTriggerService`, the AI, "does this need a permanent target at all" |
| `declares(TargetPredicates.x())` | is this *exactly* that declaration? | when one specific declaration is meant — `anyTarget()` vs `playerOrPermanent()` |
| `declaredTarget() == null` | does it target nothing? | the successor to the old `NONE` comparison |

`admits(PLAYER) && admits(PERMANENT)` is **not** a test for "any target": `playerOrPermanent()`
answers it too, and the two mean very different things. That lossy inference is the defect the
targeting model was rebuilt to remove — use `declares(TargetPredicates.anyTarget())`.
`PREDICATES_REFERENCE.md` documents the type; `agent-docs/TARGET_PREDICATE_PLAN.md` has the history.

### Worked example � a new "deal N damage to target creature" effect

```java
public record ZapTargetCreatureEffect(int damage) implements CardEffect {
    @Override
    public TargetSpec targetSpec() {
        return TargetSpec.harmful(TargetPredicates.creature()); // damage → harmful; creatures only
    }
}
```

That is the WHOLE targeting declaration: the interpreter in `TargetValidationService` offers only
creatures, rejects a creature with protection from the source (because `harmful`), and needs no
`@ValidatesTarget` validator (the declared target is purely structural). To restrict further — say
"target artifact creature" — pass a predicate: `TargetSpec.harmful(TargetPredicates.creature(), new
PermanentIsArtifactPredicate())`.

Add a `@ValidatesTarget` validator ONLY when legality depends on a rule the declared target + predicate
cannot express (opponent-relation, controller/owner compare, chosen-source, null-target tolerance) �
and such an effect STILL declares its structural `targetSpec()` (the `TargetSpecRatchetTest` guard
enforces this). See the target validator map at the bottom.

### Multi-target group binding (spells with several distinct targets)

A spell like "Target creature gets +1/+1 � Another target creature gets -1/-1" declares one
`target(filter)` group per distinct target and binds an ordinary, position-agnostic effect to
each group:

```java
target(creatureFilter).addSpellEffect(BoostEffect.target(1, 1));
target(creatureFilter).addSpellEffect(BoostEffect.target(-1, -1));
```

At resolution, an effect bound to a group applies to **all targets chosen for that group**
(`StackEntry.targetsForEffect` slices the flat target list by the card's declarations;
`EffectResolutionService` also remaps `entry.targetId` to the group's first target for
single-target handlers). An unbound effect (plain `addSpellEffect`) acts on
the whole flat target list. **Never create position-named effect classes**
(a "first target" / "second target" record pair); reuse the generic effect and bind it to the
right group. Wrapper effects (`ConditionalEffect`, `MayEffect`, �) propagate the binding to
their inner effect automatically.

Rules of thumb:
- Per CR 608.2b the spell resolves partially: a group whose targets are all gone simply does
  nothing; the spell fizzles only when ALL chosen targets are illegal.
- Graveyard target groups declare their scope in the group's filter
  (`GraveyardCardPredicateTargetFilter(cardPredicate, GraveyardSearchScope)`), which is how a spell
  takes two graveyard targets from different graveyards (Spelltwine). Enumeration, cast-time
  validation and the CR 608.2b recheck are all per-position off that filter; the effect that consumes
  them stays **unbound** so it sees every chosen card.
- A variable-count group ("up to N": `target(filter, 0, N)`) must be the **last** declared
  group � the flat wire format fills groups in declaration order, so an earlier variable group
  would be ambiguous.
- The only effects that inherently read two targets carry their group indices as record DATA:
  `FightTargetsEffect(firstGroup, secondGroup)` and
  `DealDamageEffect.bite(dealerGroup, recipientGroup)` (`bite()` is `(0, 1)`).
  `FightTargetsEffect.boundTargetGroupAndNext()` instead reads the group bound to the effect and
  the following group, which is useful when preceding modal modes shift the fight targets. For
  activated abilities (which declare targets via `multiTargetFilters`, not `target()`), these
  indices address flat target positions instead.

### Per-blocker trigger mode

A `Triggers.becomesBlocked()` ability can be registered with `TriggerOptions.EACH_BLOCKER` via `addTrigger(Triggers.becomesBlocked(), TriggerOptions.EACH_BLOCKER, effect)`, causing CombatService to create one stack entry per blocking creature (e.g. "whenever this creature becomes blocked **by a creature**"). Cards using this: `SylvanBasilisk`, `EngulfingSlagwurm` (Triggers.becomesBlocked() only), `InfiltrationLens`.

`Triggers.becomesBlocked()` fires only for *this* creature. For "whenever **a creature you control** becomes blocked" (any of your creatures), use `Triggers.creatureYouControlBecomesBlocked()` � fires once per blocked attacker on every permanent with the ability on the blocked creature's controller's battlefield. The watching permanent is the source; the entry records the blocked creature as its triggering permanent and non-targeting target, so "it" is `BoostEffect.of(Subjects.triggering(), ...)` and the like; permanent/player-targeting effects use the shared `AttackTriggerTarget` pipeline with the blocked creature as the choice's triggering permanent. Used by `UnstoppableAsh` and `CloseQuarters`. "Creatures you control have 'whenever this creature becomes blocked by a creature, …'" (Retaliation) is `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect(new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.becomesBlocked(), TriggerOptions.EACH_BLOCKER, …), Subjects.creaturesYouControl())`.

For "whenever **a creature** blocks" with no controller restriction, use `Triggers.creatureBlocks()` — fires once per blocking creature during declare blockers on every permanent with the ability across all battlefields, with the blocker as the stack entry's non-targeting `targetId`. Used by `CarnageGladiator` (`LoseLifeEffect(1, controllerOf(target()))`).

For "whenever **a creature** becomes blocked" with no controller restriction at all (a global watcher on an enchantment), use `Triggers.creatureBecomesBlocked()` on every battlefield: without `EACH_BLOCKER` once per blocked attacker (below), with `TriggerOptions.EACH_BLOCKER` ("becomes blocked by a creature", "a creature blocks a creature") once per declared attacker/blocker pair, the attacker the entry's triggering permanent and the blocker its non-targeting target. A comparison of the pair is the event condition, judged as blockers are declared (`BlockPairLesserPower(BlockParticipant)`, No Quarter: "destroy the blocking creature" = `DestroyCombatOpponentEffect(false)`, "destroy the attacking creature" = `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect(Subjects.triggering())`).

For a subtype-qualified form that should fire once per matching blocked attacker, give the trigger a filter (`Triggers.creatureBecomesBlocked().withFilter(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SLIVER))`, Spined Sliver); the pipeline judges the filter (and the ability's event condition) on each blocked attacker and puts the ability on the stack with the watcher as its source and the blocked attacker as its triggering permanent and non-targeting target. Spined Sliver uses this with `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SLIVER)` and `BoostEffect.of(Subjects.triggering(), new CreaturesBlockingSource(true), new CreaturesBlockingSource(true))`.

### Becomes-target-of-spell trigger

Effects of a `Triggers.becomesTargetOfSpell()` ability fire when the permanent (or the creature an equipment is attached to) becomes the target of a spell (spells only � not abilities). Two kinds of effect are supported, split by `targetSpec()`:
- **Targeting effects** (non-`NONE` category, e.g. `DealDamageEffect`) route through the shared "choose any target" interaction � "deal 2 damage to any target" when the equipped creature becomes targeted (`LivewireLash`).
- **"That spell's controller"** (`Subjects.controllerOf(Subjects.triggeringSpell())`): every becomes-the-target entry records the spell or ability that targeted as its triggering spell (as it was then, and as it last existed on the stack once it has left, CR 608.2h) and that object's controller as its triggering player, whatever the effects are; the effect reads "that spell or ability's controller" from it as the ability resolves, so "whenever this becomes the target of a spell, that spell's controller loses 5 life" is `LoseLifeEffect(5, controllerOf(triggeringSpell()))` (`ForsakenWastes`), and an effect that acts only on a spell ("counter that spell or ability [unless …]", ward) is aimed at that object on the stack without targeting it.
- `Triggers.becomesTargetOfSpellOrAbility()` records the same and preserves the source Aura id; the permanent that became the target is the entry's triggering permanent. Fractured Loyalty is `GainControlOfTargetEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent(PERMANENT).gainedBy(controllerOf(triggeringSpell()))`.
- **Non-targeting effects** (`TargetSpec.NONE`, e.g. `SacrificeSelfEffect`) go straight onto the stack as a `TRIGGERED_ABILITY` with `sourcePermanentId` set to the source � "When this creature becomes the target of a spell, sacrifice it" (`LabyrinthGuardian`; `JaceCunningCastaway`'s Illusion tokens). The any-target interaction never records a source, so a self-referential effect must take this path or it would no-op.

An **attached** permanent (Aura/Equipment) with this ability monitors only its host: the trigger fires when the enchanted/equipped creature is targeted, never when the attachment itself is targeted, and the resulting ability is controlled by the attachment's controller (CR 603.3a) even when the host belongs to an opponent. `SpectralPrison` = `DoesntUntapEffect.enchanted()` (STATIC) + `SacrificeSelfEffect` on this trigger.

### Becomes-target-of-Aura-spell trigger

Effects of a `Triggers.becomesTargetOfAuraSpell()` ability fire when the permanent itself becomes the target of an **Aura spell** (`Card.isAura()` on the triggering stack entry). Spells only, no controller restriction — an opponent's Aura and the controller's own Aura both trigger it. The ability goes straight onto the stack as a `TRIGGERED_ABILITY` with `sourcePermanentId` set, controlled by the targeted permanent's controller. Unlike `Triggers.becomesTargetOfSpell()`, attached permanents are not scanned for this trigger. Cards using this: `FugitiveDruid` (`DrawCardEffect`).

### Becomes-target-of-spell-or-ability trigger

Effects of a `Triggers.becomesTargetOfSpellOrAbility()` ability fire when the permanent (or a permanent it is attached to) becomes the target of any spell or activated ability. The triggered ability goes directly on the stack with `sourcePermanentId` set to the source permanent. Cards using this: `IceCage`. The trigger also covers abilities granted continuously via `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect(new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.becomesTargetOfSpellOrAbility(), ...))` (Dismiss into Dream).

"For the first time each turn" (`GlyphKeeper`: "counter that spell or ability") is the trigger's `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withLimit(TriggerLimit.FIRST_TIME_EACH_TURN)`: it doesn't trigger once the permanent was targeted earlier that turn (`Permanent.becomeTargetCounterUsedThisTurn`, every targeting counts). `CounterSpellEffect` acts only on a spell, so the entry is aimed at "that spell or ability" on the stack without targeting it. No controller restriction: it counters the controller's own spells too.

### Ally creature becomes target of opponent spell or ability trigger

Effects of a `Triggers.creatureYouControlBecomesTargetOfOpponentSpellOrAbility()` ability fire on ALL permanents with this ability on the creature's controller's battlefield whenever a creature that player controls becomes the target of a spell or ability controlled by an opponent. Unlike `Triggers.becomesTargetOfSpellOrAbility()` and its kin (which fire on the targeted permanent itself), this trigger fires on a separate permanent that monitors the event globally. Cards using this: `ShapersSanctuary`, `PawpatchRecruit`, `ScalelordReckoner`. A card-level target filter is honored for targeted effects; an opponent-relative permanent filter is scoped to the specific spell or ability controller that caused the trigger.

The `Triggers.creatureOrCreatureSpellYouControlBecomesTargetOfOpponentSpellOrAbility()` ability is the corresponding watcher for cards whose text explicitly includes both a creature and a creature spell. It also fires when a creature spell on the stack controlled by that player becomes the target of an opponent's spell or ability. Cards using this: `SurrakElusiveHunter`.

The `Triggers.creatureYouControlBecomesTargetOfOpponentSpell()` ability is the spell-only version of the global watcher above. It fires for opponent-controlled spells targeting a creature you control, but not for activated or triggered abilities. Cards using this: `SwarmShambler`.

### Another ally creature becomes target of spell or ability trigger

Effects of a `Triggers.anotherCreatureYouControlBecomesTargetOfSpellOrAbility()` ability fire whenever another creature controlled by the watcher’s controller becomes the target of any spell or ability. The watcher itself is excluded, and the targeted creature is stored as the triggered entry’s non-targeting `targetId`. Used by `MonkGyatso` for its optional airbend.

### Any creature becomes target of spell or ability trigger

Effects of a `Triggers.creatureBecomesTargetOfSpellOrAbility()` ability fire on ALL permanents with this ability across every battlefield whenever ANY creature (any controller) becomes the target of ANY spell or ability. Broader than `Triggers.creatureYouControlBecomesTargetOfOpponentSpellOrAbility()` (no controller/opponent restriction). The targeted creature is set as the non-targeting `targetId` so the resolved effect can act on it � pair with `ReturnToHandEffect.target()` for "return that creature to its owner's hand". Cards using this: `Cowardice`.

### Opponent creature becomes target of your spell or ability trigger

Effects of a `Triggers.creatureOpponentControlsBecomesTargetOfYourSpellOrAbility()` ability fire on ALL permanents with this ability on the *spell/ability controller's* battlefield whenever a creature an opponent of theirs controls becomes the target of that spell or ability. The mirror image of `Triggers.creatureYouControlBecomesTargetOfOpponentSpellOrAbility()`. The targeted creature is set as the non-targeting `targetId` and the listening permanent as the `sourcePermanentId`, so source-linked durations resolve correctly — pair with `GainControlOfTargetEffect(Duration.WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD)` for "gain control of that creature for as long as you control this". Cards using this: `Willbreaker`.

### Ally creature becomes target of instant or sorcery trigger

Effects of a `Triggers.creatureYouControlBecomesTargetOfInstantOrSorcerySpell()` ability fire on ALL permanents with this ability on the creature's controller's battlefield whenever a creature that player controls becomes the target of an instant or sorcery spell. Only the spell path checks it (activated/triggered abilities never trigger it) and there is no controller restriction, so the creature's controller's own spells trigger it too. The targeted creature is set as the non-targeting `targetId` so the resolved effect can act on it � pair with `BoostEffect.target` for "that creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn". Cards using this: `WildDefiance`.

## Wrapper / modifier effects

`CardsInExileMatchingAtLeast(n, filter)` (the controller owns at least N nontoken cards in exile matching a card predicate; Howling Galefang),
- `TargetPermanentColorCount()` is a target-relative `DynamicAmount` that counts the target
  permanent's current effective colors at activation time.
- `GraveyardStaticEffect(CardEffect wrapped)` marks a static effect that is active while its card
  is in its controller's graveyard; the wrapped effect reuses the ordinary continuous-effect
  handlers.
- `WrappedStackStaticEffect(CardEffect wrapped)` marks a static effect of an instant or sorcery that
  is active only while that spell is on the stack (Torrent of Lava); the wrapped effect reuses the
  ordinary continuous-effect handlers.

### Conditional effects (the `Condition` model)

`CreatureWithDifferentNameDiedThisTurn(excludedName)` is true when a creature whose last-known
battlefield name differs from `excludedName` died this turn. The name is retained even if the dead
creature later leaves the graveyard.
`ExactlyAttackers(n)` counts the creatures declared as attackers in the current combat exactly; use it inside `ConditionalEffect` for attack triggers that require an exact number. The count is snapshotted as the attack trigger triggers and re-checked when the ability resolves.

`CardsInHandMatchingAtLeast(n, filter)` counts the controller's hand cards matching the supplied card predicate (Sasaya, Orochi Ascendant's seven land cards).

Game-state conditions are **data**, not classes: the sealed interface
`model/condition/Condition` has one small record per condition (`Metalcraft`, `MaxSpeed`, `CoolnessAtLeast`, `Morbid`,
`Kicked`, `RepeatedAdditionalCostPaid(manaCost)` (optionally `minimumPayments` to distinguish repeated matching payments), `CasualtyCostPaid` (casualty's intervening "if"), `Raid`, `Equipped`, `ControlsPermanent(filter)`,
`ControlsPermanentCount(minCount, filter)` (at least), `ControlsPermanentCountAtMost(maxCount, filter)` (at most),
`AnyPlayerControlsPermanent(filter)`, `AnyPlayerControlsPermanentCount(minCount, filter[, excludeSource])` (N+ across all battlefields; the optional source exclusion supports "other" ETB counts), `AnotherCreatureOnBattlefield([count])` (at least `count`, default 1, creatures other than the triggering permanent; as a death triggers the ability the creatures that died with it count, CR 603.10a: Lifeline's intervening "if another creature is on the battlefield", Portcullis's "if there are two or more other creatures on the battlefield" `(2)`),
`AnyPlayerControlsPermanentCountAtMost(maxCount, filter)` (at most N across all battlefields � use `0` for "no matching permanents on the battlefield"; Pestilence's end-step self-sacrifice when no creatures exist; also gated as an intervening-if at `Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU)` in `StepTriggerService` — Spirit Mirror's "if there are no Reflection tokens on the battlefield"),
`OpponentControlsPermanent(filter)`, `OpponentControlsNoPermanent(filter)`, `DefendingPlayerControlsPermanent(filter)` (like every `DefendingPlayer…` condition, the player the creature attacks or is checked against attacking, CR 508.5), `ControlsMoreCreaturesThanOpponent`,
`APlayerControlsMoreCreaturesThanEachOtherPlayer([PermanentPredicate creatureFilter])`,
`APlayerHasMoreCardsInHandThanEachOtherPlayer`, `APlayerHasMoreLifeThanEachOtherPlayer` (Ghazbán Ogre, Wild Dogs), `FirstUpkeepThisTurn` (not an additional upkeep: Paradox Haze's event condition), `ActivePlayerIsMonarch` ("the monarch's end step": Archivist of Gondor's event condition), `SourceCardInExileWithCounter(SCREAM)` (All Hallow's Eve's intervening "if"),
`DefendingPlayerPoisoned`,
`OpponentPoisoned`, `OpponentDealtCombatDamageThisTurn()` (an opponent was dealt combat damage this turn: at least one counts for `OpponentsDealtCombatDamageThisTurn`; Tymna the Weaver skips its "pay X life" at X = 0), `OpponentDealtDamageThisTurn(minimumAmount)` (an opponent was dealt N+ damage this turn � use `1` for "any damage"; Bloodcrazed Goblin, Spinerock Knoll), `ControllerDealtDamageThisTurn(minimumAmount)` (the controller-relative counterpart — *you* were dealt N+ damage this turn, combat or not; reads the same `GameData.damageDealtToPlayersThisTurn`; Boarded Window's end-step self-exile), `DealtDamageByRedSpellThisTurn()` (the controller was dealt damage this turn by a red instant or sorcery spell � reads `GameData.lastRedSpellDamagerThisTurn`, recorded in `DamageSupport.dealDamageToPlayer`; Suffocation's `setCastCondition`), `OpponentLostLifeThisTurn(minimumAmount)` (an opponent lost N+ life this turn from any source, damage included � reads `lifeLostThisTurn`; Sygg, River Cutthroat; `isEtbTriggerGate()` for intervening-if ETBs like Voldaren Ambusher),
`OpponentGainedLifeThisTurn(minimumAmount)` (an opponent gained N+ life this turn; Needlebite Trap),
`AnyPlayerLostLifeThisTurn(minimumAmount)` (any player lost N+ life this turn from any source, including damage; supports intervening-if triggers),
`EventValueAtLeast(n)` (the triggering event's recorded amount is at least N; use on amount-bearing
damage triggers such as Innocent Bystander),
`ControllerLifeAtLeast(n)`,
`ColorsAmongControlledPermanentsAtLeast(n)` (at least N distinct effective colors among permanents the controller controls),
`CardTypesAmongControlledPermanentsAndGraveyardAtLeast(n)` (at least N distinct card types among the controller's effective permanents and nontoken graveyard cards),
`ControllerDidntLoseLifeThisTurn` (the source's controller lost no life this turn; damage counts as life loss; Luminarch Ascension),
`AnOpponentLifeAtMost(n)` (at least one opponent of the controller has N or less life; Blood Baron of Vizkopa's static boost, combined with `ControllerLifeAtLeast(30)` via `AllConditions`),
`OpponentLostLifeLastTurn()` (an opponent of the controller lost life during the immediately preceding turn; Feast on the Fallen),
`TargetPlayerAttackedControllerDuringLastTurn()` (the target player attacked the source controller during that player's most recent turn; O-Kagachi, Vengeful Kami),
`TargetPlayerAttackedBySubtypeControllerControlledThisTurn(CardSubtype)` ("that player" was attacked this turn by a creature of the subtype the source's controller controlled as it was declared; Ramses, Assassin Lord's intervening "if"), `SourceDealtDamageToTargetPlayerThisTurn(int minimum)` (the source has dealt at least that much damage to "that player" this turn; Vessel of the All-Consuming's intervening "if"), `SourceKeepsPermanentPhasedOut()` (a permanent is phased out by the source for as long as it remains tapped; The Pandorica's event condition),
`OpponentOwnsCardInExile()` (an opponent of the controller owns a card in exile; the controller's own exiled cards are excluded; Warden of the Beyond),
`ControllerOwnsCardInExile()` (the controller owns a card in exile; Dreadlight Monstrosity),
`ControllerLifeAtMost(n)` / `ControllerLifeAtMost.atHalfStartingLife()` (uses the game's actual starting life total), `ControllerLifeBelowStartingLife()` (controller's life total is less than the format's starting life total, so Commander's 40 applies; Resolute Archangel ETB gate via `isEtbTriggerGate`), `EachPlayerLifeAtMost(n)` (every player's life total is at or below N; upkeep intervening-if for Cryptolith Fragment's "if each player has 10 or less life"), `GraveyardCardThreshold(n, filter)`, `CardsInLibraryAtLeast(n)` (controller has N+ cards in library; Battle of Wits), `AnyLibraryAtMost(n)` (some player's library has N or fewer cards; Shelldock Isle), `AnyGraveyardAtLeast(n)` (some player's graveyard has N or more cards; Visions of Beyond), `OpponentGraveyardAtLeast(n)` (an opponent of the controller has N or more cards in their graveyard � controller's own graveyard excluded; Jace's Phantasm), `CardsInHandAtLeast(n)` (controller has N+ cards in hand; Imaginary Pet), `CardsInHandAtMost(n)` (controller has N or fewer cards in hand; Thresher Lizard STATIC +1/+2 with threshold 1), `AnyPlayerHandAtMost(n)` (some player has N or fewer cards in hand; Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal), `ActivePlayerHandAtLeast(n)` (the player whose upkeep/step it is has N+ cards in hand � Misers' Cage's "if that player has five or more cards in hand" on Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.OPPONENT)), `ActivePlayerHandEmpty` (the player whose upkeep/step it is has no cards in hand � gates upkeep triggers that read "if you/that player have no cards in hand"; Hollowborn Barghest), `ActivePlayerControlsPermanent(filter)` (the player whose upkeep/step it is controls a permanent matching the predicate — "if that player controls a nonblack, nonland permanent" on Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.ANY); Urborg Stalker), `ControllerHandEmpty` (controller has no cards in hand � Idle Thoughts activated; Bloodhall Priest ETB/attack gate via `isEtbTriggerGate` + `CombatAttackService` filter), `ControllerMaximumHandSizeOtherThanSeven` (controller's effective maximum hand size is not seven, including no maximum hand size; Learned Learner), `CastFromZone(zone)`,
`AttacksAlone`, `DuringCombat` (met while the current step is one of the five combat steps; encodes "dies during combat" — Mongrel Pack's `Triggers.dies(THIS)` intervening-if option), `StackIsEmpty` (no spell or ability is on the stack; Priority Avenger's lock), `TargetPlayerCouldCastSorcery` (the context's target player could cast a sorcery: their turn, a main phase, an empty stack, CR 307.5; Teferi's lock as `NotCondition`; `TargetPlayerTurn` is that player's turn, read for the player a static cast lock is judged for), `FirstCombatPhase` (met when the current combat phase is the turn's first — reads `GameData.combatPhasesThisTurn == 1`; gates additional-combat effects from looping across the extra combats they create, Finest Hour's intervening "if it's the first combat phase of the turn"), `MinimumAttackers(n)`, `AttackedWithCreaturesThisTurn(minimum)` (controller declared N+ attacking creatures this turn, cumulative across combats; Windbrisk Heights), `HasAttacker(predicate)`, `AllMatchingCreaturesAttack(filter)` (every controlled permanent matching the filter is attacking; vacuous if none match — Mob Mentality), `CreatureAttackingAndCreatureBlocking` (at least one creature is currently attacking and at least one creature is currently blocking; useful for conditional flash), `NoSpellsCastLastTurn`,
`AttacksPlayerAlone` (the referenced attacker is the only creature attacking that player; used for Jin Sakai, Ghost of Tsushima's player-specific attack trigger),
`TwoOrMoreSpellsCastLastTurn`, `SourceCounterThreshold(n, type)`, `SourceCounterCountParity(parity)` (the total number of counters on the source permanent is odd/even), `SourcePowerParity(parity)` (the source permanent's effective power is odd/even), `SourceUntapped` (the source permanent is untapped — Sphinx Sovereign's end-step branch), `TopCardOfLibraryColor(color)`,
`ChosenColorStrictlyMostCommonAmongOpponentNontokens` (Call to Arms: source's chosen color is strictly most common among an opponent's nontoken permanents; multicolor counts per color, colorless ignored, tokens ignored),
`ColorMostCommonAmongAllPermanents` (the given color is most common among all permanents or tied; multicolor counts for each color, colorless ignored),
`AllNonartifactCreaturesShareColor` (every nonartifact creature on the battlefield shares at least one effective color; artifact creatures are ignored and colorless creatures never satisfy it),
`SourceIsRenowned` (the source permanent is renowned, CR 702.112b — the intervening-if of "whenever this creature attacks, if it's renowned"; filtered at trigger time in `CombatAttackService`; Consul's Lieutenant),
`SourceIsSaddled` (the source permanent is saddled until end of turn; "whenever this creature attacks while saddled" is `Triggers.attacks()` with `withEventCondition(new SourceIsSaddled())`, judged as the attackers are declared; Brightfield Glider),
`SelfHasKeyword(keyword)`, `ControllerTurn`, `NotControllerTurn`, `ControllerIsNotStartingPlayer` (the controller is not the game's starting player; used for cast-time cost reductions such as Unforgiving Overtake),
`TargetPlayerIsActivePlayer` (the target-slot player is the active player; used by event triggers that
record the player whose turn the event occurred during),
`TargetPlayerControlsMoreLandsThanController` (the target-slot opponent controls strictly more lands
than the source controller; use for effects that refer to the opponent whose event caused the trigger),
`ControllerOwnTurnCountAtMost(n)` (it is the controller's turn and they have taken at most `n` turns this
game, per `GameData.turnsTakenByPlayer`, extra turns included � wrap in `NotCondition` for Serra Avenger's
"you can't cast this during your first, second, or third turns of the game"), `SourceHasSubtype(subtype)`, `SourceMatchesPermanentPredicate(predicate)` (current source characteristics, with a source snapshot fallback),
`TargetPermanentMatches(filter)`, `WonClash` (the controller won their most recent clash � written by
`ClashEffect` during resolution, read by a later effect on the same stack entry; e.g. Whirlpool Whelm's
"if you win, you may put that creature on top of its owner's library instead"), and more � see the
package for the full list). Two generic wrappers combine a condition with effects:

- `ConditionalEffect(Condition condition, CardEffect wrapped)` � resolves/applies `wrapped`
  only while the condition is met (intervening-if / "as long as" patterns). Targeting
