The life-loss step inserted after an earlier change of the same resolution (an exile, a sacrifice, a mill, a random reveal, discards) with players and amounts already fixed; its handler is `AsksDeathReplacementsFirst` and uses `LifeSupport.applyLifeLosses`, so Lich's Duel Mastery sacrifices are asked before any life is lost. Prefer `LoseLifeEffect` when a `PlayerSubject` fits. |
| `ResolveRiderForPlayerEffect` | `(CardEffect rider, UUID controllerId, UUID targetId, int eventValue, Map<UUID, UUID> removedPermanentControllers, List<UUID> targetCardIds)` | **internal, never on a card**. A "then" handler's rider made the next step of the resolving entry, resolved on a derived entry for the recipient and last-known value the handler determined. `DestroyTargetPermanentThenEffect` inserts it (only as the resolution step itself) for a rider whose handler is `AsksDeathReplacementsFirst` (a `LoseLifeEffect`, also behind a resolution-time `ConditionalEffect`), so Lich's Duel Mastery's sacrifice for "its controller loses 2 life" is asked after the destruction and before any life is lost. |
| `SacrificeSelfIfEvokedEffect` | `()` | evoke sacrifice (CR 702.75e): place in `Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)`. `EtbEffectResolver` resolves it to a `SacrificeSelfEffect` when the permanent was cast for its evoke (alternate) cost, else drops the trigger. Pair with `AlternateHandCast(ManaCastingCost)` + `GameService.playCardWithEvoke` (Dawnfluke) |
| `CreateTokenCopyOfSacrificedPermanentEffect` | `()` / `(int amount)` | sacrifice-trigger effect that uses the stack entry's triggering permanent (as it last existed on the battlefield, CR 603.10a) (the sacrificed permanent's last-known card characteristics) to create a token copy; the handler creates the copy as one ordered token creation event (`TokenCopySupport.createTokenCopiesWithTokenRider`) and grants haste until end of turn and schedules the controller's next end-step pay-or-sacrifice action for every token it creates, added ones included. Ashling, the Limitless |
| `ChampionCreatureEffect` | `(CardSubtype... championedSubtypes)` � no-arg ctor = any creature; multiple subtypes match inclusively ("Goblin or Shaman", Lightning Crafter) | champion a creature, or a permanent with one of the specified subtypes: on ETB sacrifice unless you exile another matching permanent you control; when this leaves the battlefield a triggered ability returns the exiled card. The ETB may still exile after its source has left. Uses `PermanentChoiceContext.ChampionCreature` + `exileReturnOnPermanentLeave`. Used by Changeling Hero. For a "when a creature is championed with this" follow-up trigger, write `addTrigger(Triggers.championsCreature(), effect)` � it fires from `PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService.handleChampionCreature` right after the exile (player-targeting effects route through `PermanentChoiceContext.ChampionedTriggerTarget`; Mistbind Clique) |
| `DestroyNonlandPermanentsWithManaValueEqualToChargeCountersEffect` | `()` | destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on source (reads snapshotted count from xValue). Used by Ratchet Bomb |
| `DestroyNonlandPermanentsWithManaValueXDealtCombatDamageEffect` | `()` | destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to X whose controller was dealt combat damage by the source permanent this turn. Reads X from xValue, checks combatDamageToPlayersThisTurn. Used by Steel Hellkite |
| `TransformSelfEffect` + `ChoosePermanentsEffect.exactly(1, creaturesYouControl()).thatCanHost(source())` + `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect(source(), thisWay(CHOOSE))` | _compose_ | "transform this enchantment, then attach it to a creature you control" (Sidequest: Play Blitzball): not skippable, a lone creature chosen unasked |
| `ChoosePermanentsEffect.exactly(1, controlledBy(you(), filter))` + `TransformSelfEffect(thisWay(CHOOSE))` | _compose_ | "transform an Incubator token you control" (Sunder the Gateway): the one candidate chosen unasked; `TransformSelfEffect(picked(PermanentIsDoubleFacedPredicate))` in a `MayEffect` is "if it's a double-faced card, you may transform it" after a put (Nick Fury, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.) |
| `SacrificeAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` or `(int damageToController)` | sacrifice the source at end of combat. With `damageToController > 0` ("sacrifice it and it deals N damage to you", Time Elemental = 5) the same delayed ability also carries `DealDamageEffect.to(CONTROLLER, N)`. Resolution creates an end-of-combat delayed triggered ability (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.atNextStep`, `Triggers.endOfCombat()`) carrying `SacrificeSelfEffect`; the damage is dealt with last-known information, so it happens even if the creature already left the battlefield. Put on Triggers.attacks() / Triggers.blocks() |
| `PutSelfOnTopOfLibraryAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | schedule the source permanent to be **put on top of its owner's library** at end of combat. "When this creature attacks or blocks, put it on top of its owner's library at end of combat." Put on Triggers.attacks() / Triggers.blocks(); schedules a delayed triggered ability for the end of combat (`DelayedPermanentActions.schedule`, CR 603.7a) that does `PUT_ON_TOP_OF_LIBRARY_AT_END_OF_COMBAT` as it resolves, and does nothing to a permanent that already left the battlefield. See Saprazzan Outrigger |
| `PutCounterOnCombatOpponentAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int amount)` or `(…, boolean alsoTap)` | Put on Triggers.endOfCombat(): as the trigger resolves, puts counters on every creature still blocking or blocked by the source; Greater Werewolf uses this inside an intervening-if `SourceAttackedOrBlockedThisCombat` condition, Dread Wight with `PARALYZATION` and `alsoTap=true`. Counter placement respects `cantHaveCounters` Targets nothing. |
| `PutCounterOnCombatOpponentEffect` | `(CounterType counterType, int amount[, CardEffect grantedStaticEffect, CardEffect grantedUpkeepEffect])` | puts counters on the **combat opponent** immediately on resolution. The card declares no target for it, so it acts on "that creature", the creature on the other side of the block, recorded as the entry's non-targeting `targetId` as the ability triggers. Placement respects counter prevention. Optional effects are granted persistently only when counters are placed; Mindbender Spores supplies its fungus-counter untap lock and upkeep-removal ability this way. Counter names have no intrinsic rules |
| `DestroyTargetPermanentAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()`, `(boolean cannotBeRegenerated)`, `(PermanentSubject)`, `(boolean, PermanentSubject)`, `ofTriggeringPermanent()` | schedule the permanents the subject names for destruction at end of combat: `target()` (default; harmful CREATURE target, "destroy it at end of combat" riders, Goblin Sappers with `MakeCreatureUnblockableEffect`), `triggering()` ("destroy that creature at end of combat": the basilisks, Sosuke, Son of Seshiro) or `source()` ("when this creature blocks, destroy it at end of combat": Cinder Wall, Arrogant Bloodlord). Schedules a delayed triggered ability for the end of combat (`DelayedPermanentActions.schedule`, CR 603.7a) that does `DESTROY_AT_END_OF_COMBAT` as it resolves (regeneration/indestructible apply) and does nothing to a permanent that already left. `RemovalEffect` DESTROY except for `source()`. Unlike `DestroyCombatOpponentAtEndOfCombatEffect` the target is chosen |
| `DestroyCombatOpponentsOfTargetAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` / `(boolean onlyCreaturesBlockedByTarget)` / `(boolean, boolean onlyWhileInCombat)` | One-shot end-of-combat destruction keyed to a chosen creature. The default mode destroys creatures that blocked or were blocked by it (Venomous Breath); the directional mode destroys only creatures blocked by it (Glyph of Doom). `onlyWhileInCombat` (Kjeldoran Frostbeast, source-trigger form) destroys nothing once the source has left combat, e.g. regenerated; it is off for the spell form, which reads turn history (Gaze of the Gorgon). Resolution creates a delayed triggered ability for this turn's next end of combat step (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.atNextStepThisTurn(Triggers.endOfCombat(), …)`) carrying the effect again, remembering the creature and its combat opponents so far; as that ability resolves it also reads the directional or bidirectional combat history, so blocks declared after the spell resolved are included. Regeneration and indestructible apply. `RemovalEffect` DESTROY; `targetSpec()` = harmful CREATURE `ofSourceWhileInCombat()`: the source's own non-targeting end-of-combat ability ("destroy all creatures blocking or blocked by this creature", Kjeldoran Frostbeast). |
| `GrantTrampleToCreaturesBlockedByTargetEffect` | `()` | "Creatures that were blocked by that creature this combat gain trample until end of turn" (Ride Down). The target is a currently blocking creature (`targetSpec()` = benign CREATURE narrowed by `PermanentIsBlockingPredicate`). Resolution snapshots its `blockingTargetIds`, grants trample to each surviving creature, and leaves the ordinary `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect()` to resolve next on the same target group |
| `TapCombatOpponentsOfTargetAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` / `(boolean schedule)` | One-shot delayed tap/untap-lock effect for Triton Tactics. The card form (`schedule=true`) has a benign creature `targetSpec()` and is bound to the spell's `target(TargetFilters.creature(), 0, 2)` group. Resolution creates one delayed triggered ability for this turn's next end of combat step (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.atNextStepThisTurn(Triggers.endOfCombat(), …)`, "this turn's next end of combat") carrying `(schedule=false)` and remembering the chosen creatures, and that trigger taps the deduplicated attackers they blocked (from `GameData.combatOpponentIdsBlockedByThisTurn`) with a one-untap-step lock. |
| `PutMinusOneCounterOnSourceAtEndOfCombatEffect` | `()` | schedule the source permanent to get a **-1/-1 counter at end of combat** (delayed, so it stays full size for the combat damage step — unlike the immediate `PutCountersEffect.onSelf(MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE)`). "Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, put a -1/-1 counter on it at end of combat." Put on Triggers.attacks() and/or Triggers.blocks(); creates an end-of-combat delayed triggered ability (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.atNextStep(Triggers.endOfCombat(), …)`) carrying `PutCountersEffect.onSelf(MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE)`, which uses the stack as the next end of combat step begins. See Wicker Warcrawler |
| `ExileEachTargetPermanentThenRevealUntilSharedCardTypeEffect` | `()` | exile each selected artifact, creature, enchantment, planeswalker, and/or land, then for each exiled permanent reveal its controller's library until a permanent card sharing a card type with it is found; put the found cards onto the battlefield and shuffle the other revealed cards back. Chaotic Transformation |
| `EachPlayerShufflesOwnedCreaturesIntoLibraryThenRevealsCreatureEffect` | `()` | shuffle each player's owned creature permanents into their owner's library; players who shuffled a nontoken creature reveal one creature card, all found creatures enter simultaneously, and the other revealed cards are put on the bottom in random order. Collision of Realms |
| `SeparateIntoPilesEffect` | `permanents(controlledBy(players, filter), label)` / `cards(graveyardCards, chooser, label)` | the pile step (CR 700.3): the controller separates the objects into two piles (either may be empty), a player chooses one; a CHOOSE step, `thisWay(CHOOSE)` / `cardsThisWay(CHOOSE)` the chosen pile, the other pile `except(set, thisWay(CHOOSE))`. Permanents: each named player's own are separated and that player chooses (Stand or Fall over `eachOpponent()`); a `targetPlayer()` set declares the target. Then the verb: `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect(thisWay(CHOOSE, creature), true)` (Do or Die), `SacrificeSelfEffect(thisWay(CHOOSE), targetPlayer())` (Liliana of the Veil), `CantAttackThisTurnEffect` / `CantBlockThisTurnEffect(except(controlledBy(...), thisWay(CHOOSE)))` (Fight or Flight, Stand or Fall), `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect.cards(cardsThisWay(CHOOSE))` + `PutCardsOntoBattlefieldEffect(except(...))` after `ChoosePlayerEffect.opponent()` (Death or Glory) |
| `WhimsOfTheFatesEffect` | `()` | each player separates all permanents they control into three piles, then one pile is chosen uniformly at random for that player and sacrificed. The engine prompts each player for Pile 1 and Pile 2 in controller-first turn order; the unselected permanents form Pile 3, and all randomly selected permanents are sacrificed together |
| `MakeAnExampleEffect` | `()` | each opponent separates their creatures into two piles; the spell controller chooses one pile for each opponent to sacrifice. Uses `PendingPileSeparation` plus `PendingMakeAnExample`: every opponent splits in APNAP order, then the controller chooses each opponent's pile, then all chosen piles are sacrificed as one event (CR 608.2e) (Make an Example, `NCC` 37) |

### Sacrifice costs (for activated abilities)

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ExileSelfCost` | `()` or `(boolean trackWithSource)` | exile this permanent as cost (e.g. Brittle Effigy); the tracking form associates the exiled card with the activating permanent |
| `UnattachEquipmentFromSourceCost` | `()` | activated-ability cost: choose any Equipment attached to the source permanent, unattach it, and snapshot its mana value as the ability's X value (Captain America, First Avenger) |
| `ExileSelfCost` | `()` | exile this permanent as cost (e.g. Brittle Effigy). Handled in `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService` via `removePermanentToExile` |
| `WaterbendCost` | `(int amount)` / `optional(int amount)` | Waterbend cost for abilities and casting cost (`addCastingCost`)s. Each untapped artifact or creature tapped while paying contributes one generic mana toward `amount`; available mana is used first and only the required number of qualifying permanents is tapped. `optional(int amount)` marks a spell cost that may be declined |
| `SacrificeSelfCost` | `()` or `(boolean trackPower)` | sacrifice this permanent as cost. `trackPower=true` snapshots effective power into the stack entry's xValue at payment (last-known info). Pair with `UnlessPaysEffect.counterUnlessPaysX()` for "unless pays {X}, where X is this creature's power" (Mausoleum Wanderer) |
| `SacrificeSelfCost` | `()` or `(boolean trackPower)`; `recordingPermanentSnapshot()` | sacrifice this permanent as cost. `trackPower=true` snapshots effective power into the stack entry's xValue at payment (last-known info). `recordingPermanentSnapshot()` preserves the source's last-known counters and attached Equipment IDs for later resolution. Pair with `UnlessPaysEffect.counterUnlessPaysX()` for "unless pays {X}, where X is this creature's power" (Mausoleum Wanderer) |
| `RemoveAllCountersAsCostEffect` | `(CounterType counterType)` or `(CounterType counterType, boolean fromGrantingEquipment)` | additional cost: remove all counters of the given type from the source. The number removed is snapshotted into the ability's xValue (in `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService`, via `Permanent.getCounterCount`/`setCounterCount`) before the counters are cleared, so a companion effect (e.g. `LookAtTopCardsEffect` with an `XValue()` look count) scales with the count removed. Used by Jar of Eyeballs (`CounterType.EYEBALL`). `fromGrantingEquipment = true` pays from the Equipment that granted the ability instead of the activating permanent — Hankyu's "{T}, Remove all aim counters from Hankyu: This creature deals damage to any target equal to the number of aim counters removed this way" (`RemoveAllCountersAsCostEffect(AIM, true)` + `DealDamageEffect.toAnyTarget(new XValue())`). Contrast `RemoveCountersEffect.allFromSelf`, the resolution step whose REMOVE_COUNTERS result `AmountThisWay(REMOVE_COUNTERS)` reads |
| `RemoveAllCountersFromAllPermanentsThenEnterWithCountersEffect` | `(CounterType counterType)` | as-enters replacement: removes every concrete counter from every permanent and makes the entering permanent receive one counter of `counterType` for each counter removed (Thief of Blood) |
| `RemoveAllCountersFromChosenPermanentsThenEnterWithCountersEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, CounterType counterType, int multiplier)` | as-enters replacement: the controller chooses any number of matching permanents, removes every concrete counter from them, and makes the entering permanent receive `multiplier` counters of `counterType` for each counter removed (Sin, Unending Cataclysm) |
| `ExileTetraviteTokensToPutCountersOnSelfEffect` | `()` | Tetravus upkeep trigger 2 ("you may exile any number of tokens created with this creature. If you do, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature"). Its handler gathers the source's still-alive tracked tokens from `GameData.sourceCreatedTokens` (any controller) and opens a `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.ExileTetraviteTokensPutCountersOnSource` multi-permanent choice; the completion in `MultiPermanentChoiceHandlerService` exiles the chosen tokens and puts that many +1/+1 counters on the source. Does nothing if the source has no surviving tokens |
| `SacrificeCreatureCost` | `()` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue)` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue, boolean trackSacrificedPower)` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue, boolean trackSacrificedPower, boolean trackSacrificedToughness)` or `(boolean trackSacrificedManaValue, boolean trackSacrificedPower, boolean trackSacrificedToughness, boolean excludeSelf)` | sacrifice a creature as cost. When `trackSacrificedManaValue=true`, the sacrificed creature's mana value is stored in the StackEntry's xValue (e.g. Birthing Pod). When `trackSacrificedPower=true`, the sacrificed creature's effective power (including static bonuses) is stored in xValue (e.g. Ichor Explosion). When `trackSacrificedToughness=true`, the sacrificed creature's effective toughness is stored in xValue (e.g. Disciple of Griselbrand). When `excludeSelf=true`, the source permanent cannot be chosen as the sacrifice target � use for "Sacrifice another creature" costs (e.g. Grimgrin, Corpse-Born) |
| `PayLifeOrPayManaCost` | `(int lifeAmount, String manaCost)` | additional cast cost: pay the fixed life amount **or** pay `manaCost`. `PlayCardRequest.payLifeForAdditionalCost=true` selects life; false or absent selects mana. Handled by `AdditionalSpellCostService` / `SpellCastingService` |
| `SacrificePermanentCost` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String description)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String description, boolean excludeSource)` | sacrifice a permanent matching filter as cost. Works for spell costs, activated abilities (via `MultiplePermanentSacrificeCostHandler`), and predicate-backed forced costs. Uses `PredicateEvaluationService.matchesPermanentPredicate()` for validation. Use `PermanentAllOfPredicate(List.of(new PermanentIsCreaturePredicate(), new PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(subtype)))` with `excludeSource=false` for "Sacrifice a [subtype]" creature costs that can sacrifice the source. The 4-arg form adds `trackSacrificedPower` � snapshots the sacrificed permanent's effective power into the ability's xValue at payment (the predicate-based sibling of `SacrificeCreatureCost(false, true)`), read back via `XValue`. Freyalise Supplicant: half that power via `Divided(new XValue(), 2)`. The 5-arg form adds `trackSacrificedManaValue` � snapshots the sacrificed permanent's mana value into xValue instead (Soldevi Adnate: `AwardManaEffect(BLACK, new XValue())`; mana abilities read xValue via `AmountContext.forManaAbility(source, controller, xValue)`) |
| `SacrificeMultiplePermanentsCost` | `(int count, PermanentPredicate filter[, String description])` | sacrifice N permanents matching filter as cost (e.g. "Sacrifice three artifacts: ..." with `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate`). Multi-step UI: if exactly N match, auto-sacrifices all; otherwise prompts one-at-a-time. Validated and paid in `AbilityActivationService`. Also valid as a spell's additional cast cost (`addCastingCost`) ("As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice two creatures" � Phyrexian Tribute, `(2, PermanentIsCreaturePredicate)`); the chosen permanents ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds` and are validated/paid by `AdditionalSpellCostService` + `SpellCastingService` before any mana is spent. Harness: `castSorceryWithSacrifices(player, index, targetId, ids)` |
| `SacrificeDistinctNamePermanentsCost` | `(int count, PermanentPredicate filter)` | activation-only cost that chooses N matching permanents with distinct names, retaining the chosen permanents until the final pick before sacrificing them (Transmutation Font) |
| `TapAnyNumberOfPermanentsCost` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | **Spell** additional cast cost (`addCastingCost`): "As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap any number of untapped permanents you control matching filter" (Burn at the Stake, `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate`). Any count including **zero** is legal, so it never blocks castability. The number tapped becomes the spell's X value, so a companion effect scales with it (Burn at the Stake pairs it with `DealDamageEffect.toAnyTarget(new Scaled(new XValue(), 3))`). Chosen permanents ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds` (shared with `SacrificeMultiplePermanentsCost` / `ReturnAnyNumberOfPermanentsToHandCost` — no spell carries more than one) and are validated/paid by `AdditionalSpellCostService.validateTapAnyNumberOfPermanentsCost` + `SpellCastingService.payTapAnyNumberOfPermanentsCost` before any mana is spent. Harness: `castSorceryTappingPermanents(player, index, targetId, ids)`. Contrast `TapMultiplePermanentsCost` (activated-ability only) |
| `TapCreaturesForManaCost` | `()` | **Spell cost (`addCastingCost`) or activated-ability cost**: tap any number of untapped creatures you control; each tapped creature reduces the spell or ability's generic mana cost by `{1}`. As a spell cost, selected creatures ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds`, are validated before mana payment, and are tapped after the reduced spell cost is paid. Used by Explosive Singularity (NEO 140); the same record is used for Heirloom Epic's activated-ability cost. |
| `TeamworkCost` | `(int requiredPower)` | **Spell** optional additional cast cost (`addCastingCost`): tap any number of untapped creatures you control with total effective power at least `requiredPower`. Declining is legal; selected creatures ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds`, are validated/paid by `AdditionalSpellCostService` and `SpellCastingService`, and each tapped creature fires `Triggers.tappedToPayTeamworkCost()`. |
| `ReturnAnyNumberOfPermanentsToHandCost` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | **Spell** additional cast cost (`addCastingCost`): "As an additional cost to cast this spell, return X permanents you control matching filter to their owner's hand" (Infernal Harvest, `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SWAMP)`). Any count including **zero** is legal. The number returned becomes the spell's X value (Infernal Harvest pairs it with `DealDividedDamageEffect.xAmongTargetCreatures()`). Chosen permanents ride on `PlayCardRequest.additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds`; harness `castSorceryReturningPermanents(player, index, damageAssignments, ids)`. Contrast `ReturnCreatureToHandCost` (exactly one creature) / `ReturnMultiplePermanentsToHandCost` (activated-ability only) |
| `ReturnMultiplePermanentsToHandCost` | `(int count, PermanentPredicate filter)` | return N permanents matching filter from battlefield to owner's hand as cost (e.g. "Return two lands you control to their owner's hand" with `PermanentIsLandPredicate`). Multi-step UI: if exactly N match, auto-returns all; otherwise prompts one-at-a-time. Validated and paid in `AbilityActivationService`. Works with both battlefield and graveyard activated abilities |
| `ReturnCreatureToHandCost` | `()` | additional cost to cast a **spell**: return a creature you control to its owner's hand (Familiar's Ruse). A spell cost (`addCastingCost`). The creature is supplied via `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId` (reuses the sacrifice-cost id field) and paid in `SpellCastingService`; spell is unplayable if you control no creature (`CastingCostService.canPayAdditionalSpellCosts`). This is the spell-cast analogue of `ReturnMultiplePermanentsToHandCost` (which is activated-ability only) |
| `ReturnPermanentToHandCost` | `()` or `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | additional cost to cast a **spell**: return exactly one matching permanent you control to its owner's hand (Disappearing Act; Deprive uses `PermanentIsLandPredicate`). The no-arg form matches any permanent. A spell cost (`addCastingCost`). The permanent is supplied via `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId`, validated before mana payment, and returned by `SpellCastingService`; spell is unplayable if you control no matching permanent |
| `PutCounterOnControlledCreatureCost` | `(CounterType counterType, int count)` | put `count` counter(s) of the given type on a creature you control. **Spell cost** (`addCastingCost`, Scarscale Ritual: `MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE, 1`): creature supplied via `PlayCardRequest.sacrificePermanentId` and paid in `SpellCastingService`; spell is unplayable if you control no creature (`CastingCostService.canPayAdditionalSpellCosts`). Also usable as an **activated-ability cost** (Hatchet Bully): dispatched to `PutCounterOnCreatureCostHandler` via the `PermanentChoiceCostHandler` pattern � auto-selects when only one creature qualifies, prompts when multiple. Counter placed directly; creature dies later via state-based actions if toughness reaches 0 |
| `PutCounterOnOpponentCreatureCost` | `(CounterType counterType, int count)` | `UnlessPaysEffect` ransom for cumulative upkeep: the payer puts one counter on a creature an opponent controls for each of `count` age-counter payments, choosing separately among eligible opponent creatures (all on the one when only one can get them); no eligible creature makes the cost unpayable (not asked). Used by `CumulativeUpkeepEffect.putCounterOnOpponentCreature(...)` (Sheltering Ancient) |
| `BlightEffect` | `(int count, CardEffect thenEffect)` or `(int count, CardEffect thenEffect, boolean thenEffectTargets)` | resolution-time blight action: choose a creature you control, put `count` -1/-1 counters on it, then put `thenEffect` on the stack; set `thenEffectTargets` for a targeted reflexive follow-up that chooses its target after blighting (Warren Torchmaster). Use `MayEffect(BlightEffect, ...)` for optional blight (Blighted Blackthorn). Also `.byTargetPlayer(n)` is "target player blights N" (Champion of the Weird; bound the opponent with the target filter). |
| `DiscardCardTypeCost` | `(CardPredicate predicate, String label)` or `(CardPredicate predicate, String label, boolean manaValueEqualsX)` or full `(predicate, label, manaValueEqualsX, count, sameName, trackManaValue)` | discard a card matching a predicate as cost (null predicate = any card). The `label` is used in UI messages. E.g. `new DiscardCardTypeCost(new CardTypePredicate(CardType.LAND), "land")`, `new DiscardCardTypeCost(new CardIsHistoricPredicate(), "historic")`, `new DiscardCardTypeCost(null, null)` for any card. Set `manaValueEqualsX=true` for "discard a card with mana value X" — the discardable cards are additionally restricted to those whose mana value equals the ability's chosen X (Knollspine Invocation, paired with an `{X}` mana cost). `trackManaValue=true` snapshots the discarded card's mana value into the stack entry's `xValue` at payment (Mercurial Chemister + `DealDamageEffect.toTargetCreature(new XValue())`). Also usable as a **spell cost** (`addCastingCost`, Seize the Spoils; a count greater than one uses `PlayCardRequest.discardHandCardIndices`), validated before any cost is paid (`AdditionalSpellCostService`), and the spell is unplayable without enough other matching cards in hand (`CastingCostService.canPayAdditionalSpellCosts` / `validDiscardCostIndices` — the spell can never be its own discard). `imprintOnSource=true` (7th component of the full ctor) imprints the discarded card on the source card, so the ability's effects can gate on it with `ConditionalEffect(new ImprintedCardMatches(filter, description, "discarded card"), …)` (Necromancer's Stockpile)  |
| `DiscardLastDrawnCardCost` | `()` | activation-only hand-card cost that permits only the last card the controller drew this turn, if it remains in hand; it reuses the `HandCardCost` discard-choice path (Jandor's Ring) |
| `EscalateCost` | `(CostEffect perModeCost, Kind kind)`, `escalate("{1}")` / `escalate(perModeCost)` / `entwine("{2}")` / `entwine(perModeCost)` | A modal spell's mode-count cost (spell cost, `addCastingCost`, with `ChooseOneEffect.oneOrMore`): `ESCALATE` pays `perModeCost` once per mode beyond the first (CR 702.120a), `ENTWINE` once for choosing all modes instead of the number specified (CR 702.42a). One payment is `PayManaCost("{M}")` (folded into the spell's total mana, so cost changes apply), `DiscardCardTypeCost(null, null)` (`PlayCardRequest.discardHandCardIndices`), `SacrificeMultiplePermanentsCost(n, filter)` or `TapMultiplePermanentsCost(1, filter)` (`additionalCostSacrificePermanentIds`). A free cast still pays it (CR 118.9d). Collective Brutality, Collective Effort, Borrowed Hostility; Betrayal of Flesh, Solar Tide, Barbed Lightning, Kaya's Guile (choose two of four: entwine is paid for all four, and a count in between is refused). Copies cease to exist instead of entering exile. Used by Nivmagus Elemental and Synthesis Pod |

The number of exiled cards becomes the X value. Player chooses which and how many cards to exile (0 or more); castability needs at least one matching card in the graveyard. Add it with `addCastingCost` and pass `exileGraveyardCardIndices` (List<Integer>) via `PlayCardRequest`. Handled by `SpellCastingService`. E.g. Harvest Pyre, Haunting Misery (`CREATURE` + `DealDamageEffect.toTargetPlayerOrPlaneswalker(new XValue())`) |

Add it with `addCastingCost` and pass `exileGraveyardCardIndices` (List<Integer>) via `PlayCardRequest`. `GameActionAvailabilityService` checks graveyard has enough matching cards for castability. Handled by `SpellCastingService`. E.g. Skaab Ruinator (3, CREATURE). Also usable as an **activated-ability** cost (Immortal Coil "Exile two cards from your graveyard", Drudge Spell "Exile two creature cards from your graveyard"): `AbilityActivationService` gates on the number of graveyard cards matching `requiredType` and auto-exiles the front N of those � no per-card choice interaction |

| `PutCardFromHandOnTopOfLibraryCost` | `()` | activation-only `HandCardCost`: choose one card from hand and put it on top of its controller's library instead of discarding it. Uses the shared hand-card choice flow; no discard triggers fire (Hidden Retreat) |

## Counter spells

"Counter that spell" of a cast trigger is `Triggers.playerCastsSpell()` with a filter and `CounterSpellEffect()`: the stack door puts it on the stack aimed at the triggering spell, which isn't a target: Chalice of the Void's `StackEntryManaValueEqualsSourceCountersPredicate(CHARGE)` (the counters as the spell is cast) and Void Mirror's `StackEntryNotPredicate(StackEntryColoredManaSpentPredicate)` are the stack-entry filters, and Cephalid Shrine's `UnlessPaysEffect.counterUnlessPays(CardsInGraveyard(CardSharesNameWithTriggeringSpellPredicate, ANY_PLAYER))` reads the spell's name as it resolves.


`RevealTopCardAndCounterTriggeringSpellIfMatchesEffect(RevealedCardMatch match, boolean spellControllerMayCastFree)` is a `Triggers.opponentCastsSpell()` resolved effect, wrapped in `MayEffect` for the optional reveal. It reveals the source controller's top library card, leaves it on top, and counters the spell that caused the trigger when the two match: `RevealedCardMatch.SAME_MANA_VALUE` compares mana values, X included (Counterbalance: `(SAME_MANA_VALUE, false)`); `SHARES_CARD_TYPE` checks for a shared card type (Swindler's Scheme on `.castFrom(Zone.HAND)`: `(SHARES_CARD_TYPE, true)`). With `spellControllerMayCastFree`, a match also offers the triggering spell's controller a free cast of the revealed nonland card from that library; declined, the card stays on top. The ability doesn't target the spell (the spell is its entry's triggering card), so it still resolves after the spell was countered in response (CR 608.2b); only the counter is skipped then, and the match reads the spell's last known information.

Otherwise counter target spell (or ability), or with several targets chosen for its group ("counter up to N target spells", Double Negative, Katara's Reversal) each of them, recorded as one COUNTER_SPELL step; `destination` (default `GRAVEYARD`) sends the countered card to `EXILE` (Dissipate, Faerie Trickery) or `LIBRARY_TOP` (Memory Lapse) instead. Copies and countered abilities cease to exist regardless. |

Pair with `setEnchantPlayer(true)` since it's a non-Curse "Enchant player" aura. Used by Wheel of Sun and Moon |
| `ExileOwnCardsInsteadOfGraveyardEffect` | `(boolean appliesToTokens)`, convenience `()` = cards only | static replacement effect: if a card (or, with `appliesToTokens`, a token) would be put into the controller's own graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead (CR 614.1). Hades, Sorcerer of Eld uses `(true)`. Controller-side counterpart of `ExileOpponentCardsInsteadOfGraveyardEffect`. Implements `OwnGraveyardExileReplacement`. Checked in GraveyardService.addCardToGraveyard(). Used by Forbidden Crypt |
| `ExileOwnCyclingCardsUnlessCycledEffect` | `()` | static replacement: if a card with cycling would be put into your graveyard from anywhere and it wasn't cycled, exile it instead. Implements `OwnGraveyardExileReplacement` (filter=`CardHasCyclingPredicate`, `exemptWhenCycled`, tokens exempt). Cycling discard sets `GameData.cardEnteringGraveyardByCycling`. Used by Abandoned Sarcophagus |
| `CastSurveilledCardsFromGraveyardByPayingLifeEffect` | `()` | static: you may play lands and cast cards surveilled this turn from your graveyard; spells use life equal to mana value instead of their mana cost. Implements both graveyard-cast and graveyard-land permissions; used by Eye of Duskmantle |
| `GrantEscapeToGraveyardCardsEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter)` | static: matching nonland cards in your graveyard may be cast for their normal mana costs by exiling three other graveyard cards. Implements `CastSpellsFromGraveyardPermission`. Used by Underworld Breach |
| `GrantEscapeToGraveyardCardsEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter[, String alternateManaCost, int additionalGraveyardExileCount])` | static or temporary player-scoped permission: matching graveyard cards may be cast with escape, optionally using an alternate mana cost, by exiling the configured number of other graveyard cards. Used by Rivaz of the Claw, Mischievous Lookout, Serra Paragon, and Edgar, Master Machinist |

Nissa's Chosen (`onBottom`), Saiba Syphoner (`shuffledIn`). Only applies when sourceZone is BATTLEFIELD (i.e. "die"). The optional form is offered to the affected permanent's controller, including when granted to Slivers by Pulmonic Sliver (`TSP`). Checked in `GraveyardService.discardCard()` (the choke point all discard sites route through), never for a discard paid as a cost (cast and activation costs pass `applyDiscardToLibraryReplacement=false`; resolution-time ransoms and a `DiscardEffect` whose result a later "if [they] do / can't" reads, `HappenedThisWay.discarded()` (CR 118.12), set `GameData.discardPaidAsCost`; Library of Leng's ruling). X comes from the stack entry's X value; the spell is removed from the stack **without being countered**, so "can't be countered" does not protect it. The card gets X delay counters (`GameData.exiledCardCounters` (DELAY)), and the resolution creates a `TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.atEveryStep` (`upkeep(CHOSEN_PLAYER)`, the spell's controller as its watched player; intervening-if and `lastsWhile` `CardsStillInZone(EXILE, …)`) whose effect keeps a snapshot of the target's `StackEntry`, so the spell keeps its X value and targets. A copy of a spell ceases to exist instead of being exiled |
| `RemoveDelayCounterFromExiledSpellEffect` | `(UUID cardId, StackEntry originalEntry)` | delayed triggered ability effect: "remove a delay counter from [exiled card]. If the card has no delay counters on it, the player puts it onto the stack." The effect of the upkeep delayed ability `ExileTargetSpellWithDelayCountersEffect` creates, triggering in the exiled spell's *controller's* upkeeps. Intervening-if: does nothing if the card left exile, and the ability ends then. On the last counter the card leaves exile and the snapshot stack entry is re-added — the spell is **put onto the stack, not cast**, so cast triggers do not fire. Used by Ertai's Meddling |
| `CantBeCounteredEffect` | `()`; `(Condition condition)` | this spell can't be countered (static). Replaces `setCantBeCountered(true)`. The continuation accumulates counters and haste, then resumes the prepared entry before ETB triggers are collected. |

"Spells can't be countered" (Lier), "creature spells can't be countered" (Gaea's Herald, Leyline of Lifeforce), "Sliver spells can't be countered" (Root Sliver), "creature spells you control with power 5 or greater" (Spellbreaker Behemoth). Read by `GameQueryService.areCreatureETBTriggersSuppressed` / `areArtifactOrCreatureETBTriggersSuppressed` / `areCreatureDeathTriggersSuppressed` / `areOpponentPermanentETBTriggersSuppressed`; a face-down or ability-less source suppresses nothing |

Each copy adds one extra trigger. |

By default it matches permanents controlled by the triggering ability's controller and excludes the static source; the extended form can include the source itself and evaluate attached-permanent predicates across all controllers (Cloud, Midgar Mercenary). |

## Bounce / return to hand

| `ReturnTargetPermanentsWithinTotalManaValueEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, int maxTotalManaValue)` or `withinTotalManaValue(filter, maxTotalManaValue)` | return any number of target permanents matching `filter` to their owners' hands when their combined mana value is at most the configured limit; selection and resolution both enforce the aggregate limit |
| `DestroyTargetPermanentsWithinTotalManaValueEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, DynamicAmount totalManaValueLimit)` or `withinTotalManaValue(filter, totalManaValueLimit)` | destroy any number of target permanents matching `filter` when their combined mana value is at most the evaluated limit; selection and resolution both enforce the aggregate limit. Used by Rampaging Yao Guai (PIP 82) |
| `ReturnTargetPermanentsThenEffect` | `countingCardsReturnedToYourHand(CardEffect thenEffect)` | Paradoxical Outcome only: bounce the targets, then the rider with the number of cards (a melded permanent's components each) returned to the controller's own hand. Anything else is `ReturnToHandEffect.target()` then a step reading RETURN: "If you do" / "if a permanent was returned this way" `ConditionalEffect(HappenedThisWay.returned(), X)`, "for each permanent returned this way" `AmountThisWay(StepKind.RETURN)`, "its mana value" `TargetManaValue` |

| `DelayedEndOfCombatEffect` | `(CardEffect effect)` | schedules the wrapped non-targeting ability to trigger at the beginning of the end-of-combat step. The delayed trigger preserves the source card and controller even if the source permanent leaves the battlefield. The scheduling ability's non-targeting permanent ("that creature", the creature on the other side of a block) is the delayed ability's non-targeting target, with what was attached to it just before it left the battlefield if it has (CR 608.2h). Use Triggers.attacks() / Triggers.blocks() for delayed instructions such as Fickle Efreet's end-of-combat coin flip, or Corrosive Ooze's `new DelayedEndOfCombatEffect(new DestroyAttachmentsOnTargetCreatureEffect(false, true))` |

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ReturnToHandEffect` | static factories, or `(PermanentSubject subject)` | bounce the permanents the `PermanentSubject` names to their owners' hands (`SubjectResolutionService`; a target or `triggering()` one at a time with the controller rider, `source()` as itself, every other subject as one simultaneous leave batch); `withSubject` / `withFilter` copy it. Factories: `target()` (bounce the chosen target); `targetWithCastTimeXValue(DynamicAmount)` (targeted bounce whose X-scaled target cap is evaluated from game state as the spell is cast — Aether Burst); `targetAndControllerLosesLife(int)` (Vapor Snag — controller, snapshotted before the bounce, loses N); `targetAndControllerDraws(int)` (Call to Heel — controller, snapshotted before the bounce, draws N); `self()` (bounce the source; declares source-self targeting so the triggered ability's entry keeps the source id); `allPermanentsMatching(PermanentPredicate filter)` (every permanent matching `filter` across all battlefields, null = every permanent — Evacuation uses `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate`); `permanentsTargetPlayerControls(filter)` (River's Rebuke — `controlledBy(targetPlayer(), filter)`; makes the spec player-targeting); `permanentsTargetPlayerOwns(filter)` (Hurkyl's Recall — `ownedBy(targetPlayer(), filter)`, the card's owner whoever controls it; makes the spec player-targeting); `aurasAttachedToTarget()` (Scarab of the Unseen — `attachmentsOf(target(), Aura)`); `enchanted()` (bounce the permanent the source Aura is attached to — Sun Clasp; non-targeting; subject `attached()`, whose last-known lookup still finds the host of a self-sacrificing Aura — Phantom Wings); `enchantedAndAuras()` (`allOf(attachmentsOf(attached(), Aura), attached())`: the source Aura's enchanted permanent and all Auras attached to it, the Auras first — Mark of Eviction); `grantingEquipment()` (`granter()`, bound at activation by `ActivatedAbilityExecutionService` — Trusty Boomerang); `triggering()`; `targetAndSelf()`; `targetCreaturesOfChosenType()`; `targetNonlandPermanentOrSuspendedCard()`; `selfSpell()` (no subject) |
| `ReturnTargetPermanentToHandAndReduceControllerSpeedEffect` | `()` | returns the target permanent to its owner's hand, then reduces its controller's speed by one only when that speed is greater than every other player's speed, never below 1. The handler snapshots the controller before the bounce. Used by Spikeshell Harrier. |
| `ReturnCreaturesBlockingOrBlockedByTargetEffect` | `()` | returns every creature blocking or blocked by the targeted creature to its owner's hand, excluding the target itself. |
| `ReturnToHandEffect.targetCreatureAndAttached` | `(PermanentPredicate attachedFilter)` | bounce target creature and every attached permanent matching `attachedFilter` to their owners' hands as one simultaneous event (leave abilities look back, CR 603.10a). Hubris (Aura), Word of Undoing `AllOf(Aura subtype, ColorIn(WHITE), OwnedBySourceController)`. `RemovalEffect` BOUNCE |
| `ReturnPermanentControlledByPlayerToHandEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String noun[, boolean controllerChooses])` / `controller(filter, noun)` / `byPlayer(PlayerSubject player, filter, noun)` (that player chooses and returns: "choose a player. They return a creature they control", Multiple Choice) / `choosingOneOf(PermanentSubject candidates, String noun)` | a player returns a permanent they control matching `filter` to its owner's hand. The acting player is the entry's `targetId` if set, else the resolving controller. On `Triggers.dealsDamageToPlayer()`, the damaged player is the entry's non-targeting `targetId`, recorded as the ability triggers; `controllerChooses=true` makes the trigger controller choose the permanent (Sigil of Sleep). On a filtered cast trigger (`Triggers.playerCastsSpell().anySpell()`) the caster is recorded as the entry's non-targeting `targetId` (Mana Breach, `PermanentIsLandPredicate`); wrap in `MayEffect` on a controller ability for "you may return a land you control" (Kefnet the Mindful); `Triggers.attacks()` for "return another creature you control" (Havengul Skaab, `AllOf(IsCreature, Not(IsSourceCard))`). Resolver collects that player's matching permanents and prompts via the shared `BounceCreature` choice context (`noun` fills the prompt; none matching ? nothing). A RETURN step that ends on the choice: "If you do" is `ConditionalEffect(HappenedThisWay.returned(), X)` after it (wrap both in `MayEffect` for "you may return"), "if another Desert was returned this way" `HappenedThisWay.toA(StepKind.RETURN, filter)` (Arid Archway); `controller(filter, noun)` for "you return"; `choosingOneOf(Subjects.triggeringAll(), noun)` for "return one of them" (Kaito, Dancing Shadow), `choosingOneOf(Subjects.ownedBy(Subjects.you(), filter), noun)` for "a permanent you own" (Phenomenon Investigators) |
| `ReturnPermanentSharingTypeWithEnteringPermanentToHandEffect` | `()` | non-targeting enter-trigger choice: returns another permanent controlled by the ability's controller that shares an effective permanent type with the entering permanent; excludes the entering permanent and uses its printed permanent types as a fallback if it left the battlefield. Used by Cloudstone Curio |
| `ReturnThisSpellToHandThenDiscardAtRandomEffect` | `()` | return this spell to its owner's hand, then discard a card at random (Hanabi Blast); the spell itself is a discard candidate |
| `ReturnPermanentsOnCombatDamageToPlayerEffect` | `()` | "whenever this deals combat damage to a player, return up to that many target permanents that player controls" (Cephalid Constable): targets chosen as it is put on the stack, returned together. "Return target creature that player controls" is `ReturnToHandEffect.target(filter with PermanentControlledByTriggeringPlayerPredicate)` (Mistblade Shinobi) |
| `ReturnChosenPermanentsToHandEffect` | `.exactly(count, subject, label)`, `.upTo(n, subject, label)`, `.anyNumber(subject, label)`; `.announced()` | "return two creatures you control / up to two lands you control / any number of Plains you control / half the creatures they control": chosen among the subject's permanents as it resolves, returned together, a RETURN step (`AmountThisWay(RETURN)`, `AmountThisWay(RETURN, POWER)`, `cardsThisWay(RETURN)` for perpetual riders) |

| `ExileTargetPermanentUntilSourceLeavesEffect` on a damage trigger | `()` | "whenever a creature deals combat damage to you, if this entered this turn, exile that creature until this leaves the battlefield" is `Triggers.creatureDealsCombatDamageToYou()`, `TriggerOptions.DEFAULT.withInterveningIf(new SourceEnteredThisTurn())`, `ExileTargetPermanentUntilSourceLeavesEffect()`: the damaging creature is the entry's `targetId` (`nonTargeting`) and its triggering permanent; the ability goes through the stack door, so "triggers an additional time" applies; the intervening "if" is judged as the ability triggers and again as it resolves (Hixus, Prison Warden) |
| "Whenever equipped creature deals damage to a creature, tap that creature. It doesn't untap for as long as this remains on the battlefield" | — | write `Triggers.dealsDamageToCreature()` (this creature), `equippedCreatureDealsDamageToCreature()`, `creatureYouControlDealsDamageToCreature()` or `creatureDealsDamageToCreature()` (any controller's), with `.withFilter(dealer)`, `.withDamagedFilter(damaged creature)` and `.withCombatDamageOnly()` + `TapPermanentsEffect(Subjects.triggering())` + `DoesntUntapEffect.triggeringWhileSourceOnBattlefield()` (Neko-Te) |
| `PutTargetOnBottomOfLibraryEffect` | `()` | put target permanent on bottom of owner's library |
| `PutTargetOnTopOfLibraryEffect` | `()` / `(PutOnTopOfLibraryScope scope)` | put a permanent on top of its owner's library. `TARGET` (default, `benign(PERMANENT)`), `SELF` (source permanent, no target � `PutTargetOnTopOfLibraryEffect.self()`, Soaring Hope), or `SELF_AND_TARGET` (`benign(CREATURE)`) which tucks BOTH the target creature and the source and then shuffles each affected owner's library � "Put this creature and target creature on top of their owners' libraries, then those players shuffle their libraries" (Void Stalker). Targeting the source itself with `SELF_AND_TARGET` simply tucks it once |
| `PutTargetCreatureOnTopOrOptionalBottomOfLibraryEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate bottomOptionCondition)` | put target creature on top of its owner's library, but if it matches `bottomOptionCondition` the controller **may** put it on the bottom instead (exclusive destinations � declining leaves it on top). `normalfx` handler moves it to the top outright when the condition fails, otherwise queues a `PendingMayAbility` carrying the target permanent id; `mayfx/PutTargetCreatureOnLibraryBottomInsteadHandler` sends it to the bottom on accept and delegates back to the top placement on decline. Spec `benign(CREATURE)`. Ether Well uses `PermanentColorInPredicate(Set.of(RED))` |
| `PutTargetSpellOrCreatureOnTopOrBottomOfLibraryEffect` | `()` | put target spell or creature on top of its owner's library, then the target's owner chooses whether it stays on top or moves to the bottom. Spec `benign(CREATURE or SPELL)`. The resolution-time choice uses the target owner's dedicated library-destination interaction |
| `PutControlledCreatureOnTopOfLibraryEffect` | `()` | "put a creature you control on top of its owner's library" (Nulltread Gargantuan ETB). **Non-targeted** � resolved as a mandatory choice at resolution time (no card `target(...)` filter, `targetSpec()` stays `NONE`). The source is a legal choice, and forced when it's the only creature you control. Resolves automatically when there is one candidate; otherwise prompts `PermanentChoiceContext.PutControlledCreatureOnTopOfLibrary` (completed in `PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService`). Contrast `PutTargetOnTopOfLibraryEffect` (a real cast-time target) |
| `PutTargetPermanentIntoLibraryNFromTopEffect` | `(DynamicAmount position)` / `(int position)` | put target permanent into its owner's library at the evaluated position N from the top (0-indexed: 0=top, 1=second, 2=third). The `int` overload supports fixed positions; Quarry Colossus uses a controller-scoped Plains count Also `self(n)` / `(Subjects.source(), n)` (this permanent) and `(Subjects.attached(), n)` (enchanted creature, Shattered Ego). |
| `PutTargetCardFromGraveyardOnTopOrBottomOfLibraryEffect` | `()` / `(Destination)` | target any card in any graveyard; the spell controller chooses whether to put it on top or bottom of its owner's library during resolution |
| `PutTargetSpellOrPermanentOrGraveyardCardOnTopOrBottomOfLibraryEffect` | `()` / `(Destination)` | target a spell, nonland permanent, or card in a graveyard; that target's owner chooses whether it goes on top or bottom of their library during resolution. Used by Endless Detour (`SNC`) |
| `PutTargetPermanentIntoLibraryNFromTopThenEffect` | `(DynamicAmount position, CardEffect thenEffect, ThenEffectRecipient recipient)` / `(int position, CardEffect thenEffect, ThenEffectRecipient recipient)` | put target permanent into its owner's library at the evaluated position, then resolve an existing follow-up effect using the target's controller/owner snapshot; Oust uses `(1, GainLifeEffect(3), TARGET_CONTROLLER)` |
| `PutTargetSpellOrPermanentOnTopOrBottomOfLibraryEffect` | `()` / `(Destination)` | target red or green spell or permanent; its owner chooses whether it goes on top or bottom of its owner's library during resolution. Used by Aether Gust |
| `PutTargetSpellOrPermanentIntoLibraryNFromTopEffect` | `(int position)` | put target **spell or nonland permanent** into its owner's library at position N from the top (0-indexed). Spec `benign(PERMANENT, nonland)` + spell capability via `EffectResolution.targetsSpellOnStack` (like Glamerdye). Spell removal is **not** countering � works vs can't-be-countered. Used by Commit (position=1, "second from the top") |
| `PutSourceCardFromGraveyardIntoLibraryNFromTopEffect` | `(int position)` | death trigger: put the dying source card from its owner's graveyard into its owner's library at position N from the top (0-indexed: 0=top, 1=second, 2=third; clamped to bottom if the library is shorter). Graveyard-source analogue of `PutTargetPermanentIntoLibraryNFromTopEffect`. Used by Undying Beast (`position=0`) and Enigma Sphinx (`position=2`, "third from the top") |
| `PutSourceCardFromExileIntoLibraryNFromTopEffect` | `(int position)` | exile trigger: put the source card from its owner's exile zone into its owner's library at position N from the top (0-indexed; clamped to bottom if the library is shorter). Used by God-Eternal Oketra (`position=2`, "third from the top") |
| `PutTimeCountersAndGainSuspendEffect` | `(CardSubject cards, int timeCounters)` / `.onCardsExiledThisWay(int)` | "exile it with N time counters on it. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend": each named card in exile (not a token) gets the time counters and is suspended (CR 702.62b). The step after an exile step: `ExileTargetPermanentEffect` (Suspend), `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect.cards(Subjects.sourceCard())` (Epochrasite), `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect.oneTargetFromControllerGraveyard(nonland)` (Doom's Time Platform) `equalToManaValueOnCardsExiledThisWay()`: as many as each card's mana value. |
| `PutTimeCountersOnTargetExiledCardWithSuspendEffect` | `(int amount)` | activated-ability effect: target a nonland card exiled from your graveyard this turn, put the specified time counters on it, and enable the normal suspend upkeep/free-cast flow. Used by Soovril, Patient Antiquarian (`YSOS` 27) |
| `ExileTopCardsAndSuspendNonlandsWithManaValueEffect` | `(int count)` | exile the top `count` cards and register each exiled nonland with suspend time counters equal to its mana value. The Parting of the Ways |
| `ExileTriggeringCreatureWithHitCounterEffect` | `()` | opponent-creature-death trigger capability: exile the specific creature card that caused the trigger from its owner's graveyard and add a hit-counter marker. Used by Mari, the Killing Quill |
| `HauntEffect` | `()` | targeted death trigger: exile the dying source card from its owner's graveyard and record the targeted creature as haunted. When that permanent is put into a graveyard, the haunted card's `Triggers.dies(HAUNTED)` effects are collected. Used by Absolver Thrull (`Triggers.dies(THIS)`) and, on an instant or sorcery, Cry of Contrition (`Triggers.putIntoGraveyardWhileResolving(THIS)`, CR 702.55a) |
| `ReturnTopCreatureCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(PlayerSubject graveyardOwner, boolean assignNoCombatDamageIfReturned)` | put the top creature card of a graveyard onto the battlefield **under the effect controller's control**. `graveyardOwner` = `you()` (your own) or `defendingPlayer()` (Bone Dancer); it may not declare a target. "Top creature card" = the creature card closest to the top (the most recently put there); noncreature cards sitting above it are skipped, not blockers. Non-targeting, no-op with no creature card in the graveyard. `assignNoCombatDamageIfReturned` adds the stack entry's `sourcePermanentId` to a floating prevention effect **only when a card was actually returned** — the "if you do" half of Bone Dancer, which a `SequenceEffect` with `AssignNoCombatDamageEffect` would get wrong on an empty graveyard. Mistmoon Griffin uses `(you(), false)` as the second step of `SequenceEffect.of(ExileGraveyardCardsEffect.cards(Subjects.sourceCard()), it)` on `Triggers.dies(THIS)` — one trigger, and the Griffin must leave the graveyard first or it would be its own top creature card; Bone Dancer uses `MayEffect(new …(defendingPlayer(), true))` on `Triggers.attacksUnblocked()` |
| `UnlessPaysEffect.forEach` | `(PermanentSubject objects, PlayerSubject payer, CostEffect ransom, Function<PermanentSubject, CardEffect> effect)` | "For each [object], [do X to] it unless [P] pays": the objects found once, asked about one at a time in their payers' APNAP order; the payer `controllerOf(objects)` / `ownerOf(objects)` is read for each object, any other subject asks every player it names ("any player", each even after another paid); payments made as answered; after the last answer the unpaid objects are the `CHOOSE` step and `effect.apply(thisWay(CHOOSE))` resolves once (one destroy / return event, CR 608.2c, 101.4); an object that left is skipped. Cut the Tethers, Cleansing, Giant Albatross |
| `UnlessPaysEffect.forEachCard` | `(CardSubject cards, PlayerSubject payer, CostEffect ransom, Function<CardSubject, CardEffect> effect)` | "For each [card], [do X to] that card unless [P] pays": `forEach` over cards (revealed ones: the question names each card); every player the payer names is asked about each card in the subject's order, even after another paid; a card that left the zone it was found in is skipped (CR 400.7); after the last answer the unpaid cards are the `CHOOSE` step where they are and `effect.apply(cardsThisWay(CHOOSE))` resolves once (CR 608.2c). Sirocco (`RevealCardsFromHandEffect.hand(targetPlayer())` + `forEachCard(revealedThisWay(blue instant), targetPlayerDeclaredElsewhere(), new PayLifeCost(4), DiscardCardsEffect::new)`), Sword-Point Diplomacy (`RevealTopCardOfLibraryEffect.topCards(you(), 3)` + `forEachCard(revealedThisWay(), eachOpponent(), new PayLifeCost(3), PutCardsIntoHandEffect::new)` + `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect.cards(revealedThisWay())`) |

## Graveyard return

- `DefendingPlayerChoosesCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect.withoutRiders(CardPredicate)` — defending-player graveyard choice with no additional subtype or counter rider; the one-argument form remains the Drana variant

- `ReturnTargetPermanentFromOpponentGraveyardToHandThenDefendingPlayerChoosesPermanentFromGraveyardEffect(CardPredicate)` — combat-damage trigger: return the targeted permanent card from the damaged player's graveyard to its owner's hand; only if it returns, that player chooses a permanent card from the controller's graveyard to put onto the battlefield under the controller's control


- `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(CardPredicate, int, CounterType, int)` — fixed-cap targeted reanimation with a counter rider applied to each permanent that enters.
- `ReturnTargetCreatureAndSameNameCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect()` — targets a creature card in the controller's graveyard, then returns it and every other card with the same name to the battlefield tapped. Reuses the targeted graveyard-return batch handler for simultaneous entry.
- `ReturnTargetCreatureAndSameNameCardsFromGraveyardToHandEffect()` — targets a creature card in the controller's graveyard, then returns it and every other same-name card from that graveyard to the controller's hand. Only the creature card is targeted. Used by Echoing Return.

Second Sunrise uses `EachPlayerReturnsCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(Integer.MAX_VALUE, filter, true)` with a `CardAnyOfPredicate` for artifact, creature, enchantment, and land cards, so each player returns only those qualifying cards put into their graveyard from the battlefield this turn.

### Unified effect: `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect`

| `ExperienceCountersEffect` | `(int amount)` | adds experience counters to the resolving controller |
| `CoolnessEffect` | `(int amount)` | adds percentage points to the resolving controller's persistent coolness total. Used by Rainbow Dash |
| `ResetCoolnessEffect` | `()` | resets the resolving controller's persistent coolness total to 0%. Used by Rainbow Dash |

All graveyard-to-hand and graveyard-to-battlefield return effects are handled by a single unified record.

**Builder pattern:**
```
ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder()
    .destination(GraveyardChoiceDestination)   // HAND, BATTLEFIELD, or TOP_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY (required)
    .filter(CardPredicate)                     // which cards qualify (default: null = any)
    .sourceChosenSubtype(boolean)               // true = match cards of the source permanent's chosen subtype (default: false)
    .source(GraveyardSearchScope)              // default: CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD � omit unless ALL_GRAVEYARDS or OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD
    .targetGraveyard(boolean)                  // true = player chooses whose graveyard to search at cast time (default: false)
    .returnAll(boolean)                        // true = return all matching cards, false = choose one (default: false)
    .eventCardIdsOnly(boolean)                 // true = only the cards a preceding event on this stack entry recorded, else the entry's triggering cards ("one of them")
    .thisTurnOnly(boolean)                     // true = only CREATURE cards put there from battlefield this turn (default: false)
    .fromBattlefieldThisTurn(boolean)          // true = ALL cards (any type) put there from battlefield this turn (default: false; Twilight Shepherd, Faith's Reward)
    .fromAnywhereThisTurn(boolean)             // true = only cards put there from any zone this turn (default: false)
    .discardedOrCycledThisTurn(boolean)        // true = only cards the controller cycled or discarded this turn (default: false; Shadow of the Grave)
    .discardedByOpponentThisTurn(boolean)      // true = only cards discarded because of an opponent's spell or ability (default: false; Pure Intentions)
    .targetPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurn(boolean) // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must have come from the battlefield this turn
                                               //   card put into that graveyard from the battlefield this turn
                                               //   (default: false; Grim Return). Pairs with targetGraveyard(true);
                                               //   reads creatureCardsPutIntoGraveyardFromBattlefieldThisTurn
    .targetPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereThisTurn(boolean)    // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must have been put
                                               //   into a graveyard from anywhere this turn (default: false;
                                               //   Night Nurse, Healer of Heroes). Pairs with targetGraveyard(true);
                                               //   reads cardsPutIntoGraveyardFromAnywhereThisTurn
    .targetPutIntoGraveyardFromLibraryThisTurn(boolean)      // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must have been put
                                               //   into a graveyard from a library this turn (default: false;
                                               //   Captain N'ghathrod). Pairs with targetGraveyard(true);
                                               //   reads cardsPutIntoGraveyardFromLibraryThisTurn
    .targetDiscardedOrPutIntoGraveyardFromLibraryThisTurn(boolean) // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must have
                                               //   been discarded or put into a graveyard from a library this turn
                                               //   (default: false; Ghost of Ramirez DePietro). Pairs with
                                               //   targetGraveyard(true)
    .targetNotPutIntoGraveyardThisCombat(boolean) // true = the TARGETED graveyard card must not have been put
                                                  //   into a graveyard during the current combat phase
                                                  //   (default: false; Storrev, Devkarin Lich)
    .attachmentTarget(PermanentPredicate)      // non-null = aura attaches to matching permanent on ETB (default: null)
    .chooseAuraAttachment(boolean)              // true = a returned Aura's controller chooses any legal
                                               //   permanent or player for it to enchant as it enters
    .gainLifeEqualToManaValue(boolean)         // true = controller gains life equal to returned card's mana value (default: false)
    .loseLifeEqualToManaValue(boolean)         // true = controller loses life equal to returned card's mana value (default: false);
                                               //   pre-targeted path only (Reanimate); life loss via LifeSupport, so triggers fire
    .attachToSource(boolean)                   // true = attach the returned card to the source permanent (default: false).
                                               //   search-and-choose path: optional "you may attach" prompt after ETB (Auriok Survivors)
                                               //   pre-targeted BATTLEFIELD path: mandatory, prompt-free � the Aura enters already
                                               //   attached; fizzles if the source is gone or the Aura can't enchant it (Hakim, Loreweaver)
    .grantHaste(boolean)                       // true = grant haste to the returned permanent (default: false)
    .grantKeywords(Set<Keyword>)                // non-empty = grant these keywords indefinitely to the returned permanent
    .battlefieldEffectGrants(List<CardEffect>)  // static effects continuously granted to each returned battlefield permanent;
                                               // a loses-all-abilities grant is applied before entry as well
    .perpetuallySetBasePowerToSourcePower(boolean) // true = perpetually set each returned battlefield card's base power
                                               // to the resolving source permanent's effective power (Forgefire Automaton)
    .battlefieldEffectGrantDuration(Duration) // duration of those grants; defaults to PERMANENT
    .sacrificeAtEndStep(boolean)               // true = sacrifice the returned permanent at the next end step
    .exileAtEndStep(boolean)                   // true = exile at the next end step (default: false). Unearth's extra
    .exileAtYourNextEndStep(boolean)            // true = exile at the returned permanent controller's next end step
                                               //   "exile it instead if it would leave the battlefield" clause is the
                                               //   separate .exileIfLeavesBattlefield(true) � pair the two for Unearth /
                                               //   Postmortem Lunge; Shallow Grave uses exileAtEndStep alone
    .topmost(boolean)                          // true = return the topmost matching card of the controller's ordered
                                               //   graveyard with no prompt at all (default: false); Shallow Grave
    .requiresManaValueEqualsX(boolean)         // true = restrict to cards with MV = X (default: false); X is the spell's or ability's own X (CR 107.3), never a trigger event's value: for "equal to the damage dealt / that spell's mana value" put CardManaValueEqualsEventValuePredicate in the filter
    .manaValueXOffset(int)                     // offset added to X for an exact/at-most MV restriction (default: 0)
    .requiresManaValueAtMostX(boolean)         // true = restrict to cards with MV ? X (default: false); e.g. Profane Command
    .dynamicMaxManaValue(DynamicAmount)        // mana value limit; a triggered ability's "X or less, where X is the damage dealt" is new EventValue() and "lesser mana value" than the sacrificed creature new Sum(new TriggeringCardManaValue(), new Fixed(-1)), read from the trigger record as the target is chosen and from the entry as it resolves; a death trigger's is evaluated as its target is chosen, with the dying object as it last existed as the amount's source (soulshift X, "lesser mana value"), and kept on the stack entry
    .maxManaValueEqualsLifeGainedThisTurn(boolean) // true = restrict to cards with MV <= life gained this turn (default: false); e.g. Moseo
    .maxManaValueEqualsLifeLostThisTurn(boolean) // true = restrict to cards with MV <= life lost this turn (default: false); e.g. Betor
    .grantColor(CardColor)                     // non-null = permanently grant this color "in addition to" (default: null)
    .grantSubtype(CardSubtype)                 // non-null = permanently grant this subtype "in addition to" (default: null)
    .enterWithCounters(Set<CounterType>)       // one counter of each listed type is placed on the returned permanent as it enters
    .enterTapped(boolean)                      // true = enters the battlefield tapped (default: false)
    .underOwnersControl(boolean)               // true = put each card onto battlefield under its owner's control (default: false)
    .returnAtRandom(boolean)                   // true = return a random matching card instead of player choice (default: false)
    .battlefieldIfCreatureElseHand(boolean)    // true = route each returned card by type — creature cards to the battlefield,
                                               //   everything else to hand (default: false); returnAtRandom path only, overrides
                                               //   destination (Deadbridge Chant)
    .battlefieldIfCreatureElseExile(boolean)   // true = route each randomly selected card by type — creature cards to the
                                               //   battlefield, everything else to exile (default: false); returnAtRandom path only
    .shuffleGraveyardBeforeRandomSelection(boolean) // true = randomly reorder the controller's graveyard before the random selection
                                               //   (default: false); returnAtRandom path only (Search for Survivors)
    .choosePermanentType(boolean)              // true = prompt controller to choose a permanent type at resolution, then return all matching (default: false); implies returnAll
    .exileSourceFromGraveyard(boolean)         // true = exile the source card from graveyard before selecting random cards (default: false); e.g. Moldgraf Monstrosity
    .grantSourceHasteIfSubtype(CardSubtype)    // non-null = source permanent gains haste until end of turn if the returned card has this subtype (default: null); HAND search-and-choose only; e.g. Warren Pilferers (Goblin)
    .greatestPower(boolean)                    // true = restrict the (mandatory) controller's-graveyard search-and-choose to the matching card(s) with greatest power; single card auto-forced, ties chosen and cannot be declined (default: false); e.g. Desecrator Hag
    .exileIfLeavesBattlefield(boolean)         // true = set exile-if-leaves replacement on the returned permanent (default: false); Dreams of the Dead, Unearth
    .exileIfDying(boolean)                      // true = set "if this creature would die, exile it instead" on the returned permanent (default: false); Can't Stay Away
    .grantCumulativeUpkeepCost(String)         // non-null = grant that Cumulative upkeep cost as a persistent Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU) ability (default: null); Dreams of the Dead "{2}"
    .plusOneCountersIfExiledCostCardHasSubtype(CardSubtype) // condition keyed to the exiled additional-cost card snapshot
    .counterIfExiledCostCardHasSubtype(CounterType) // counter type placed when that subtype condition matches
    .counterCountIfExiledCostCardHasSubtype(int) // number of those counters to place
    .plusOneCountersIfCardType(CardType)       // non-null = only add the plusOneCounterCount counters when the returned permanent currently has this card type
    .linkToSource(boolean)                     // true = bond the reanimated permanent to the source permanent's chosenPermanentId (default: false); pre-targeted BATTLEFIELD path only; pair with RemoveLinkedPermanentEffect triggers; Coffin Queen
    .grantOnDeathEffect(CardEffect)            // non-null = add this persistent Triggers.dies(THIS) ability to each returned battlefield permanent; owner-dependent TargetPlayerLosesGameEffect(null) is bound to the returned card's graveyard owner
    .build()
```

Only `destination` is required. All booleans default to `false`, all object references default to `null`, and `source` defaults to `CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD`. Only set fields that differ from defaults.

Use `manaValueXOffset` when the mana-value restriction is derived from X, such as a target with mana value X plus one after a sacrificed creature's mana value is tracked, or a target with mana value less than X (`requiresManaValueAtMostX(true)` with offset `-1`).

On the pre-targeted `BATTLEFIELD` path, a card reanimated out of a **different player's** graveyard is registered in `GameData.stolenCreatures` automatically (with the matching PERMANENT control effect), so it dies to its owner's graveyard rather than the reanimator's — no card-side flag needed.

**CardPredicate filter system** (in `model/filter/`):

| Predicate | Constructor | Matches |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `CardTypePredicate` | `(CardType cardType)` | cards of a given type (CREATURE, ARTIFACT, etc.) |
| `CardSubtypePredicate` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` | cards of a given subtype (ZOMBIE, GOBLIN, etc.) |
| `CardKeywordPredicate` | `(Keyword keyword)` | cards with a given keyword (INFECT, FLYING, etc.) |
| `CardIsSelfPredicate` | `()` | only the source card itself (Squee-style self-return) |
| `CardIsTriggeringCardPredicate` | `()` | the card the triggered ability's event was about ("it", "that card"); `CardNotPredicate` of it is "other" than the dying creature (Illicit Masquerade, Puca's Covenant), bound as the target is chosen |
| `CardIsAuraPredicate` | `()` | aura cards |
| `CardIsAuraEnchantCreaturePredicate` | `()` | Aura cards with enchant creature (read from the Aura's spell target filter) |
| `CardIsPermanentPredicate` | `()` | permanent cards (creature, artifact, enchantment, planeswalker, land, kindred � not instant/sorcery) |
| `CardMaxManaValuePredicate` | `(int maxManaValue)` | cards with mana value ? maxManaValue |
| `CardMinManaValuePredicate` | `(int minManaValue[, boolean includeXValue])` | cards with mana value ?A minManaValue; `includeXValue=true` includes the announced X value when evaluated for a spell being cast |
| `CardSupertypePredicate` | `(CardSupertype supertype)` | cards with a given supertype (BASIC, LEGENDARY) |
| `CardColorPredicate` | `(CardColor color)` | cards that ARE the colour � the colour is present among `getColors()` (multicolour-aware per CR 105.2c; a Black-Green card matches both `CardColorPredicate(BLACK)` and `CardColorPredicate(GREEN)`, order-independent). Used by "whenever a {colour} spell is cast" triggers and colour-filtered searches (Green Sun's Zenith) |
| `CardNotPredicate` | `(CardPredicate predicate)` | NOT � inverts a predicate |
| `CardAllOfPredicate` | `(List<CardPredicate> predicates)` | AND � all predicates must match |
| `CardAnyOfPredicate` | `(List<CardPredicate> predicates)` | OR � any predicate matches |

Pass `null` as filter to allow any card.

**GraveyardSearchScope enum** (in `model/`):

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD` | search only the controller's graveyard (default) |
| `ALL_GRAVEYARDS` | search any player's graveyard |
| `OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD` | search only opponent's graveyard |

**GraveyardChoiceDestination enum** (in `model/`):

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `HAND` | return chosen card(s) to hand |
| `BATTLEFIELD` | put chosen card(s) onto battlefield |
| `TOP_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY` | put card on top of its owner's library (e.g. Noxious Revival) |
| `BOTTOM_OF_OWNERS_LIBRARY` | put card on the bottom of its owner's library (e.g. Mistveil Plains) |

**Related graveyard-return records:**

| Effect | What it does |
|------------|----------------|
| `ReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandOfOpponentsChoiceEffect(CardPredicate)` | targeted controller-graveyard return to hand; the controller chooses which opponent makes the target choice, then the chosen opponent selects the matching card through the trigger-time graveyard targeting flow (Mausoleum Turnkey) |
| `ReturnTargetCreatureFromGraveyardToBattlefieldOrHandByManaValueEffect(DynamicAmount)` | target a creature card in the controller's graveyard; at resolution, return it to the battlefield when its mana value is at most the evaluated amount, otherwise to its owner's hand |
| `TargetOpponentChoosesCardFromGraveyardEffect(CardPredicate)` | target opponent chooses a matching card in their graveyard; put it onto the battlefield under the controller's control |
| `TargetOpponentChoosesCardFromGraveyardEffect(CardPredicate, List<CardEffect>)` | target opponent chooses a matching card in their graveyard; put it onto the battlefield under the controller's control and keep the listed effects on that permanent |
| `DefendingPlayerChoosesCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(CardPredicate)` | `Triggers.attacks()`: defending player chooses a matching card from the controller's graveyard; put it onto the controller's battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and an additional Vampire subtype |
| `ReturnTargetCreatureAndAurasOrEquipmentEffect()` | Resolves two controller-graveyard target groups in order: returns the target creature first, then returns up to two targeted Auras or Equipment attached to it. An Aura that cannot enchant the creature remains in the graveyard; an Equipment that cannot attach enters unattached. Used by Unfinished Business (FIC 259). |

**Rise to Glory:** Use `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD)
.filter(new CardIsAuraPredicate()).targetGraveyard(true).chooseAuraAttachment(true).build()` for
the targeted Aura mode. The returned Aura's controller chooses any legal permanent or player as
the Aura enters; if there is no legal object, the Aura remains in the graveyard.

**Common usage examples:**

| Card | Usage |

| Profane Command (reanimate mode) | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(CREATURE).targetGraveyard(true).requiresManaValueAtMostX(true).build()` � creature with MV ? X from your graveyard to battlefield; pair inside a choose-two modal with `{X}` |

Non-targeting and prompt-free: `topmost` walks the ordered graveyard from the top and returns the first matching card via the pre-targeted path (`GraveyardReturnSupport.resolveTopmostFromControllersGraveyard`), so all battlefield riders apply. No `exileIfLeavesBattlefield` � a creature that dies before the end step just goes to the graveyard |

End-step graveyard targeting reuses the `SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger` flow |
| Betor, Ancestor's Voice | `Triggers.endStep(ActivePlayer.YOU)` uses `PutCountersEffect(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, LifeGainedThisTurn(CONTROLLER))` on up to one other creature you control, plus `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(CREATURE).targetGraveyard(true).upTo(true).maxManaValueEqualsLifeLostThisTurn(true).build()` |

| Reassembling Skeleton | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).enterTapped(true).build()` � self-return to battlefield tapped (graveyard activated ability) |
| Warcry Phoenix | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).enterTapped(true).enterAttacking(true).build()` � self-return to battlefield tapped and attacking (graveyard attack trigger) |
| Fatestitcher (Unearth) | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardIsSelfPredicate()).returnAll(true).grantHaste(true).exileAtEndStep(true).exileIfLeavesBattlefield(true).build()` � Unearth self-return with haste, exiled at next end step or if it would leave the battlefield (graveyard activated ability with `SORCERY_SPEED` timing). Built by `Card.addUnearth(cost)`. `grantHaste`/`exileAtEndStep`/`exileIfLeavesBattlefield` are honored on the `returnAll` self-return path as well as the targeted path; the two exile flags are independent (Shallow Grave sets only `exileAtEndStep`) |
