| Warren Pilferers | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).grantSourceHasteIfSubtype(CardSubtype.GOBLIN).build()` in `Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)` � return a creature card from your graveyard; if it's a Goblin card, this creature gains haste until end of turn |
| Dawn-Blessed Pennant | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).sourceChosenSubtype(true).targetGraveyard(true).build()` � return target card of the source permanent's chosen subtype from your graveyard to your hand |

See `RecordReturnedGraveyardCardValueEffect` below |
| Morgue Burst | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(HAND).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).targetGraveyard(true).build()` + `RecordReturnedGraveyardCardValueEffect(POWER)` + `target(AnyTargetPredicateTargetFilter(...)).addSpellEffect(DealDamageEffect.toAnyTargetInGroup(new EventValue(), 0))` - same two-target shape, damage equal to the returned creature card's power |

Use inside `MayEffect` for optional suspect-and-clear text |
| `ReturnedPermanentReturnsTargetPermanentCardFromGraveyardEffect` | `()` | unbound targeted-reanimation rider; after the preceding return succeeds, snapshots the returned permanent's mana value and queues an optional target permanent-card return from the controller's graveyard with that mana-value cap. Used by Jailbreak |

| Kheru Lich Lord | `UnlessPaysEffect.youMayPay("{2}{B}", ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(CREATURE).returnAtRandom(true).grantKeywords(Set.of(FLYING, TRAMPLE, HASTE)).exileAtEndStep(true).exileIfLeavesBattlefield(true).build(), ...)` — upkeep payment returns a random creature with indefinite keyword grants and both exile riders |

### `RecordReturnedGraveyardCardValueEffect`

The `TOUGHNESS` value is used by Foul Renewal to feed the returned creature card's printed toughness into its target creature's temporary -X/-X effect.

Graveyard-return glue effect (`TargetSpec.NONE`), parameterized by `ReturnedGraveyardCardValue`: `NONLAND_MANA_VALUE` (Vengeful Rebirth) or `POWER` (Morgue Burst). Sets the entry's event value to that characteristic of the card on `entry.targetId` (a graveyard target, Yawgmoth's-Vile-Offering two-target shape: graveyard card on `targetId`/targetZone GRAVEYARD, any target on a `target(...)` group) **only when that nonland card was actually returned to the controller's hand** � the handler confirms the card is now in hand rather than reading its type in place, so a graveyard target that became illegal (exiled/removed in response, CR 608.2b) records 0 and deals no damage. A returned land also records 0.

Add it **UNBOUND**, right after the `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect`. `EffectResolutionService` remaps `entry.targetId` to a bound effect's target group for the duration of that effect (so `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect`-style bound effects read the group via `targetId`); leaving this effect unbound keeps `targetId` pointing at the graveyard card while it runs. Pair with a **bound** `DealDamageEffect.toAnyTargetInGroup(new EventValue(), 0)` on the any-target group � binding is what makes the position accept player targets (`Card.doesPositionAllowPlayerTargets`) and lets the AI classify it as harmful damage. `0` event value = no damage (`dealDamageToPlayer` no-ops on `<= 0`).

### "If it was a [type] card" after a return

`ConditionalEffect(HappenedThisWay.toACard(StepKind.RETURN, filter), …)` after the return to hand (Cemetery Recruitment, Jared Carthalion).

### Other graveyard effects


| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ReturnUpToOneCardOfEachManaValueFromGraveyardToHandEffect` | `()` | return any number of cards with different mana values from controller's graveyard to hand. Choices are sequential, optional, and later choices exclude mana values already selected. Used by Seasons Past |
| `ReturnCardsFromControllerGraveyardToHandEffect` | `(CardPredicate, DynamicAmount[, boolean optional])` | return up to the evaluated count of matching cards from the controller's graveyard to hand. The two-argument form is optional and permits stopping early; pass `false` for mandatory wording. Rofellos's Gift uses mandatory `EventValue()` after its hand-reveal effect |
| `PutTargetCardsFromGraveyardOnTopOfLibraryEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter[, int maxTargets])` | put target cards matching filter from controller's graveyard on top of library. `maxTargets` caps the choice; the one-arg ctor uses `ANY_NUMBER` (= 0) for "any number of target cards". Multi-target selection at cast time via SpellCastingService (`handleAnyNumberGraveyardSpellTargeting` for any-number, `handleUpToNGraveyardSpellTargeting` for a cap). Used by Frantic Salvage / Gravepurge (any number) and Reinforcements (`maxTargets = 3`). The static factory `fromOpponentGraveyard(filter, maxTargets)` flips it to "up to N target cards from an opponent's graveyard on top of their library" (Misinformation): the choice pools every opponent's graveyard but is flagged `singleGraveyard`, so all targets must share one opponent's graveyard, and resolution puts each card on top of its own owner's library. `fromAnyPlayerGraveyard(filter, maxTargets)` is the same but for **any single player's** graveyard, including the controller's � "put up to four target basic land cards from a player's graveyard on top of their library" (Lodestone Bauble). That flavour is used from an **activated ability**: the targets ride in on the activation's `targetIds` with `Zone.GRAVEYARD` (harness `activateAbilityWithGraveyardTargets`) and are validated in `TargetLegalityService.validateMultiTargetGraveyardAbility` (cap, distinctness, filter, single graveyard) |
| `ReturnUpToOneCardOfEachColorFromGraveyardToHandEffect` | `()` | returns the cards chosen for all the card's controller-graveyard target groups together: up to one of each color (All Suns' Dawn), up to one instant and up to one sorcery (Shreds of Sanity). The groups and the one-card-per-group rule are the card's target declaration |
| `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToHandEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter, int maxTargets[, boolean xScaled])` or `(CardPredicate filter, DynamicAmount dynamicMaxTargets)` | return up to maxTargets target cards matching filter from controller's graveyard to hand. Multi-target selection at cast time via SpellCastingService "up to N" graveyard targeting. `upToOnePerCardType(filter, Set<CardType>)` additionally limits the selection to one card matching each listed card type (Pull from the Deep). The `(CardPredicate filter, DynamicAmount dynamicMaxTargets)` form replaces the fixed cap with a number evaluated in `SpellCastingService` once the spell's player target is chosen (X is locked in as the spell is cast) and makes the effect declare a benign `player()` `TargetSpec`; the fixed-cap check in `TargetLegalityService` is skipped for it, the multi-graveyard choice enforces the computed cap. Used by Morbid Plunder, Reap (dynamic). `xScaled=true` ("Return X target creature cards …", Shattered Crypt) ignores maxTargets and instead requires **exactly** the paid X targets through `handleExactNGraveyardSpellTargeting`; casting with X above the number of matching graveyard cards is rejected, and X rides on the stack entry so riders such as `LoseLifeEffect(new XValue(), you())` read the same X. On an `Triggers.dies(THIS)` ability it is instead recognised by `GraveyardTargetingSupport` (which also looks inside a `MayEffect`/`SequenceEffect` wrapper), so the targets are chosen as the trigger goes on the stack; `maxTargets = Integer.MAX_VALUE` is "any number of target cards" and a zero-target trigger still goes on the stack (Iname, Life Aspect) |
| `TargetCardGroupEffect` | `targetGroups()` | associates an effect with positional graveyard-card target groups when one activated ability resolves different groups through different effects. `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToHandEffect.withTargetGroups(...).fromSameGraveyard().toOwnersHands()` supports effects such as Pulsemage Advocate, while `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().targetGroup(index)` routes a separate graveyard target to reanimation. |
| `ReturnTargetCreaturesOfChosenTypeFromGraveyardToHandEffect` | `(int maxTargets)` | return up to maxTargets target creature cards of the creature type chosen while casting from the controller's graveyard to hand. The cast-time choice filters the graveyard target pool and includes Changeling cards. Used by Aphetto Dredging |
| `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter)`, fixed-cap `(CardPredicate filter, int maxTargets, boolean fromBattlefieldThisTurn, boolean enterTapped[, CardColor grantColor, CardSubtype grantSubtype])`, `fromAllGraveyardsUnderOwnersControl(...)`, `(CardPredicate filter, DynamicAmount dynamicMaxTargets)`, or `withinTotalManaValue(CardPredicate filter, int maxTotalManaValue)` / `withinTotalManaValue(CardPredicate filter, DynamicAmount maxTotalManaValue, boolean grantHasteUntilEndOfTurn)` | returns target cards matching the filter from the configured graveyard scope to the battlefield. The one-argument form returns exactly the spell's paid X cards; the fixed-cap form returns up to `maxTargets` and can grant persistent color/subtype characteristics; the all-graveyards owner-control factory returns each card under its owner's control; the dynamic form evaluates an ETB cap from cast context; the factory permits any number within an aggregate mana-value cap, while its dynamic overload can also cap the number of returned cards and grant temporary haste. Targets are validated before costs are paid and returned together in one battlefield-entry batch. Used by Return to the Ranks, Ever After, Marshal's Anthem, Tocasia, Dig Site Mentor, Orcus, Prince of Undeath, and Sudden Salvation |
| `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect.anyNumberAttachedToSourceHost` | `(CardPredicate filter)` | returns any number of targeted Aura and/or Equipment cards from the controller's graveyard and attaches them to the permanent enchanted by the source Aura. Used by Mantle of the Ancients |
| `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect.sinisterWaltz` | `(CardPredicate filter)` | targets exactly three controller-graveyard cards, randomly returns two to the battlefield, and puts the rest on the bottom of its owner's library. Used by Sinister Waltz (VOC 30) |
| `ReturnTargetCardsFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter)`, fixed-cap `withTargetBounds(CardPredicate filter, int maxTargets, int minTargets)` or `(CardPredicate filter, int maxTargets, boolean fromBattlefieldThisTurn, boolean enterTapped[, CardColor grantColor, CardSubtype grantSubtype])`, `(CardPredicate filter, DynamicAmount dynamicMaxTargets)`, `withinTotalManaValue(CardPredicate filter, int maxTotalManaValue)`, or `fromSingleGraveyard(CardPredicate filter, int maxTargets, boolean grantHaste, boolean sacrificeAtEndStep)` | returns target cards matching the filter from the controller's graveyard to the battlefield. The one-argument form returns exactly the spell's paid X cards; the fixed-cap form returns up to `maxTargets`, or at least `minTargets` when configured, and can grant persistent color/subtype characteristics; the dynamic form evaluates an ETB cap from cast context; the factory permits any number within an aggregate mana-value cap; the single-graveyard factory pools all graveyards while requiring the chosen cards to share one graveyard and can grant haste plus schedule sacrifice at the next end step. Targets are validated before costs are paid and returned together in one battlefield-entry batch. The card is the stack entry's triggering card. `Triggers.nontokenCreatureDies(ANY)` wrapped in `UnlessPaysEffect` for "you may pay {X}" (Nim Deathmantle, `attachSource=true`); `Triggers.creatureDies(EQUIPPED)` with `ConditionalEffect(TriggeringCardMatches(CardSubtypePredicate(SAMURAI)), …)` for "return that card … if it's a Samurai card" (Oathkeeper, Takeno's Daisho, `attachSource=false`) |

Fizzles if the card left the graveyard or is blocked from entering. Used by Valkyrie's Call on `Triggers.creatureDies(YOU_CONTROL)` with non-token, non-Angel conditional filtering, Undying Malice as a temporary `Triggers.dies(THIS)` grant, and Fang, Roku's Companion on `Triggers.dies(THIS)` |

Fizzles if the card left the graveyard, is not a permanent card, or is blocked from entering. Used by Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods on `Triggers.creatureDies(YOU_CONTROL)` |
| `ReturnDyingOpponentCreatureUnderYourControlEffect` | `(CardSubtype grantSubtype)` or `()` | Triggers.creatureDies(OPPONENT_CONTROLS): put the creature card that died (the stack entry's triggering card) from its owner's graveyard onto your battlefield, tracked as a stolen creature (permanent control). An optional subtype is granted only if the returned permanent is a creature (Lim-Dûl the Necromancer uses `ZOMBIE`). "You may return that card" is `new MayEffect(new ReturnDyingOpponentCreatureUnderYourControlEffect(), "…")` (Necroskitter, The Reaper King, No More); "you may pay {1}{B}. If you do" wraps it in a `UnlessPaysEffect` (Lim-Dûl the Necromancer). Fizzles if the card left the graveyard |

When `requireManaValueEqualsX=true`, targeting is restricted to MV==X and that player mills X cards afterward. `(boolean tapped)`/`()` default to `filter`=artifact-or-creature and `requireManaValueEqualsX`=true (Geth). Ashen Powder: `(false, CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), false)` � creature only, any MV, no mill On `Triggers.dealsCombatDamageToPlayer()` the shared `SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger` flow narrows the choice to the damaged player's graveyard (`CombatDamageService` passes them as `graveyardOwnerId`) — Ink-Eyes, Servant of Oni's "from that player's graveyard". |

Used by The Beamtown Bullies |
| `PutImprintedCreatureOntoBattlefieldEffect` | `()` | when this creature dies, reveal imprinted card; if creature, put onto battlefield (Clone Shell dies trigger) |
| `LivingDeathEffect` | `()` | Spell effect, card-specific (Living Death). Three ordered steps in one resolution: every player exiles all creature cards from their graveyard (`GraveyardReturnSupport.exileCardFromAnyGraveyard`), then every creature on every battlefield is sacrificed (`DestructionSupport.performSimultaneousSacrifice` — sacrifice, so indestructible and regeneration do not save them), then each exiled card is pulled out of exile and put onto the battlefield under the player whose graveyard it came from. Because the exile snapshot is taken first, creatures sacrificed by step two stay in their graveyards. The returning cards enter as one CR 614.12 simultaneous batch (shared `snapshotEnterTappedTypes` + `simultaneouslyEntered`), with ETB/legend-rule handling run afterwards. A `BoardWipeEffect` (`sweepsBoard() == true`) |

Pushed automatically by `PermanentRemovalService` (`collectPersistTriggers`, `collectUndyingTrigger`) when a creature with `Keyword.PERSIST` / `Keyword.UNDYING` dies with no counter of that kind; never add it to a card. |

Routed by `MayCastHandlerService.handlePlayImprintedCardChoice`. Wrap in `ConditionalEffect(<play condition>, ...)` for the card's gate (e.g. `NoPlayerHasCardsInHand`). Pair with `ImprintFromTopCardsEffect(N)` on Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS) |

## Draw / discard / hand manipulation

| `RevealCardsChooseOneToCastEffect` | `(DynamicAmount count)` | target player chooses X cards from hand; the controller privately sees those cards and may cast one revealed nonland spell without paying its mana cost. Uses the shared `RevealCardsDiscardChoice` interaction with a private reveal and `PendingMayAbility` free-cast routing; lands remain in hand and are not eligible. Used by Extract Brain (OTC 225) |



`RevealAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandEffect(CardPredicate filter[, CardPredicate countedFilter])` makes the controller choose any
number of matching cards from their hand to reveal publicly. The selected count is stored on the
resolving stack entry for a following `EventValue`-based effect; Brine Seer chains it into
`UnlessPaysEffect.counterUnlessPays(new EventValue())`. The optional `countedFilter` restricts which revealed
cards are counted (and stored as event card IDs) while `filter` still decides which cards may be
revealed: "show any cards, and if you show two black cards" = `RevealAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandEffect(new CardTruePredicate(), new CardColorPredicate(CardColor.BLACK))`
+ `ConditionalEffect(new EventValueAtLeast(2), ...)` (Xyru Specter).

`EachPlayerRevealsAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandThenCreatesTokensEffect(CardPredicate filter,
CreateTokenEffect token)` lets each player reveal any number of matching cards from their hand in
APNAP order, then creates one copy of the token for each card that player revealed. Kamahl's Summons
uses a creature-card filter and a 2/2 green Bear token.

`RevealUpToFiveNonlandCardsFromHandThenCreateTreasureTokensEffect()` makes the controller
choose up to five nonland cards from hand and publicly reveals the selected cards. It then creates
one Treasure for every revealed card whose mana value is shared by at least one other revealed card.
The choice reuses `PendingInteraction.RevealAnyNumberOfCardsFromHandChoice` with a dedicated
duplicate-mana-value resolution context.

`ChooseCardEffect` (hand) + `RevealCardsFromHandEffect` + the put step makes the controller
reveal one chosen card from hand. If it shares a name with any permanent on any battlefield, the
card is put onto the battlefield; otherwise it remains in hand. Retraced Image uses the mandatory
`ChooseCardEffect.announced` choice.

`TargetPlayerPutsCardsFromHandOnTopOfLibraryEffect.yours(1, TOP)` is the non-targeting controller-scoped form of
the hand-to-library-top choice. It requires the controller to choose one card when their hand is
nonempty, and an empty hand resolves without a prompt. `GrantNoMaximumHandSizeEffect(Duration.UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN)` grants a temporary
controller-scoped hand-size exemption that is removed when that player's next turn begins.

`EachPlayerPutsCardFromHandOnTopOfLibraryEffect()` applies the same mandatory single-card choice to
every player in APNAP order, skipping players with empty hands. It reuses the top-only
`PutCardsFromHandOnLibraryCardChoice` interaction and carries its progress in `GameData` so the
resolution can resume between players. Sadistic Augermage (RAV) uses it.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `DrawCardEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount[, PlayerSubject player])` | `player` (default `Subjects.you()`; `SUBJECTS_REFERENCE.md`) draws that many cards; several players in APNAP order (CR 101.4), each the amount evaluated once, or `eachEvaluatedFor(amount, players)` for an amount read for each drawing player ("each player draws a card for each creature card in their graveyard", Tales of the Ancestors), every number fixed before the first draw (CR 608.2h); one at a time (draw-replacement effects and "whenever you draw" triggers see each draw). Convenience ctors: `(int amount)`, `()` = 1; "when you sacrifice this, draw …" is `Triggers.sacrificed(THIS)` with the plain effect. Covers "draw X cards" (`XValue`), "draw a card for each creature you control" (`PermanentCount`), "for each creature card in your graveyard" (`CardsInGraveyard`), "for each charge counter on [source]" (`CountersOnSource` � evaluates the live source, falling back to `sourcePermanentSnapshot` when sacrificed as a cost, e.g. Culling Dais). Advertises a benign PLAYER `targetSpec()` when the amount is target-relative � `CardsDiscardedByTargetPlayerThisTurn` (Dream Salvage) or a `PermanentCount` with `CountScope.TARGET_PLAYER` ("draw a card for each tapped creature target player controls": Theft of Dreams, Tamiyo, the Moon Sage's -2) � so a loyalty ability needs no card-level player filter | `rememberingAmount(amount)` snapshots the evaluated draw count into `EventValue` before draw replacements change game state (Corpse Augur). Also `Subjects.controllerOf(Subjects.target())` is "its controller draws" after the sibling effect's permanent target (Gwafa Hazid, Nin). |

Sequential per-player `XValueChoice` interactions; the APNAP remainder rides `GameData.pendingEachPlayerDrawUpToQueue` and the answers `GameData.pendingEachPlayerDrawUpToChoices`. Life uses cards actually drawn, not the chosen count. Used by Truce and Temporary Truce (2, 2) |

| `AlternatingHandExileEffect` | `()` | target opponent reveals their hand; that player and the spell's controller then alternately exile a card from it (the TARGET picks first) until the hand is empty. Encode "gains haste until end of turn" via the template's `grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn`. Used by Warren Weirding |

Used by Entrapment Maneuver |

Each sacrifice is its own resolution step (a CR 616.1 question ends the step before the permanent leaves), and the effect inserts itself again as the next step while the sacrificed permanent's last-known types were nonland. Used by Tyrant of Discord (ETB, `PlayerPredicateTargetFilter(OPPONENT)`) |

Flashback casts (`StackEntry.isCastWithFlashback()`) search `castFromGraveyardCount`. `requireDifferentNames=true` (Uncage the Menagerie) excludes already-chosen names on subsequent picks; `count <= 0` still searches and shuffles. By-name search = `CardNamedPredicate` (Squadron Hawk). To-top = `TOP_OF_LIBRARY` (Liliana Vess, Brutalizer Exarch). As a static ability (`addStaticEffect`) the normal-cost variant supplies the draw replacement for Eruth through `ExileTopCardsMayPlayThisTurnDrawReplacementEffect`. `.fromLibraryOf(PlayerSubject)`: another library ("that player exiles the top two cards of their library", Fallen Shinobi; `targetPlayer()` declares a harmful player target, Knacksaw Clique, Korvold); the controller still gets the permission. `.mayOnlyCast()`: "you may cast that card" (a land gets no permission, Ragavan); `.withManaAsThoughAnyColor()`: "spend mana as though it were mana of any color" for nonland cards (Grenzo, Daxos, Breeches), for as long as the permission lasts; `.until(Duration)`: the permission's duration instead of end of turn (`UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_END_STEP` Haste Magic, `UNTIL_END_OF_YOUR_NEXT_TURN` Lidless Gaze, `UNTIL_CONTROLLERS_NEXT_UPKEEP` Elkin Bottle, `PERMANENT` "for as long as it remains exiled" Brainstealer Dragon, Cunning Rhetoric); `.exiledFaceDown()`: exiled face down, the controller may look at it (Thought-String Analyst, Ixhel); `.payingLifeEqualToManaValue()`: "pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost" (Inside Information, Xander's Pact); `.playableBy(PlayerSubject)`: another player may play them, read without a target, and the duration's "your" is theirs (Expedited Inheritance's "they", Curse of Hospitality's "that creature's controller"); `.playableOnlyIf(Condition)`: playable only while the condition holds (Neyali, Monk Class); `.until(DURING_YOUR_NEXT_TURN)`: "during your next turn" (Galvanic Relay); `.mayOnlyCast(CardPredicate)`: "you may cast [red | instant or sorcery] spells from among them", only a card castable as a matching spell (front face, modal double-faced back face or Adventure) is permitted and the permission casts only matching spells (Narset, Chandra Hope's Beacon); `.upTo(n)`: "you may play one / up to two of those cards" (a shared play-permission group; Electrostatic Blast, March of Reckless Joy); `.choosingOne()`: "choose one of them. A target library is a benign target when `.playableBy(targetPlayerDeclaredElsewhere())` gives that player the permission (Casey & Raph). ## Exile

`ExileGraveyardCardsEffect` also supports `GraveyardExileScope.DYING_CREATURE_CONTROLLER`, a non-targeting scope that exiles the last-known controller's graveyard when used by a delayed death trigger such as Burn Away.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `ExileSourceAndTopCardChooseOneMayPlayUntilNextTurnEffect` | `()` | Triggers.dies(THIS): exile the dying source card from its owner's graveyard, then exile the top card of the ability controller's library; grant that controller play permission for both cards until the end of their next turn, sharing one use (no prompt). If the source is no longer in the graveyard, neither the top card nor a play choice is created. Used by Flameskull |
| `ExileGraveyardCardsEffect` | `(int count, GraveyardExileScope scope[, CardPredicate filter])` or `(GraveyardExileScope scope)` | unified graveyard-exile effect; `scope` selects which graveyard(s) and derives the `targetSpec()` graveyard scope. Scopes: `OWN` (the controller exiles `count` of the cards in their own graveyard that match `filter`, their choice; a lone match is exiled without a prompt; the chosen cards are the EXILE step's result, so a following `ConditionalEffect(HappenedThisWay.exiled(), …)` reads them: `fromOwnGraveyard(count, filter)` / `fromOwnGraveyardWithSource(count, filter)`; "you may exile a … card from your graveyard. | `ExileTriggeringCreatureAndTrackWithSourceEffect` | `()` | Triggers.creatureDies(YOU_CONTROL), Triggers.nontokenCreatureDies(...) or `Triggers.dies(filter, YOU_OWN)` ("put into your graveyard") resolution: exile the dying creature card from its owner's graveyard tracked "exiled with" the source permanent (`GameData.exiledCards` by source id). The dying card is the stack entry's triggering card. Wrap in `MayEffect` (with a toughness or other filter on the trigger) for the "you may exile it" clause. Used by Colfenor's Urn (may, toughness-gated) and Purgatory (mandatory, `Triggers.dies(Triggers.NONTOKEN_CREATURE, ObjectRelation.YOU_OWN)`) |
| `SearchLibraryForCardsToExileWithSourceEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter[, int maxCount[, boolean requireDifferentNames]])` | Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS): the controller searches their library for **any number**, or up to `maxCount`, of cards matching `filter`, exiling each one tracked "with" the source permanent (`GameData.exiledCards` by source id), then shuffles. The repeated single-card pick may stop early; `requireDifferentNames` excludes names already chosen during this search. Driven by `LibraryChoiceHandlerService` via the `LibrarySearchDestination.EXILE_WITH_SOURCE` destination (carries `sourcePermanentId` + re-filters each pick). Pair with `PutCardExiledWithSourceIntoHandEffect`. Used by Endless Horizons (`CardSubtypePredicate(PLAINS)`), Kaho, Minamo Historian (`CardTypePredicate(INSTANT)`, `3`), and Omenpath Journey (`CardTypePredicate(LAND)`, `5`, different names) |
| `ExileCardFromHandFaceDownWithSourceEffect` | `(boolean toGraveyardOnControlLoss)` | the controller chooses a card in their hand and exiles it **face down** tracked "with" the source permanent, so only that permanent's controller may look at it (`GameViewProjectionFactory` face-down reveal). Resolves the source permanent from the stack entry, falling back to the battlefield permanent whose card is the ability's source card (activated-ability entries carry no `sourcePermanentId`). `toGraveyardOnControlLoss=true` registers the source in `GameData.exiledCardsToGraveyardOnControlLossWatch`, so `StateBasedActionService.putExiledCardsIntoGraveyardOnControlLoss` puts every card exiled with it into its owner's graveyard when its controller changes **or** it leaves the battlefield. Used by Gustha's Scepter |
| `PutCardExiledWithSourceIntoHandEffect` | `([CardPredicate filter[, boolean toOwnersHand]])`, `returningToOwner()`, `withTriggeringCardNameToOwnersHand()` | puts one matching card the controller owns exiled "with" the source permanent into their hand; with several the controller chooses which via a `LIBRARY_REVEAL_CHOICE` routed by `PendingReturnExiledWithSourceCard` (only the chosen card leaves exile). Wrap in `MayEffect` for "you may". Companion to `SearchLibraryForCardsToExileWithSourceEffect`. Used by Endless Horizons's Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU) and Ethereal Forager's filtered attack trigger. `withTriggeringCardNameToOwnersHand()` narrows the pool to the name of the card the trigger event was about (the stack entry's triggering spell, or the land played), read as the ability resolves, and returns it to its owner (Search the City) |

| `PutRandomCardExiledWithSourceIntoOwnersHandEffect` | `()` | chooses one card at random exiled "with" the source permanent and puts it into its owner's hand without an interaction. Used by Skyship Weatherlight (PLS) |
| `PutCardExiledWithSourceIntoGraveyardCost` | `([CardPredicate filter])` | activation cost: chooses one matching card exiled with the source permanent, removes it from exile, and puts it into its owner's graveyard before the ability is put onto the stack. The no-argument form accepts any tracked card; the optional filter is checked during legality, selection, payment, and target validation. Used by Void Maw and Shelob, Dread Weaver (LTC 29) |
| `PutOpponentOwnedExiledCardIntoGraveyardCost` | `()` | cost: chooses one card an opponent owns from exile, removes it from exile, and puts it into that player's graveyard before the spell or ability is put onto the stack. Spell casts use `chosenAdditionalCostObjectId`; activated abilities use the normal exile-card choice interaction. Used by Cryptic Cruiser and Oracle of Dust (`BFZ`), and Processor Assault (`BFZ`) |
| `EachPlayerChoosesOwnPermanentsToExileUntilSourceLeavesEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, int maxCount)` | in turn order, each player chooses up to `maxCount` matching permanents they control; all chosen permanents are exiled and tracked with the source until it leaves. Used by Foreboding Steamboat (MKC 28) |
| `PutAllCardsExiledWithSourceIntoOwnersHandsEffect` | `()` | puts every card exiled with the source permanent into its owner's hand and records the number actually returned in the stack entry's event value for a following dynamic effect. Used by Bag of Holding's sacrifice ability and Asmodeus the Archfiend |
| `PutFaceUpExiledCardOwnedByTargetIntoGraveyardEffect` | `()` or `(CardPredicate filter)` | controller may choose one face-up card owned by the spell's target from exile and put it into that player's graveyard; an optional filter narrows the eligible cards. Used by Binding Negotiation and Memory Theft (`CardHasAdventurePredicate`) |
| `SearchLibraryForCardsToExileFaceDownPileEffect` | `(int count)` | Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS): the controller searches their library for `count` cards, exiles them **face down** as a pile tracked "with" the source permanent, shuffles that pile (`GameData.shuffleExilePile`), then shuffles their library. Repeated single-card pick over the whole library (fail-to-find allowed, CR 701.23b) driven by `LibraryChoiceHandlerService` via the `LibrarySearchDestination.EXILE_FACE_DOWN_PILE` destination. Pair with `RegisterNextDrawFromExiledPileReplacementEffect`. Used by Mangara's Tome (5) |
| `RegisterNextDrawFromExiledPileReplacementEffect` | `()` | activated-ability resolution: registers a one-shot, turn-scoped delayed replacement of the controller's next draw � "instead put the top card of the exiled pile into its owner's hand." Each activation is a floating effect on the drawing player (`UNTIL_END_OF_TURN`) whose payload is `RegisterNextDrawFromExiledPileReplacementEffect(pileSourceId)`, so N activations replace the next N draws; `DrawService.resolveDrawCard` consumes one (`endFloatingEffect`) via `GameData.topOfExilePile`. An empty pile still replaces the draw and does nothing. Mangara's Tome |
| `ReturnCardExiledWithSourceToBattlefieldEffect` | `()` | returns one card exiled "with" the source permanent to the battlefield under the **ability controller's** control (CR 110.2a � not necessarily the owner); with several the controller chooses via the same `LIBRARY_REVEAL_CHOICE` / `PendingReturnExiledWithSourceCard` route (its `toBattlefield` flag selects this destination). An optional `EnterWithCountersEffect` is carried through that choice and applied before ETB processing. Battlefield sibling of `PutCardExiledWithSourceIntoHandEffect`. Used by Purgatory's Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU) wrapped in `UnlessPaysEffect.youMayPay("{4}", 2, �)` and Chaos Shrine's Black Crystal |
| `DealDamageEffect.to(Subjects.triggeringPlayer(), n)` (enchanted player) | `(triggeringPlayer(), int)`, `eachEvaluatedFor(amount, triggeringPlayer())` | deals damage to the enchanted player (the player a curse is attached to; targetId baked to that player by StepTriggerService). Used by Curse of the Pierced Heart (`toPlayerOrTheirPlaneswalker(1, triggeringPlayer())`) and Curse of Thirst (`eachEvaluatedFor(PermanentCount(allOf(Curse, PermanentAttachedToSourceControllerPredicate), ANY_PLAYER), triggeringPlayer())`: the Curses attached to that player), both Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.ENCHANTED_PLAYER) |
| `ReturnTargetCardFromExileToHandEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter, boolean ownedOnly)` | return target exiled card matching filter to hand. When `ownedOnly=true`, restricts targeting to the controller's own exile zone (MTG "you own"). Targets exile (spec `EXILE_CARD`). Fizzles if target removed before resolution. Validated by `ExileTargetValidators`, resolved by `ReturnTargetCardFromExileToHandEffectHandler`. Used by Runic Repetition |
| `ReturnTargetCardFromGraveyardOrExileToHandEffect` | `(CardPredicate graveyardFilter, CardPredicate exileFilter, boolean exileOwnedOnly)` | return one target card from the controller's graveyard or exile to hand, using independent filters for the two source zones. The target zone is selected at cast time and retained on the stack; `exileOwnedOnly=true` restricts the exile branch to cards you own. Used by Sorceress's Schemes |
| `KnowledgePoolExileAndCastEffect` | `()` | Knowledge Pool's cast trigger (`Triggers.playerCastsSpell().castFrom(Zone.HAND)`, so its own free casts don't retrigger it). Exiles the triggering spell from the stack to the pool of the stack entry's source (nothing more if it has left), then presents the caster, the entry's non-targeting "that player" (the trigger is controlled by the KP controller per CR 603.3a), with a choice of nonland "other" cards from the pool to cast without paying mana cost. Uses `KNOWLEDGE_POOL_CAST_CHOICE` awaiting input |
| `EyeOfTheStormExileAndCopyEffect` | `()` | Eye of the Storm's cast trigger (`Triggers.playerCastsSpell()` filtered to instant or sorcery cards that aren't cast copies). Exiles the triggering card from the stack tracked with the entry's source, copies every instant or sorcery card exiled with that source, and opens `PendingInteraction.EyeOfTheStormCastChoice` so the caster chooses any subset and order of those copies for free casting. Handler: `EyeOfTheStormExileAndCopyEffectHandler` |
| `MayCastExiledCardThenBottomRestEffect` | `(UUID sourcePermanentId)` | Internal marker effect for a `PendingMayAbility`: offers `ability.targetCardId()` in exile as a free cast, then puts every other card exiled with `sourcePermanentId` on the bottom of its owner's library in a random order (declining bottoms it too). Bottoming runs before the cast so the chosen card is the only one that stays out of the library. Handler: `MayCastExiledCardThenBottomRestHandler`, bottoming via `ExileBottomRandomSupport`. Used by Possibility Storm and Unpredictable Cyclone. Pauses a multi-card draw instruction until the current free-cast choice finishes, keeping each cycling replacement separate |
| `MirrorOfFateEffect` | `()` | choose up to seven face-up exiled cards you own, exile all cards from your library, then put the chosen cards on top of your library. Uses `MIRROR_OF_FATE_CHOICE` awaiting input. Resolved by `MirrorOfFateEffectHandler` |
| `DoomsdayEffect` | `()` | holds the controller's library and graveyard as one combined pool; `PendingInteraction.DoomsdayChoice` requires five cards, or all cards if fewer are available, orders them via `LibraryReorder`, and exiles the rest. Follow with `LoseLifeEffect` for half the controller's life rounded up; it resumes after ordering completes. Used by Doomsday |
| `PermanentAuctionEffect` | `()` | exile all nontoken permanents into a shared pool; starting with the controller and going in turn order (wrapping), each player picks one exiled card and puts it onto the battlefield tapped under their control until the pool empties. Uses the `PermanentAuctionChoice` awaiting-input record (a `CHOOSE_MULTIPLE_CARDS` prompt with `maxCount == 1` per pick). Resolved by `PermanentAuctionService`. Used by Thieves' Auction |
| `ExilePermanentsInsteadOfGraveyardEffect` | `()` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, boolean excludeSource, boolean trackWithSource)` | static replacement effect: a permanent that would be put into a graveyard is exiled instead. Scoped to permanents leaving the BATTLEFIELD only — permanent cards moving to a graveyard from the stack, hand, or library are untouched. A non-null filter narrows which permanents are replaced; `excludeSource` excludes the dying source when applicable; `trackWithSource` records the exiled card with the replacement's source permanent. The no-arg form is global (Samurai of the Pale Curtain); the filtered tracked form is used by Void Maw. Read by `GraveyardService.tryApplyBattlefieldExilePermanentsReplacement`; contrast the narrower `ExileOpponentCardsInsteadOfGraveyardEffect` and `ExileInstantSorceryCardsInsteadOfGraveyardEffect` |
| `ReturnEnchantedCreaturesYouControlToHandInsteadOfDyingEffect` | `()` | static replacement: an enchanted creature controlled by the source's controller returns to its owner's hand instead of dying. Read by `PermanentRemovalService` before normal graveyard processing. Used by Necromancer's Magemark |
| `FirestormPhoenixReplacementEffect` | `()` | static replacement: when its source creature would die, returns that source card to its owner's hand instead. The returned card is individually revealed and can't be played from that hand until its owner's next turn; both temporary permissions are tracked by card ID. Read by `PermanentRemovalService`. Used by Firestorm Phoenix |


## Tokens

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `CreateTokenThenEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenEffect, CardEffect thenEffect)` / `aboutThatToken(tokenEffect, thenEffect)` | creates the wrapped tokens and, if at least one token was created, puts the follow-up on the stack as a reflexive ability. Use when the wording is "create [tokens]. When you do, [thenEffect]" and the follow-up target must be chosen after token creation. The follow-up's target restrictions come from its own `targetSpec()`. When the follow-up is about "that token" ("attach it to target creature", "... attached to that token") write `CreateTokenThenEffect.aboutThatToken(...)`: one reflexive ability for each token created (a replacement effect may make more), each with its token as the permanent its effect acts for (the entry's source permanent) and its own target |
| `ReturnTargetEquipmentFromGraveyardAndAttachToCreatedTokenEffect` | `()` | reflexive graveyard-targeting follow-up for a `CreateTokenThenEffect`: returns a target Equipment from the controller's graveyard and attaches it to the token created by that resolution. Used by Ratonhnhaké꞉ton (ACR 62) |
| `CreateTokenOfChosenColorAndSubtypeEffect` | `()` or `(DynamicAmount power, DynamicAmount toughness)` or `(int power, int toughness, Map<CardColor, CardSubtype> subtypeByColor)` | creates one creature token whose color comes from the source permanent's chosen color. The no-arg form uses the source's chosen creature subtype and creates a 2/2; dynamic power/toughness are evaluated from the resolving stack entry; the mapped form derives the subtype from the chosen color. The token name is the subtype's display name and it has no keyword abilities. No-op if the required choice is absent. Implements `TokenCreatingEffect`. Used by Volrath's Laboratory, Sarpadian Empires, Vol. VII, and Riptide Replicator |
| `CreateTokenEffect` | `(String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, Set<CardType> additionalTypes)` or `(int amount, ...)` or multi-color: `(int amount, String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, Set<CardColor> colors, List<CardSubtype> subtypes)` or `(String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, Set<CardColor> colors, List<CardSubtype> subtypes)` or multi-color with innate + until-end-of-turn keywords: `(int amount, String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, Set<CardColor> colors, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, Set<Keyword> grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn)` or multi-color with +1/+1 counters on creation: `(String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, Set<CardColor> colors, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, int initialPlusOnePlusOneCounters)` or tapped-and-attacking: `(int amount, String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, boolean tappedAndAttacking)` or tapped-attacking-with-keywords-exile: `(int amount, String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, boolean tappedAndAttacking, boolean exileAtEndOfCombat)` or enters-tapped: `(int amount, String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, Set<CardType> additionalTypes, boolean tapped)` or factory: `CreateTokenEffect.ofArtifactToken(int amount, String tokenName, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, List<ActivatedAbility> abilities)` or static factories for common tokens: `CreateTokenEffect.whiteSpirit(int amount)` (1/1 white Spirit with flying), `CreateTokenEffect.blackZombie(int amount)` (2/2 black Zombie), `CreateTokenEffect.whiteSoldier(int amount)` (1/1 white Soldier), `CreateTokenEffect.ofTreasureToken(int amount)` (Treasure artifact) or canonical (all params): `(CardType primaryType, DynamicAmount amount, String tokenName, int power, int toughness, CardColor color, Set<CardColor> colors, List<CardSubtype> subtypes, Set<Keyword> keywords, Set<CardType> additionalTypes, boolean tappedAndAttacking, boolean tapped, List<Ability> tokenEffects, List<ActivatedAbility> tokenAbilities, boolean exileAtEndOfCombat, boolean exileAtEndStep, boolean legendary, int initialPlusOnePlusOneCounters, Set<Keyword> grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn)` (also with `int amount` = `Fixed` sugar) | create N tokens. The count is a `DynamicAmount` evaluated at resolution (source-relative amounts read the live source permanent, falling back to `sourcePermanentSnapshot` when it left the battlefield as a cost); every "create a token for each �" wording is this effect + an amount � never a new effect class. Power/toughness are also `DynamicAmount`s (every int ctor is `Fixed` sugar): "create an X/X token where X is �" = the `(String tokenName, DynamicAmount power, DynamicAmount toughness, CardColor, List<CardSubtype>, Set<Keyword>, Set<CardType>)` ctor, e.g. Phyrexian Rebirth's `EventValue()`/`EventValue()` colorless Horror as a `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect.all` rider. The single-color convenience constructor also accepts a `DynamicAmount` in the amount position. Examples: "for each charge counter on ~" = `CountersOnSource(CHARGE)` (Shrine of Loyal Legions), "create X tokens" = `XValue()` (White Sun's Zenith), "for each Aura and Equipment attached to ~" = `AttachmentsOnSource(true, true)` (Valduk) / Equipment only = `(false, true)` (Kemba, Kha Regent), "for each poison counter your opponents have" = `OpponentPoisonCounters()` (Phyrexian Swarmlord), "for each creature you control" = `PermanentCount(IsCreature, CONTROLLER)` (Chancellor of the Forge), "for each creature card in your graveyard" = `CardsInGraveyard(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), CONTROLLER)` (Spider Spawning; Kessig Cagebreakers adds `tappedAndAttacking=true` via the canonical ctor), "for each Forest you control" = `PermanentCount(HasSubtype(FOREST), CONTROLLER)` (Howl of the Night Pack), "for each creature put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn" = `CreatureDeathsThisTurn(CONTROLLER)` (Fresh Meat), "half the number of Zombies you control, rounded down" = `Divided(PermanentCount(AllOf(IsCreature, HasSubtype(ZOMBIE)), CONTROLLER), 2)` (Endless Ranks of the Dead). `primaryType` determines the token's card type (CREATURE for creature tokens, ARTIFACT for artifact tokens like Treasure/Clue/Food); all convenience constructors default to CREATURE. `tokenAbilities` adds activated abilities to the token (e.g. Treasure's tap-sacrifice-for-mana). For non-creature tokens, power/toughness are ignored and `handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield` is not called. `ofArtifactToken` factory creates colorless artifact tokens with abilities. `color` is primary display color. `colors` (Set&lt;CardColor&gt;, nullable) is full color identity for multi-color tokens. Multi-color constructors default keywords/additionalTypes to empty sets. When `initialPlusOnePlusOneCounters` &gt; 0, each created token enters with that many +1/+1 counters (e.g. Additive Evolution's 0/0 Fractal with three counters). When `tappedAndAttacking=true`, tokens enter the battlefield tapped and attacking (CR 508.8) � used for "whenever ~ attacks, create tokens tapped and attacking" abilities (e.g. Hero of Bladehold). When `tapped=true`, tokens enter the battlefield tapped but not attacking � used for cards like Army of the Damned. When `exileAtEndOfCombat=true`, tokens are exiled at end of combat step � used for temporary attack tokens (e.g. Geist of Saint Traft). When `tokenEffects` is non-empty, each ability (e.g. `new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.dies(ObjectRelation.THIS), …)`) is added to the token card, giving the token its own triggered abilities (e.g. Mitotic Slime's cascading death triggers). When `legendary=true`, the token has the LEGENDARY supertype (subject to legend rule) � used for named legendary tokens (e.g. Verix Bladewing creating Karox Bladewing). `grantedKeywordsUntilEndOfTurn` (defaults to empty in every convenience constructor) is added to each created token's `Permanent.grantedKeywords` after it enters, i.e. keywords the token gains until end of turn � distinct from innate `keywords`. Used for "create a ... token. It gains haste until end of turn" (e.g. Artistic Process's Elemental gains haste) `withSimultaneousTokens(List<CreateTokenEffect>)` adds other fixed-count token profiles to the same creation instruction and entry batch; replacement choices such as Esix see the combined token count. Used by Bestial Menace. `withAttackingUntapped()` (with `tappedAndAttacking=true`) makes the token enter attacking but NOT tapped ("create a ... token that's attacking", e.g. Sigiled Sword of Valeron, Inquisitorial Rosette). `.forController(PlayerSubject)` sets who creates and controls the tokens (default `you()`; "its controller creates" = `controllerOf(target())` after a removal step), who is also offered the token-creation replacements. |
| `CreateTokenForTargetPlayerEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenEffect[, PlayerRelation targetPlayerRelation])` | create tokens under the targeted player's control (not the controller's). The optional relation narrows the player target; default is any player. Wraps a `CreateTokenEffect` that defines the token characteristics. Targets player (player-targeting spec). When used as an `Triggers.dealsCombatDamageToPlayer()` trigger, it automatically uses the damaged player as the target. Used by Dowsing Dagger (target opponent creates Plant tokens on ETB). On `Triggers.leavesBattlefield(THIS)` the blueprint's dynamic power/toughness reads the leaving permanent as it last existed (`CountersOnTriggeringPermanent`), because the source is gone by resolution � Phantasmal Sphere ("target opponent creates an X/X Orb, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature") . On `Triggers.playerTapsLandForMana()` `TapTriggers` handles the "whenever you tap this land for mana, target opponent creates ..." shape (Forbidden Orchard): it fires only when the source land itself is tapped by its own controller and creates the token for that controller's opponent, inline like every other land-tap trigger |
| `CreateTokenForImprintedCardOwnerEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect tokenEffect)` | `Triggers.leavesBattlefield(THIS)` trigger descriptor: the owner of the imprinted card creates the supplied token (Severance Priest). Dynamic power/toughness is evaluated as it resolves against the source as it last existed; the handler requires the imprinted card to still be in exile and uses the exiled entry's owner rather than the source controller. |

Examples: `new GainLifeEffect(3)`; per creature you control = `PermanentCount(IsCreature, CONTROLLER)`; per card in your hand = `CardsInHand(CONTROLLER)`; per card in your graveyard = `CardsInGraveyard(null, CONTROLLER)` (A? N via `Scaled`); X paid / toughness snapshotted as xValue (`SacrificeCreatureCost(trackToughness)`) = `XValue()`; twice X = `Scaled(XValue(), 2)`; charge counters on sacrificed source = `CountersOnSource(CHARGE)`; greatest power among your creatures = `GreatestPowerAmongControlled()`; War Report's creatures-plus-artifacts = `Sum(...)` |

## Poison counters

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `MeliraPoisonReplacementEffect` | `()` | STATIC replacement marker: the first poison-counter event affecting its controller becomes one poison counter, and later poison-counter events that turn are ignored. Checked by the shared poison application path. Melira, the Living Cure |
| Poison-counter application path | — | `LifeSupport`, combat poison damage, damage-source poison, and delayed poison all use the shared replacement path, including `MeliraPoisonReplacementEffect` and `PlayerCantGetPoisonCountersEffect` |
| `ReturnTargetCardOnDeathThisTurnEffect` | `()` / `(boolean enterTapped)` / `underControllerExcludingSource()` / `fromControllerGraveyard()` | creates a delayed triggered ability about the target (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.about`, this turn): when it dies, that card returns to the battlefield (tapped when `enterTapped`). The default forms return under the card owner's control (Graceful Reprieve, Supernatural Stamina); `underControllerExcludingSource()` returns under the registering ability's controller and narrows the target to a creature other than the source (Adarkar Valkyrie); `fromControllerGraveyard()` triggers only for a card the ability's controller owns ("put into your graveyard", Saffi Eriksdotter) |
| `GivePoisonCountersEffect` | `(int\|DynamicAmount amount, PlayerSubject player)` | give N poison counters to the players `player` names: `you()` (Phyrexian Vatmother; also a mana-ability rider, Noxious Bayou), `targetPlayer()` (benign player target; Hand of the Praetors' filtered cast trigger; with `Max(Fixed(0), Sum(Fixed(9), Scaled(TargetPlayerPoisonCounters(), -1)))` Vraska, Betrayal's Sting's "fewer than nine" difference), `eachPlayer()` (Ichor Rats), `eachOpponent()`, `controllerOf(target())` (a permanent baked onto a trigger: Noxious Assault), `controllerOf(triggering())` (Relic Putrescence's tapped artifact, Reaper of Sheoldred's damage source). Amount evaluated once. All placement routes through `LifeSupport.applyPoisonCounters` (Melira, `PlayerCantGetPoisonCountersEffect`, counter replacements); the ten-counter loss is the state-based action |
| `DefendingPlayerPoisonCounters` | `()` | dynamic amount for the poison counters on the player attacked by the source permanent; used by attack-triggered effects such as Kozilek, Compleated |
| `ReturnCreatureCardFromTargetOwnerGraveyardEffect` | `()` / `(UUID graveyardOwnerId)` | Reincarnation's delayed trigger effect: the controller of Reincarnation chooses a creature card from the targeted creature's owner's graveyard when the delayed trigger resolves; the chosen card enters under its owner's control. The no-arg form is bound to the target's owner when the delayed trigger is registered. |
| `ResolveEffectOnTargetDeathThisTurnEffect` | `(CardEffect effect)` / `ifDealtDamageThisWay(effect)` / `ifCondition(Condition, effect)` | creates a delayed triggered ability about the target (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.about`, this turn): when it dies, `effect` resolves under the registering player's control. Its source is the registering ability's (CR 603.7e), so self-referential effects (`TransformToBackFaceEffect`, `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect(Subjects.source())`) find it; the dying permanent is the triggering permanent as it last existed, its last controller `triggeringPermanentControllerId` ("that creature's controller": `Subjects.controllerOf(Subjects.triggering())`, `GraveyardExileScope.DYING_CREATURE_CONTROLLER`). A target of `effect` is chosen as it triggers (CR 603.3d). `ifDealtDamageThisWay` registers only if the source dealt the target damage (Skeletonize); `ifCondition` is an intervening "if" (CR 603.4, Fight for the Throne) |

## Win / lose game

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `TargetPlayerLosesGameEffect` | `(UUID playerId)` | target player loses the game. Pass `null` on cards: the handler uses the stack entry's player, the chosen target for spells / activated abilities (`targetSpec` = harmful `PLAYER`, e.g. Door to Nothingness), or the player dealt combat damage for a `Triggers.dealsCombatDamageToPlayer()` ability ("that player loses the game", Phage the Untouchable; the entry records that player as its non-targeting player through `DAMAGED_PLAYER`). A pre-resolved UUID is for engine-built abilities only |
| `RevealOwnHandThenDamagedPlayerLosesGameIfSixDifferentManaValuesEffect` | `()` | `Triggers.dealsDamageToPlayer()` trigger: reveals the resolving ability controller's hand, then the damaged player loses the game if at least six distinct mana values are present. The damaged player is the entry's non-targeting `targetId`; this trigger covers combat and noncombat damage. Wrap in `MayEffect` for the optional reveal. Handler `RevealOwnHandThenDamagedPlayerLosesGameIfSixDifferentManaValuesEffectHandler` |
| `ControllerLosesGameEffect` | `()` / `(PlayerSubject players)` (each of them loses, all at once: every remaining player losing is a draw, CR 104.4a; never a target) | the controller of the resolving ability loses the game (non-targeting; resolves against the stack entry's controller, so usable by state-triggered / dynamic-controller abilities like Immortal Coil's empty-graveyard loss). Respects can't-lose (Platinum Angel). Handled by `ControllerLosesGameEffectHandler` `(PlayerSubject player)` names another non-target loser: `(Subjects.enchantedPlayer())` (Sinner's Judgment). |
| `WinGameEffect` | `()` | controller wins the game (use inside conditional wrappers like `ConditionalEffect(new ControlsPermanentCount(minCount, filter), wrapped)`) |
| `PlayerWithHighestLifeWinsOrDrawEffect` | `()` | the player with the highest life total wins; a tie for highest life total declares a draw (Celestial Convergence) |
| `DrawGameEffect` | `()` | declares the game a draw when it resolves (Divine Intervention, on `Triggers.youRemoveLastCounterFromThis(CounterType.INTERVENTION)`) |
| `WinGameOnEmptyLibraryDrawEffect` | `()` | static: if controller would draw from empty library, they win the game instead (Laboratory Maniac). Checked in `DrawService.performDrawCard()` |
| `ApproachOfTheSecondSunEffect` | `()` | Approach of the Second Sun (`addSpellEffect`, no target). On resolution: if the spell was cast from hand (`sourceZone == HAND`) and the controller has cast 2+ spells with this card's name this game (`GameData.getSpellsCastThisGameByNameCount`), delegates to `WinGameEffectHandler` (so the can't-lose guard applies). ## Creature pump / boost

- `BoostSelfOrPutCounterIfExactlyThreeColorsEffect()` — gives the source +1/+1 until end of turn, or puts a +1/+1 counter on it instead when exactly three colors of mana were spent to activate the ability (Paragon of Modernity)

- `BoostEffect.targetPermanent(int, int, PermanentPredicate filter)` — "target creature or Vehicle gets +X/+Y until end of turn": a permanent target (its spec harmful only when an amount is negative, as for `target`), the filter naming the kinds (CR 301.7a); amounts read the source.

| `SetBasePowerToughnessEffect` | `(Integer power, Integer toughness, PermanentSubject subject)`; `(int power, int toughness)` � `Subjects.target()`; `toughnessOnly(int toughness)` � `(null, toughness, TARGET)` | set base P/T (modifiers still apply on top, CR 613 layer 7b). `scope == TARGET`: one-shot, sets target creature's base P/T **until end of turn** (Diminish, Quandrix Charm). `scope == SELF`: one-shot on the source, **until end of turn**, for a non-targeting self ability (Marsh Flitter). Any other scope (`Subjects.attachedCreature()`, �): continuous STATIC (Deep Freeze, Darksteel Mutation). Chosen color read from `Permanent.getChosenColor()` � pair with `ChooseColorOnEnterEffect`. Two handlers (normal + `selfOnly`) so the source is colored too. Battlefield permanents only � spells on the stack and cards in other zones are not recolored. Used by Painter's Servant |
| `BoostCreaturesOfChosenSubtypeEffect` | `(int powerBoost, int toughnessBoost[, CounterType scalingCounter[, boolean allControllers[, boolean excludeSelf]]])` / `BoostCreaturesOfChosenSubtypeEffect.otherOwnCreatures(p, t)` | static: creatures of the source permanent's chosen subtype get +X/+Y. The chosen subtype is stored on the permanent at runtime via `Permanent.getChosenSubtype()`. When `scalingCounter` is non-null the boost is multiplied by the count of that counter type on the source ("+1/+1 for each charge counter" � Door of Destinies with `CounterType.CHARGE`); `null`/2-arg = flat boost (Vanquisher's Banner). `allControllers=false` (default) boosts only creatures you control; `allControllers=true` boosts every creature of the chosen type regardless of controller, including the source itself if it is a creature of that type (Brass Herald = `(1, 1, null, true)`). `excludeSelf=true` suppresses the source's own boost entirely � "**Other** creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1" (Adaptive Automaton = `otherOwnCreatures(1, 1)`); the source still receives the boost from a *different* permanent with the same effect |
| `AttachedBoostEffect` | `(DynamicAmount powerBoost, DynamicAmount toughnessBoost, PermanentSubject subject, boolean amountsFromAttachedCreature)` (3-arg overload defaults the flag to false) | static: the attached creature (Aura/Equipment) gets +X/+Y where the amounts are `DynamicAmount`s. Scope: `Subjects.attachedCreature()`. The attached-scope sibling of `BoostEffect.self` � collapsed the whole `BoostCreaturePer*` family. Amounts evaluate against the Aura/Equipment's controller (CR 109.5), so `CountScope.CONTROLLER` = "you"/"you control". Examples: `+X/+X` per creature card in all graveyards `(CardsInGraveyard(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), ANY_PLAYER), same, Subjects.attachedCreature())` (Bonehoard); per creature card in your graveyard uses `CONTROLLER` (Wreath of Geists); `+X/+0` instants+sorceries in your graveyard uses `(CardsInGraveyard(anyOf(INSTANT,SORCERY), CONTROLLER), Fixed(0), �)` (Runechanter's Pike); `+1/+1` per land you control `(PermanentCount(PermanentIsLandPredicate, CONTROLLER), same, �)` (Blackblade Reforged); per basic-land subtype you control `(PermanentCount(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(FOREST), CONTROLLER), same, �)` (Blanchwood Armor, Lashwrithe, Armored Ascension); `-1/-1` per Swamp uses `Scaled(�, -1)` (Quag Sickness); `+1/+1` per matching-name land `(LandsMatchingImprintedName(), same, �)` (Strata Scythe) ; with `amountsFromAttachedCreature=true` the amounts evaluate with the attached creature as amount source and its controller as amount controller, so `IfSourceAttacking` switches on *its* combat state and `CountScope.CONTROLLER` reads "its controller" (Tahngarth's Rage: +3/+0 while attacking, -2/-1 otherwise) — unlike `ShrinkEnchantedCreatureEffect` there is no toughness floor |
| `ShrinkEnchantedCreatureEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | static layer 7c (CR 613.4c): the enchanted creature gets `-X/-Y` where `X = amount` and `Y = min(X, toughnessSoFar - 1)`, i.e. the toughness reduction is clamped so this effect alone can never take the creature below 1 toughness. Two differences from `AttachedBoostEffect`, both demanded by the wordings that need this record: the toughness floor, and the fact that `amount` evaluates with the **enchanted creature** as the amount source and *its* controller as the amount controller � so `IfSourceAttacking` reads the enchanted creature's combat state, `CountScope.DEFENDING_PLAYER` reads the player it is attacking, and `CountScope.CONTROLLER` reads "its controller" (NOT the Aura's controller, unlike CR 109.5 "you control" wordings). The floor is measured against the creature's toughness *so far in the pass* (own effective toughness + bonuses already in the accumulator), which both counts other pumps and keeps the self-referential value from recursing into static bonus assembly. Snowblind = `IfSourceAttacking(PermanentCount(snow land, DEFENDING_PLAYER), PermanentCount(snow land, CONTROLLER))`. Handler `ShrinkEnchantedCreatureEffectHandler` |
| `BoostByOtherCreaturesWithSameNameEffect` | `(int powerPerCreature, int toughnessPerCreature, boolean onlyControlled, PermanentSubject subject, PermanentPredicate filter)`; convenience `(power, toughness, onlyControlled)` and `(power, toughness)` = `onlyControlled=false`, both self-only (`scope=null`); a non-null `scope`/`filter` boosts every creature in scope by the others sharing its name (Mirror Box) | +X/+Y per other creature with the same name as the source (static, self-only). `onlyControlled=false` counts such creatures under any controller (Relentless Rats); `onlyControlled=true` counts only ones the source's controller controls � "each other creature you control named ..." (Timberpack Wolf) |
| `BoostBySharedCreatureTypeEffect` | `()` / `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | +1/+1 for each other creature sharing a creature type (static); with a filter, both the affected and counted creatures must match it (Sliver Legion uses `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SLIVER)`) |
| `BoostOwnCreaturesByManaSymbolEffect` | `(ManaColor manaColor, int powerPerSymbol, int toughnessPerSymbol)` | chroma anthem: each creature you control gets +powerPerSymbol/+toughnessPerSymbol for each mana symbol of `manaColor` in its own mana cost (static). Hybrid ({G/W}) and Phyrexian ({W/P}) symbols of that color each count once (via `ManaCost.countColorSymbols`). Used by Light from Within `(ManaColor.WHITE, 1, 1)` |
| `BoostOtherMulticoloredCreaturesByColorCountEffect` | `(int powerPerColor, int toughnessPerColor)` | anthem: each *other* multicolored creature you control gets +powerPerColor/+toughnessPerColor for each of its colors (static). Monocolored/colorless creatures and the source permanent itself get nothing; the color count is layer-5-aware (respects color-changing effects). Used by Knight of New Alara `(1, 1)` |
| `ConditionalEffect(new AnyPlayerControlsPermanent(filter), wrapped)` | see construction shape | conditional wrapper: "as long as any player controls a permanent matching [filter]". Wraps StaticBoostEffect, GrantKeywordEffect, ProtectionFromColorsEffect, or GrantEffectEffect (selfOnly handler). Use `PermanentColorInPredicate(Set.of(...))` for color cases. Used by Knight of Malice and Knight of Grace |
| `TapSubtypeBoostSelfAndDamageDefenderEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` | when this creature attacks, you may tap any number of untapped creatures of subtype you control � gets +X/+0 until end of turn and deals X damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking (an ordinary damage event through `DamageSupport`, even if the source has left). Use on `Triggers.attacks()`. Prompts multi-permanent choice for eligible untapped creatures |
| `BoostEffect.self` + `RemoveKeywordEffect(kw, Subjects.source())` | _compose, no dedicated effect_ | "gets +X/+Y and loses a keyword until end of turn": flat pair on a plain effect list, or `SequenceEffect.of(BoostEffect.self(x, y), new RemoveKeywordEffect(kw, Subjects.source()))` under a single-child wrapper. Sentry Oak = `ClashEffect(SequenceEffect.of(...))` (clash win reward) |
| `BoostByBushidoEffect` | `()` | continuous Bushido lord: each OTHER Samurai creature the source's controller controls gets +1/+1 for each point of Bushido that creature has (read off its own `BushidoEffect.amount()`). The source itself is excluded. Takeno, Samurai General |


## P/T setting / counters


| `SetCreatureTypesToImprintedCreatureEffect` | `(List<CardSubtype> retainedSubtypes)` or `(CardSubtype retainedSubtype)` | static self effect that replaces the source's creature subtypes with the creature subtypes of its imprinted card, retaining the supplied subtypes. No effect applies until the imprinted card is a creature card still in exile. Used by Duplicant |

Acts on the entry's source, the creature. Already-renowned creatures do nothing (CR 702.112c), and the creature still becomes renowned when counters can't be placed. Backslide uses the default characteristics; Cyber Conversion uses `asCyberman()` |
| `TurnSourceFaceUpEffect` | `()` / `ofTriggeringPermanent()` / `ofTarget()` | turns a face-down source permanent (or, `ofTriggeringPermanent()`, the stack entry's triggering permanent: "turn that creature face up"; `ofTarget()`, a benign creature target: "turn target face-down creature face up" with the face-down restriction in the card's target filter, "turn it face up if it's face down") face up without paying its turn-face-up cost, through `GameService.turnPermanentFaceUpWithoutPayingManaCost` (a "can't be turned face up" wins, CR 101.2; the turn is recorded for "turned face up this turn"); a face-down instant or sorcery card is revealed and stays face down (CR 701.40g); Staff Room (DSC 33) uses `ofTriggeringPermanent()` |

| `EnterWithCountersEffect` | `(CounterType type, DynamicAmount count)` | as-enters replacement effect (CR 614.1c): "enters the battlefield with [count] [type] counters". The count is a `DynamicAmount` � every "enters with � counters" wording is this one effect + an amount, never a new effect class. Examples: "with three charge counters" = `(CHARGE, Fixed(3))` (Trigons, Tumble Magnet), "with three wish counters" = `(WISH, Fixed(3))` (Djinn of Wishes), "with X charge counters" = `(CHARGE, XValue())` (Chimeric Mass), "with X +1/+1 counters" = `(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, XValue())` (Protean Hydra, Mikaeus the Lunarch), "for each creature that died this turn" = `(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, CreatureDeathsThisTurn(ANY_PLAYER))` (Bloodcrazed Paladin), "for each other Zombie you control and each Zombie card in your graveyard" = `(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, Sum(PermanentCount(HasSubtype(ZOMBIE), CONTROLLER), CardsInGraveyard(CardSubtypePredicate(ZOMBIE), CONTROLLER)))` (Unbreathing Horde � the entering permanent isn't on the battlefield yet, so "other" is automatic), and "for each different mana cost among nonland cards in your graveyard" = `DistinctManaCostsAmongCardsInGraveyard()` (Embodiment of Agonies; cards without a mana cost are ignored). Conditional variants wrap it in `ConditionalEffect`: "if kicked, enters with N +1/+1 counters" = `ConditionalEffect(new Kicked(), new EnterWithCountersEffect(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, new Fixed(N)))` (Academy Drake, Grunn; pair with `KickerEffect` on STATIC), "Raid � enters with N counters" = `ConditionalEffect(new Raid(), �)` (Rigging Runner). Applied in `BattlefieldEntryService.putPermanentOntoBattlefield()` before the permanent is added to the battlefield (CR 614.12), so it works on every entry path; `XValue`/`Kicked` read the resolving spell's stack-entry context (0/false when the permanent wasn't cast). Blocked by `CantHaveCountersEffect` |

It enters with N times that many +1/+1 counters on it." A static `ReplacementEffect` (`addStaticEffect`) (excluded from the triggered pipeline). Handled in `BattlefieldEntryService.handleCreatureEnteredBattlefield` � before ETB triggers it prompts the controller with a `MultiPermanentChoiceContext.DevourSacrifice` multi-permanent choice over their *other* creatures (0 to all); the sacrificed count A? `multiplier` is added as +1/+1 counters and the devoured creatures are recorded on the permanent via `Permanent.recordDevouredCreature`. Read the count back with the `CreaturesDevoured` amount ("� for each creature it devoured"), or a per-subtype count with `DevouredCreaturesOfSubtype(CardSubtype)` (Voracious Dragon's "twice the number of Goblins it devoured"; a devoured Changeling counts as any type). Tar Fiend = `new DevourEffect(2)` + `DiscardEffect(new CreaturesDevoured(), Subjects.targetPlayer())`. No other creatures ? no prompt, devours 0 |

Cost can be mana only (e.g. "{4}"), a life payment, sacrifice only (e.g. sacrifice an artifact or Goblin), mana plus sacrifice, tapping an untapped matching permanent, returning a matching permanent to its owner's hand, discarding a matching card, or foraging. SpellCastingService pays it when the caster announces buyback (`PlayCardRequest.buyback`); chosen discard payments use `discardHandCardIndices`, while `randomDiscard=true` selects automatically. The stack entry is stamped `StackEntry.buyback`; `addSpellEffect(new ConditionalEffect(new BuybackPaid(), ReturnToHandEffect.selfSpell()))` then returns the spell to its owner's hand as it resolves. "Other" is implicit � the entering permanent isn't on the battlefield yet, and a source entering simultaneously doesn't apply its effect (CR 614.12). Same CR 614.12 subtype lookahead. | `PutCountersEffect` | `(CounterType)` / `(CounterType, int count)` / `(CounterType, DynamicAmount amount)` / `(CounterType, int count, PermanentPredicate predicate)` / `(CounterType, int count, boolean regenerateIfSurvives)` / `withTargetRestriction(CounterType, int count, PermanentPredicate targetPredicate)` / `(PermanentSubject subject, CounterType[, int|DynamicAmount[, PermanentPredicate condition]])` | put `amount` counter(s) of the specified type on a permanent. A non-target **subject** names it without targeting: `Subjects.source()` ("on this [permanent]"; `onSelf`, row above), `Subjects.triggering()` ("on it"; also `onTriggeringPermanent`), `Subjects.attached()` ("on enchanted / equipped creature"; captured at an Aura's activation before a bounce cost), `Subjects.returned()`, `Subjects.returnedThisResolution()` / `Subjects.createdThisResolution()` ("on each of them" after a return or token step), `Subjects.granter()` (Hankyu); its count is evaluated against that permanent and `condition` gates placement ("if it's blue"). **The one targeted counter-placement effect**: `(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, n)`, `(MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE, n)` (`(MINUS_ONE_MINUS_ONE, 1, true)` for Gore Vassal's regenerate), `(PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, new XValue())` (Waker of the Wilds). In a multi-group spell, bind it to its target group via `target(...).addSpellEffect(...)` (Savage Stomp, River Heralds' Boon). A non-null **`predicate`** instead makes it a resolution-time own-permanent choice (non-targeting spec; Settle the Score `(LOYALTY, 2, PermanentIsPlaneswalkerPredicate)`). LORE counters on Sagas trigger chapter abilities (CR 715.2b); +1/+1 fires "whenever a +1/+1 counter is put on this" triggers (`Triggers.plusOneCounterPutOnThis()`); -1/-1 respects prevention Step 10 run C2: mass forms `onEachYouControl(kind, n, filter)`, `onEach(kind, n, filter)` (every battlefield), `onEachTargetPlayerControls(kind, n, filter)` (declares the benign player target), any set subject (`triggeringAll()`, `except(...)`); a set's amount is worked out once against the source (CR 608.2h) unless `.evaluatedForEach()`; one resolution's placements are one event: the Hero and loyalty "one or more" triggers trigger once (CR 603.2c), each replacement order still asked per permanent (CR 616.1) |

The amount is evaluated on resolution (`XValue`). The counters come off together after the last answer. A REMOVE_COUNTERS step (total, permanents, controllers, players) for `AmountThisWay(REMOVE_COUNTERS)` / `HappenedThisWay.removedCounters()`. ## Keywords / abilities

- `GrantProtectionFromPlayerEffect(PlayerSubject from, PermanentSubject permanents, Duration)` — "you and [permanents] gain protection from [player]" until end of turn or until your next turn: the player and the permanents are found as it resolves, a `ProtectionFromPlayersEffect` is floated on the controller and granted to each permanent (kept if control changes, not given to permanents that enter later). Guardian Archon (`chosenPlayer()`, `target()`), Eon Frolicker (`targetPlayerDeclaredElsewhere()`, `controlledBy(you(), planeswalker)`).
- `BoostAndGrantKeywordToTriggeringAndSharingCreaturesUntilEndOfTurnEffect(int powerBoost, int toughnessBoost, Set<Keyword> keywords)` — non-targeting triggered-ability resolution effect: the triggering creature and other creatures controlled by the ability controller that share a creature type with it get the boost and keywords until end of turn. Used by Haunted One.
- `GrantProtectionFromTargetPermanentColorsUntilEndOfTurnEffect()` — target permanent's effective colors are snapshotted on resolution; each creature controlled by the ability controller gains protection from those colors until end of turn. Used by Samite Elder.
- `GrantProtectionFromEverythingUntilNextTurnEffect()` — controller gains protection from every source until their next turn. Player targeting checks use the protection marker, while damage reuses the existing all-player-damage-prevention-until-next-turn state. The Stasis Coffin.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `GrantKeywordEffect` | `(Keyword keyword, PermanentSubject subject)` or `(Keyword keyword, PermanentSubject subject, PermanentPredicate filter)` or `(Set<Keyword> keywords, PermanentSubject subject)` or `(Set<Keyword> keywords, PermanentSubject subject, PermanentPredicate filter)` or with explicit duration: `(Keyword keyword, PermanentSubject subject, Duration duration)` / `(Set<Keyword> keywords, PermanentSubject subject, Duration duration)` / static factory `GrantKeywordEffect.toTargetIf(Keyword keyword, PermanentPredicate grantCondition)` / canonical `(Set<Keyword> keywords, PermanentSubject subject, PermanentPredicate filter, Duration duration, PermanentPredicate grantCondition)` | grant one or more keywords. Scope: `Subjects.source()`, `Subjects.target()`, `Subjects.attachedCreature()`, `Subjects.otherTappedCreaturesYouControl()`, `Subjects.creaturesYouControl()`, `Subjects.allCreatures()`, `Subjects.allPermanents()` (static: every permanent on every battlefield matching `filter`, no creature requirement; the source itself is included if it matches, so exclude it via the filter when needed � Spectral Guardian's "noncreature artifacts have shroud"), `Subjects.landsYouControl()` / `Subjects.allLands()` (static: lands you control / every land on the battlefield matching `filter`, no creature requirement � Shimmer's "each land of the chosen type has phasing" = `(PHASING, Subjects.allLands(), new PermanentHasSourceChosenSubtypePredicate())`), `Subjects.creaturesTargetPlayerControls()` (one-shot, all creatures the targeted player controls � player-targeting spec, e.g. Shields of Velis Vel), `Subjects.creaturesEnchantedPlayerControls()`, `Subjects.createdThisResolution()` (one-shot, the tokens created by an earlier effect on the **same** stack entry � read from `StackEntry.createdPermanentIds`, which the token-creation handlers populate; e.g. Gilt-Leaf Ambush's `ClashEffect` onWin grants deathtouch to the two Elf Warriors it just created). `Subjects.bandmatesOf(Subjects.source())` (one-shot, the *other* attacking creatures sharing the source's attacking band per CR 702.22c � read from `Permanent.bandId`; empty when the source isn't attacking in a band; Urza's Engine's "attacking creatures banded with this creature gain trample"). `filter` selects the eligible permanents for multi-permanent scopes and (for `Subjects.target()`) feeds the spec predicate � a targeting restriction. `grantCondition` (OPTIONAL, distinct from `filter`) is checked against the selected permanent at resolution: if it doesn't match, only the keyword grant is skipped, the target stays legal � use `toTargetIf(...)` for "target creature does X; if it's a [type], it also gains [keyword]" (Vampire's Zeal with `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(VAMPIRE)`, Blessing of Belzenlok with `PermanentHasSupertypePredicate(LEGENDARY)`). Use `Set<Keyword>` overload for multiple keywords at once. `Duration` governs the **one-shot** (normalfx) grant's expiry: the grant is a layer-6 floating effect on each permanent with that duration — `UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` (default), `UNTIL_END_OF_COMBAT`, `UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN`, `UNTIL_CONTROLLERS_NEXT_UPKEEP`, `PERMANENT` (no stated duration, so it lasts until the end of the game per CR 611.2a — Nature's Blessing; not ended by turn cleanup), or `WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD` ("for as long as you control [source]" - Aegis Angel; keyed to `entry.getSourcePermanentId()`, ended by `DurationClock` as the source leaves or changes control). In `addStaticEffect` the grant is continuous (anthem), duration and `grantCondition` are ignored |
