| `GrantEffectToTargetEffect` | `(Ability grantedAbility)` or `(Ability grantedAbility, Duration duration)` | grant an ability (triggered, or `StaticAbility.of(effect)`) to the target permanent, or with `(ability, duration, skip, subject)` to any non-targeting subject found as it resolves (Craterous Stomp's other creatures, Tend to the Kiln's `createdThisResolution()`); any `Duration` is honoured (Sygg, Stilt-Man). Each grant is a floating layer-6 grant on the permanent (`GameData.grantAbilityToPermanent`, CR 613.1f), ended by the clock: `PERMANENT` (default) has no end, `UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` ends at cleanup, `UNTIL_CONTROLLERS_NEXT_UPKEEP` at the effect controller's upkeep. Spec benign(PERMANENT). Skips if target already has an equal ability. Balduvian Shaman; Musician. `GrantEffectToTargetEffect.toEnchantedPermanent(grantedAbility, duration)` (subject `Subjects.attached()`) grants to the permanent the source Aura is attached to instead, re-derived at resolution with no target and no skip-if-present check — Genju of the Fields' `Triggers.dealsDamage()` + `GainLifeEffect(new EventValue())`. Also `(ability, Duration.PERMANENT, false, Subjects.source())` is the source's indefinite gain without the already-has check (Flame-Wreathed Phoenix). |
| `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect` | `(Ability grantedAbility, PermanentSubject subject[, PermanentPredicate filter])` | `addStaticEffect` continuous grant of a **triggered** ability to the permanents the scope selects. The grant record itself is accumulated as a granted effect by `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffectHandler` / `GrantTriggeredAbilitySelfEffectHandler` (the self pass is what covers the source permanent, since the layer pass never targets a source with itself), and the trigger pipeline lists the granted abilities next to the permanent's own (`GrantedTriggeredAbilitySupport`), so a granted ability triggers like a printed one: Avarice Amulet's "equipped creature has 'At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card'" (the creature's controller draws), Thorncaster Sliver's "Sliver creatures you control have 'Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 1 damage to any target'" (the attacker is the source; its target is chosen as the ability goes on the stack). Wrapped in `ConditionalEffect` it is recomputed by the layer system, so the granted trigger turns on and off with the condition — unlike the one-shot `GrantEffectToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect`. A "when this dies" ability an Aura or Equipment grants still triggers from the attachments the dying permanent had as it died (Infernal Scarring: "Enchanted creature has 'When this creature dies, draw a card'"). Conditional self-application goes through `StaticEffectSupport.applySelfOnlyConditionalStaticEffect`. Used by Tandem Lookout (`ConditionalEffect(SourceIsPaired, GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect(new TriggeredAbility(Triggers.dealsDamageToPlayer(), DrawCardEffect(1)), Subjects.sourceAndPaired()))`) |
| `RegisterDelayedReturnDyingCreatureUnderControlEffect` | `()` / `(boolean requireSourceOnBattlefield)` / `forOpponent()` | death-trigger effect that queues the dying creature's card for return at the next end step. `forOpponent()` targets an opponent as the delayed return controller. Global `Triggers.dies(THIS)` grants are snapshotted before battlefield removal so they survive the death-trigger collection path. |
| `ReturnDelayedGraveyardCardUnderControlEffect` | `(UUID returnControllerId, boolean sacrificeOnSourceControlLoss, CounterType counterType, int counterAmount, CardColor grantColor, CardSubtype grantSubtype)` | internal: the delayed end-step ability `RegisterDelayedReturnDyingCreatureUnderControlEffect` makes; it returns the card named as its entry's triggering card to the battlefield under `returnControllerId`'s control (new-object, blocked-zone and source-left checks). Not authored on cards. |
| `GrantEffectToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(Ability grantedAbility[, boolean delayedTrigger])` | until end of turn, the target creature(s) gain `grantedAbility`. With `delayedTrigger=true`, instead registers a spell-sourced delayed ability watching each targeted object until cleanup; the watched object retains its identity when it loses abilities, and a death trigger records its controller at death while the spell caster controls the delayed ability. The grant is a floating layer-6 grant on the permanent (`GameData.grantAbilityToPermanent`, CR 613.1f), ended by the clock at cleanup. Cleared on `resetModifiers()`. **Multi-target:** the handler fans over `entry.getTargetIds()` (falling back to `targetId`), so pair it with `target(filter, 0, 99)` for "any number of target creatures". Used by Verdant Rebirth (single-target Triggers.dies(THIS) bounce) and Rabid Attack (with `BoostEffect.target(1, 0)` on the same target list: "+1/+0 and gain 'when this dies, draw a card'"). **Triggers.attacks() granted triggers** trigger off the attacker like its own; a granted `MustBlockSourceEffect(null)` has its source snapshotted to the attacker there. Used by Tower Above ("gains 'When this creature attacks, target creature blocks it this turn if able'"). **Triggers.dealsCombatDamageToPlayer() granted triggers** likewise trigger off the damage-dealing creature; the controller draws via a plain `DrawCardEffect(1)`. Used by Open into Wonder ("gains 'Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card'", bound to a `targetX` group). **Triggers.becomesBlocked() granted triggers** trigger off the blocked attacker (`WatchedAbilities.temporary(attacker, Triggers.becomesBlocked())` next to its own abilities that aren't `EACH_BLOCKER`), both on normal blocker declaration and in `CombatBlockService.fireBecomesBlockedTriggersWithoutBlockers`; the granted effect is self-scoped to the attacker. Used by Barreling Attack ("When that creature becomes blocked this turn, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature blocking it" = `BoostEffect.self(CreaturesBlockingSource(), CreaturesBlockingSource())`). Also `(Ability, PermanentSubject)` grants to `Subjects.source()` (Cruel Deceiver) or to a set found once as the effect resolves, CR 611.2c (`Subjects.creaturesYouControl()` Driven // Despair, narrowed with `Subjects.narrowed(set, filter)`; The Cheetah Planet's Cats); a static ability is `StaticAbility.of(effect)` (Whipgrass Entangler, Akroma's Will). `(StaticAbility.of(new CantBlockEffect()), withCreaturesSharingAColor(target()))` is "until end of turn, target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it gain \"This creature can't block.\"" (Incite Hysteria; the set is found as it resolves). |
| `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect` | `(boolean tapped, boolean perpetuallyLosesThisAbility, boolean useReturnedPermanentAsSource)` | two one-card parts only: Runeblade Raiser's "It perpetually loses this ability" `(false, true, false)` and Bail Out's "It deals 1 damage to each opponent" `(true, false, true)` (later steps use the returned permanent as their source, else the creature as it last existed, CR 608.2h). Every other "return this card / it to the battlefield" is `PutCardsOntoBattlefieldEffect(Subjects.sourceObjectCard())` (a copy's dies trigger returns the copying card; a card that left and came back is a new object, CR 400.7) with `.enteringTapped()`, `.withCounters(kind, n)`, `.enteringWith(new SetCardTypesEffect(Set.of(ENCHANTMENT), Subjects.target()))` (the Enduring cycle), `.enteringWith(new LosesAllAbilitiesEffect(Subjects.target(), Duration.PERMANENT))` (Retched Wretch); a later step names the returned permanent with `Subjects.returnedThisResolution()` (Winter Soldier's attach, Presumed Dead's suspect) |
| `GrantFlashbackToGraveyardCardsEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter, String flashbackCost[, boolean allGraveyards])` or `(Set<CardType> cardTypes[, boolean allGraveyards])` | grants flashback to matching cards in the source controller's graveyard, or in all graveyards when `allGraveyards` is true. A null flashback cost uses each card's mana cost; static grants are active while their source's conditions are met, while spell-effect grants track card IDs until end of turn. Cards that already have native flashback are skipped for one-shot grants. Used by Past in Flames, Lier, Iroh, Grand Lotus, and Otaria |
| `GrantFlashbackToTargetGraveyardCardEffect` | `(Set<CardType> cardTypes[, String flashbackCost])`, `(Set<CardType> cardTypes, GrantedCardAbilityEffect.Ability)` (harmonize, jump-start, or embalm at the card's mana cost: Songcrafter Mage, Filigree Racer, Cursecloth Wrappings) or `(Set<CardType> cardTypes, boolean withoutPayingManaCost)` | targets a single card of a matching type in the controller's graveyard and grants it flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost defaults to the card's mana cost, unless a fixed `flashbackCost` is supplied; `withoutPayingManaCost` remains the free-cast form. Own-graveyard-only (kept `@ValidatesTarget` validator enforces the controller's graveyard). Uses multi-graveyard targeting at ETB trigger time (`BattlefieldEntryService.handleGrantFlashbackETBTargeting`) or spell targeting (`targetId` in graveyard). Resolved by `GrantFlashbackToTargetGraveyardCardEffectHandler`. Fizzles if target leaves graveyard. The grant is a `GrantedCardAbilityEffect` floating effect on the card (until end of turn); it ends as the card leaves the graveyard. Used by Snapcaster Mage, Flashback (SOS), and The Fugitive Doctor (WHO 130) |
| `GrantAbilityToNextSpellThisTurnEffect` | `storm(CardPredicate)`, `cascade(CardPredicate)`, or `(CardPredicate filter, CardEffect effect, String keyword)` | one-shot: the next matching spell the controller casts this turn has that triggered ability of its own (a `nextThisTurn` delayed ability with `.grantedToTheSpell()`), used up by that spell, else ended with the turn; each resolution gives one instance. Storm, Force of Nature; Crackling Spellslinger; Sloppity Bilepiper |
| `GrantGraveyardAbilityToCardsEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter, ActivatedAbility ability)` or `(CardPredicate filter, PerCard)` | STATIC: each matching card in the controller's graveyard (the planar controller's for a plane) has the ability, or one whose cost is read from the card (`EMBALM_FOR_MANA_COST`, `UNEARTH_FOR_MANA_COST`, `ENCORE_FOR_MANA_COST`: none without a mana cost; `ENCORE_FOR_MANA_VALUE`). The filter is judged by the card's current types, subtypes and colors. Sedris, Mishra Tamer of Mak Fawa, Dregscape Sliver, Sliver Gravemother, Graywater's Fixer, Wire Surgeons, Naktamun, Grixis |
| `GrantUnearthToGraveyardCardsEffect` | `(CardPredicate filter, String unearthCost)` | grants fixed-cost unearth to every matching card in the controller's graveyard until end of turn. The handler makes a `GrantedCardAbilityEffect` floating effect on each matching card (the set is fixed as it resolves, CR 611.2c); `GameQueryService` exposes `Card.unearthAbility(unearthCost)` as an effective graveyard ability. Used by Ghost Ark |
| `GrantTargetCreatureCardGraveyardCastAndCopyActivatedAbilitiesEffect` | `()` | targets a creature card in any graveyard and grants permission to cast that specific card this turn. Records a `GameData.GraveyardCardCastPermission` (source permanent + casting player) as an until-end-of-turn floating effect on the card in the graveyard (`GameData.addCardEffect`). `SpellCastingService` consumes the permission when the allowed player casts the card from any graveyard by card ID, puts the permanent spell on the stack, then queues a delayed trigger above it. Used by Havengul Lich |
| `GrantSourceActivatedAbilitiesUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(List<ActivatedAbility> abilities, String copiedFromCardName)` | delayed triggered ability effect that grants the stack entry's source permanent the provided activated abilities until end of turn as `Duration.UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` floating ability grants (`GameData.grantAbilityToPermanent`). Fizzles if the source permanent is gone. Used by Havengul Lich after the selected graveyard creature card is cast |
| `BushidoEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` — int sugar ctor wraps `Fixed` | a Bushido ability. The combat triggers that represent Bushido use this rather than a bare `BoostEffect.self` so other cards can distinguish Bushido from unrelated block triggers (Takeno, Samurai General reads every other Samurai's amount). `asBoost()` returns the `BoostEffect.self(amount, amount)` the trigger resolves. Fixed N for printed bushido; `PermanentCount(IsAttacking, ANY_PLAYER)` for bushido X (Fumiko). Written as two triggers: `Triggers.blocks()` with `TriggerOptions.ONE_OR_MORE` (once each combat, CR 509.3a) and `Triggers.becomesBlocked()` |
| `GrantEffectToSourceOfChosenColorUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(Ability grantedAbility)` | after a preceding resolution-time color choice, grants the source a temporary triggered ability whose event subject must have that chosen color. The handler captures the color into a fixed `PermanentColorInPredicate`, so separate activations retain separate choices; the grant is a floating layer-6 grant on the permanent (`GameData.grantAbilityToPermanent`, CR 613.1f), ended by the clock at cleanup. |
| `RegisterDelayedBlockOrBecomesBlockedTriggerEffect` | `(CardEffect effect)` | registers two delayed abilities about the source permanent for this combat (a combat phase, CR 500.8): "whenever it blocks a creature" and "whenever it becomes blocked by a creature" (`TriggerOptions.EACH_BLOCKER`), `effect` acting on that creature; controlled by its creator even after a control change (CR 603.7e). Goblin Flotilla |

## Combat restrictions / evasion

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `CantBeBlockedEffect` | `()` | can't be blocked (static) |
| `CantAttackOrBlockAloneEffect` | `(boolean restrictsBlocking[, boolean restrictsAttacking])`, `(restrictsBlocking, restrictsAttacking, int otherCount, PermanentPredicate companion, String companionDescription)`; `unlessOthersAlsoDo(n)`, `unlessGreaterPowerAlsoDoes()`, `cantAttackUnlessAlsoAttacks(companion, description)` | static restriction (CR 508.1c, 509.1b): this creature can't attack (or block) unless at least `otherCount` other creatures matching `companion` (any creature when `null`, judged with this creature as the source) also do. The no-arg constructor is "can't attack or block alone" (Mogg Flunkies); `(false)` "can't attack alone" (Bonded Construct); `unlessOthersAlsoDo(2)` Orcish Conscripts; `unlessGreaterPowerAlsoDoes()` Okk; `cantAttackUnlessAlsoAttacks(AllOf(creature, ColorIn(B, G)), "a black or green creature")` Scarred Puma. Read through the creature's active static abilities by `CombatCompanionRestrictions` (attack and block declarations, the AI); a lone restricted creature is not offered as an attacker or blocker |
| `PeaceTalksEffect` | `()` | SPELL (Peace Talks). Resolves into itself as a floating effect on every player lasting `Duration.THIS_TURN_AND_NEXT_TURN` (ends at the next turn's cleanup, CR 514.2); `GameQueryService.isPeaceTalksActive` reads it. Creatures can't attack (`AttackLegalityService`); players and permanents can't be targets of spells or activated abilities (`TargetLegalityService` / `ValidTargetService`) — triggered abilities unaffected. Untargeted (`targetSpec()` `NONE`) |
| `CantBlockEffect` | `()` | this creature can't block (static) |
| `TargetPlayerChoosesCreaturesToAttackNextTurnEffect` | `()` | player-targeting spec: the targeted player chooses **any number** of creatures they control (`MultiPermanentChoiceContext.ChooseCreaturesToAttackNextTurn`, max = all their creatures). The chosen set — possibly empty — is made a floating `MatchingCreaturesMustAttackEffect` and `OnlyMatchingCreaturesCanAttackThisCombatEffect.only(chosen)` on that player (`Duration.DURING_AFFECTED_PLAYERS_NEXT_TURN`) by `GameData.restrictAttackersNextTurn`, which also makes the delayed triggered ability (`Triggers.endStep(CHOSEN_PLAYER)`, waiting past the current turn) that destroys each chosen creature that didn't attack at the beginning of that turn's end step. During that turn `AttackLegalityService` bars every creature outside the set and counts one must-attack requirement for every creature inside it, so an empty choice locks combat down entirely. With no creatures to choose the empty set is registered without a prompt. Pair with a `PlayerPredicateTargetFilter(OPPONENT)`. Used by Oracle en-Vec |
| `CantBlockCreaturesWithPowerGreaterOrEqualToOwnToughnessEffect` | `()` | static self-referential restriction (Ironclaw Curse): this creature can't block an attacker whose effective power ?A its own effective toughness. `BlockingRestrictionEffect` facet `cantBlockCreaturesWithPowerAtLeastOwnToughness()`; comparison resolved in `GameQueryService.findBlockDenial`, recognized on the blocker's own STATIC effects or via an attached aura |
| `CantBlockCreaturesWithPowerAtLeastEffect` | `(int minAttackerPower)` | static hard fixed-threshold restriction (Ironclaw Orcs, `(2)`): this creature can't block an attacker whose effective power ?A `minAttackerPower`. No cost, not self-referential. `BlockingRestrictionEffect` facet `cantBlockCreaturesWithPowerAtLeast()`; resolved in `GameQueryService.findBlockDenial` against the attacker's effective power |
| `CantBlockSourceEffect` | `(UUID sourcePermanentId)` | target creature can't block source permanent |
| `MatchingCreaturesCantBlockMatchingCreaturesEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, PermanentPredicate attackerPredicate, String description)` | global static: while the source is on the battlefield, any creature matching `blockerPredicate` can't block any creature matching `attackerPredicate`, board-wide (Boldwyr Intimidator "Cowards can't block Warriors"). Both predicates are evaluated with the imposing permanent's `FilterContext` (source controller + source card), so either side may be controller-relative: `PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate` as the attacker predicate gives "creatures with flying can't block creatures you control" (Bower Passage). Evaluated in `BlockLegalityService.findBlockDenial` |
| `MatchingCreaturesCantBlockMatchingCreaturesUnlessPaysLifeEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, PermanentPredicate attackerPredicate, int lifePerBlocker, String description)` | global static life-tax counterpart of the hard deny above (Heat Wave): matching blockers can't block matching attackers unless the blocker's controller pays `lifePerBlocker` life for each such unique blocking creature. `GlobalBlockLifeCostEffect`; charged in `CombatBlockService.declareBlockers` via `GameQueryService.getGlobalBlockLifeTax`. The block stays legal for targeting — only the life cost gates it |
| `MatchingCreaturesCantAttackOrBlockEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate affectedPredicate, String description)` | global static: while the source is on the battlefield, any creature matching `affectedPredicate` can't attack OR block, board-wide. `affectedPredicate` is evaluated relative to the source's controller (`sourceControllerId`/`sourceCardId` supplied), so `PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate` etc. resolve "you"/"your opponents". Kulrath Knight "Creatures your opponents control with counters on them can't attack or block" = `PermanentAllOfPredicate(PermanentNotPredicate(PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate()), PermanentHasCountersPredicate(ANY))`; Light of Day "Black creatures can't attack or block" = `PermanentColorInPredicate(BLACK)`. Attack side in `CombatAttackService.isCantAttackDueToGlobalRestriction`; block side in `GameQueryService.canBlock`/`buildBlockerFacts` |
| `TargetCreatureBecomesSubtypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardSubtype subtype)` or `(List<CardSubtype> subtypes)` | target creature **becomes** the creature type(s) until end of turn, **replacing** all its other creature types (Boldwyr Intimidator; Dance of the Skywise). One floating overriding `GrantSubtypeEffect` per type at its timestamp; contrast additive/permanent `GrantSubtypeToTargetCreatureEffect`. Also `(type or List of types, Subjects.source())` is "this creature becomes a [type] until end of turn", untargeted (Paragon of the Amesha); "in addition to its other types" is `GrantSubtypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect(type, Subjects.source())` (Adrestia). |
| `TargetCreatureBecomesChosenSubtypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` / `(PermanentSubject)` / `(PermanentSubject, Set<CardSubtype>)` / `(subject, excluded, boolean retainOtherTypes[, Duration duration])` | at resolution, choose a creature type (Wall excluded by default), then the target creature, the source, the enchanted creature or a set found as it resolves becomes that type, replacing its other creature types unless `retainOtherTypes`; until end of turn by default, `Duration.PERMANENT` for "it becomes the creature type of your choice" with no stated duration (Proteus Machine, CR 611.2a) |
| `CanBeBlockedOnlyByFilterEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, String allowedBlockersDescription)` | can only be blocked by matching creatures (static; also stored transiently on a `Permanent` for until-end-of-turn grants) |
| `CantBeBlockedByCreaturesMatchingPredicateEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate)` or `(blockerPredicate, onlyIfDefenderControls)` | negative evasion: this creature can't be blocked by blockers matching the predicate (static, validated in `GameQueryService.getBlockingIllegalityReason`). Optional `onlyIfDefenderControls` gates the restriction (Arctic Foxes: power ?A2 only while defender controls a snow land). Taoist Mystic = `PermanentHasKeywordPredicate(HORSEMANSHIP)`. On an Aura (Black Scarab), put the effect directly in STATIC � `getAuraGrantedBlockingRestrictions` collects any Aura `BlockabilityRestrictionEffect` with `blockableOnlyBy` or `cantBeBlockedByCreaturesMatching` onto the enchanted attacker |
| `CantBeBlockedByCreaturesWithLessPowerEffect` | `()` | STATIC: creatures with power less than this creature's power can't block it (Shrill Howler / Howling Chorus). Facet `cantBeBlockedByCreaturesWithLessPower()` on `BlockabilityRestrictionEffect`; compared against effective powers at declaration in `GameQueryService.findBlockDenial` |
| `CantBeBlockedByCreaturesWithPowerLessThanIslandCountEffect` | `()` | STATIC: creatures with power less than the number of Islands controlled by this creature's controller can't block it (Kraken of the Straits). Facet `cantBeBlockedByCreaturesWithPowerLessThanIslandCount()` on `BlockabilityRestrictionEffect`; compared against current effective powers and Island count at declaration in `BlockLegalityService` |
| `GrantCanBeBlockedOnlyByFilterToOwnCreaturesEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate creatureFilter, PermanentPredicate blockerPredicate, String allowedBlockersDescription)` | SPELL one-shot: each of the controller's creatures matching `creatureFilter` (null = all) can be blocked only by blockers matching `blockerPredicate` until end of turn (Dread Charge). Affected creatures snapshotted at resolution (CR 611); see the effect's handler |
| `CanBeBlockedByAtMostNCreaturesEffect` | `(int maxBlockers)` | can be blocked by at most N creatures (static). Read by `GameQueryService.getMaxBlockersAllowed`, which takes the smallest cap from the creature's own STATIC effects (Stalking Tiger) and from Auras attached to it, so putting it in an Aura's `addStaticEffect` restricts the enchanted creature (Alpha Authority) |
| `EachControlledCreatureCanBeBlockedByAtMostNCreaturesEffect` | `(int maxBlockers[, PermanentPredicate affectedCreatureFilter])` | team-wide version: each creature the controller controls, optionally matching the filter, can be blocked by at most N creatures (static, validated in CombatBlockService by scanning the active player's battlefield). Yuan Shao, the Indecisive uses maxBlockers=1; Challenger Troll filters with `PermanentPowerAtLeastPredicate(4)` |
| `EachControlledCreatureCanBeBlockedByAtMostNCreaturesEffect` | `(int maxBlockers)` | team-wide version: each creature the controller controls can be blocked by at most N creatures (static, validated in CombatBlockService by scanning the active player's battlefield). Yuan Shao, the Indecisive uses maxBlockers=1 |
| `MaximumCombatCreaturesEffect` | `(int maxAttackers, int maxBlockers)` | global static cap on the number of attackers and distinct blockers declared in each combat. Read through `CombatCreatureLimitEffect`; Dueling Grounds uses `(1, 1)`. The caps are restrictions the CR 508.1d / 509.1c requirement maximum respects: `CombatAttackService.searchAttackRequirements` and `CombatBlockService.validateBlockRequirements` search the declarations that disobey no restriction, so of two "attacks each combat if able" creatures under a one-attacker cap either one attacks |
| `CantBeBlockedByFewerThanNCreaturesEffect` | `(int minBlockers)` | generalized menace: can't be blocked except by N or more creatures � if blocked, must be blocked by at least N (static, validated in CombatBlockService alongside menace). Menace is the minBlockers=2 case; Guile uses 3 |
| `CanBlockAnyNumberOfCreaturesEffect` | `()` | this creature can block any number of creatures (static) |
| `CanBlockOnlyIfAttackerMatchesPredicateEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate attackerPredicate, String allowedAttackersDescription)` | this creature can only block attackers matching predicate (static). Read by `BlockLegalityService.buildBlockerFacts` from the blocker's own STATIC effects **and** from auras/equipment attached to it (`GameQueryService.collectAuraEffects`), so an Aura may impose it on the enchanted creature (Stratus Walk) |
| `CanBlockCreaturesWithShadowEffect` | `()` / `(boolean treatAttackerAsWithoutShadow)` / `.ignoringLandwalk()` / `.asThoughReachAgainst(CardSubtype)` / `(Mode, PermanentPredicate attackers)` | static blockability permission of the carrier (creature, granted, or the creature an Aura carrying it enchants): `AS_THOUGH_SHADOW` "can block creatures with shadow as though it had shadow" (Wall of Diffusion); `IGNORING_SHADOW` "as though they didn't have shadow" (Aether Web); `IGNORING_LANDWALK` "can block creatures with landwalk abilities as though they didn't have those abilities" (Street Savvy); `AS_THOUGH_REACH` over matching attackers ("can block Dragons as though it had reach", Dragon Hunter). Only the one restriction is lifted: the carrier gains no shadow or reach and the attacker loses nothing |
| `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessEffect` | `attack(Condition, String)` / `block(Condition, String)` / `attackOrBlock(Condition, String)` (record `(condition, requirementDescription, restrictsAttacking, restrictsBlocking)`) | static: this creature can't attack / can't block / can't attack or block unless the condition is met (CR 508.1c, 509.1b). Facets `AttackOrBlockRestrictionEffect.cantAttackUnless()` (read by `AttackLegalityService.isCantAttackUnlessConditionUnmet`, a defending-player condition judged for each attack target: the creature can attack a player, planeswalker or battle for which every condition is met, CR 508.5, 802.2a) and `BlockingRestrictionEffect.cantBlockUnless()` (read by `BlockLegalityService.hasUnmetBlockRequirement`), both through `ConditionEvaluationService` with the creature as source; a face-down creature or one that lost its abilities isn't restricted. Map the "unless" clause to a Condition: `ControlsPermanentCount(1, filter)` (Desperate Castaways), `DefendingPlayerControlsPermanent(filter)` (Sea Monster), `AnyPlayerControlsPermanentCount(N, filter)` (Harbor Serpent), `DefendingPlayerPoisoned()` (Chained Throatseeker), `OpponentDealtDamageThisTurn()` (Bloodcrazed Goblin), `NotCondition(new ExtraTurn())` (Medomai the Ageless), `ControlsOtherPermanentCount(1, Zombie)` (Marauding Boneslasher, `block`), `ControlsAnotherPermanent(Giant)` (Blind-Spot Giant) or `Equipped()` (Training Drone, `attackOrBlock`). requirementDescription is the "unless" clause. |
| `CreaturesCantAttackUnlessPredicateEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate exemptionPredicate)` | global static: ALL creatures can't attack unless they match the exemption predicate (e.g. flying or islandwalk), judged with the source and its controller as the filter context (Ensnaring Bridge: `PermanentNotPredicate(PermanentPowerGreaterThanSourceControllerHandSizePredicate)`). NOT folded into `CantAttackOrBlockUnlessEffect` � it is a per-attacker exemption applied from any permanent, not a source-creature condition. `youControl(exemption)` restricts only the source controller's creatures ("Non-Eye creatures you control can't attack", Evil Eye of Orms-by-Gore: `youControl(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(EYE))`; Glacial Chasm: `youControl(PermanentNotPredicate(PermanentTruePredicate()))`). |
| `CreaturesCantAttackControllerUnlessPredicateEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate exemptionPredicate[, boolean protectsPlaneswalkers])` | defender-scoped static: creatures not matching the exemption predicate can't attack THIS permanent's controller (they may still attack other players). "Creatures without flying can't attack you" = exemption `PermanentHasKeywordPredicate(Keyword.FLYING)` (Form of the Dragon). Pass `protectsPlaneswalkers=true` to also bar attacks on the controller's planeswalkers ("can't attack you or planeswalkers you control", Sandwurm Convergence � exemption `PermanentNotPredicate(PermanentHasKeywordPredicate(Keyword.FLYING))`); single-arg overload defaults to player-only. Contrast `CreaturesCantAttackUnlessPredicateEffect`, which is global (no attacking at all). Enforced per attacked player in `CombatAttackService`. |

Attack-only summoning-sickness bypass (no `{T}` activation), read in `AttackLegalityService.canAttack`; the "entered this turn" check scans `GameData.permanentsEnteredBattlefieldThisTurn`, which control changes do not touch � so the creature can attack the turn it changes controller |
| `CanOnlyAttackAloneEffect` | `()` | STATIC self-only "this creature can only attack alone" (Master of Cruelties): the creature can be declared as an attacker only if it is the sole attacker. Checked off the creature's own STATIC effects in `CombatAttackService.validateCanOnlyAttackAlone`, and as an Aura's restriction in `AttachedPermanentRestrictionEffect` (Errantry) |
| `EnchantedPermanentCantActivateAbilitiesEffect.includingManaAbilities()` | factory | enchanted creature's or permanent's activated abilities can't be activated, mana abilities included (static, Arrest, Ice Cage; CR 602.5); the no-argument constructor spares mana abilities. An `EnchantedPermanentAbilityLockEffect`, read by `AbilityActivationService.validateNotBlockedByStaticAbilityLock` and `GameQueryService`'s mana-ability check |
| `IgnoreSourceAuraEffectsUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `()` | NORMAL: the source Aura's static effects are ignored until end of turn (Volrath's Curse "for that player to ignore this effect until end of turn"). Resolution makes a floating effect on the Aura until end of turn whose controller is the paying player (`GameData.ignoresEffectOf`); `GameQueryService.hasAuraWithEffect` skips the Aura for that player, which is the single lookup behind the enchanted-creature attack (`AttackLegalityService`), block (`BlockLegalityService`) and activated-ability (`AbilityActivationService`) restrictions. | `EnchantedPlayerCantActivateNonManaNonLoyaltyAbilitiesEffect` | `()` | static on a Curse Aura enchanting a player: that player can activate only mana abilities (CR 605.1a) and loyalty abilities � every other activated ability (battlefield/graveyard/hand) is blocked (Overwhelming Splendor). Detected via `GameQueryService.playerCantActivateNonManaOrLoyaltyAbilities`; enforced at each activation entry point in `AbilityActivationService`. Pair with `LosesAllAbilitiesEffect(Subjects.creaturesEnchantedPlayerControls())` + `SetBasePowerToughnessEffect(1, 1, Subjects.creaturesEnchantedPlayerControls())` for the full card |
| `MatchingPermanentsCantActivateTapAbilitiesEffect` | `(PermanentSubject subject)` / `(PermanentPredicate affectedPredicate)` | static: activated abilities with `{T}` in their costs of the permanents `subject` names can't be activated (CR 602.5; non-tap abilities stay usable). A set, `controlledBy(eachPlayer(), filter)` (the predicate constructor), judged as an active static ability of its source: Katabatic Winds (`PermanentHasKeywordPredicate(FLYING)`); `attachedCreature()`, the Aura's lock on its creature: Serra Bestiary. Enforced via `GameQueryService.isLockedFromActivatingTapAbilities` |
| `LockTargetPermanentEffect` | `(boolean locksAttacking, boolean locksBlocking, boolean locksActivatedAbilities, Duration duration)` | resolved (non-static) targeted lock: stamps a `FloatingContinuousEffect` carrying the `PermanentLockEffect` facts onto the target creature. Attack side read in `CombatAttackService.canCreatureAttack`, block side in `GameQueryService.findBlockDenial`, activation side in `AbilityActivationService.validateNotBlockedByStaticAbilityLock` (mana abilities included; triggered abilities unaffected). Duration drives expiry (`UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` = cleanup, `UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN` = ability controller's next turn start). Edifice of Authority: `(true,false,false,UNTIL_END_OF_TURN)` = "can't attack this turn"; `(true,true,true,UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN)` = Detain. Targeted `harmful(CREATURE)` (or `declaredTarget`). A sixth component `PermanentSubject subject` (default `target()`) locks a permanent named without targeting: `LockTargetPermanentEffect.activatedAbilitiesOf(Subjects.targetAbilitySource(), UNTIL_END_OF_TURN)` after a `CounterSpellEffect` (Interdict, Trickbind); a non-target subject declares no target. |
| `LockMatchingPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate, boolean locksAttacking, boolean locksBlocking, boolean locksActivatedAbilities, Duration duration)` | non-targeted mass sibling of `LockTargetPermanentEffect`: scans every battlefield and stamps one floating `LockTargetPermanentEffect` per permanent matching `predicate`, so the same readers and duration expiry apply. `FilterContext` carries the source card and controller, so controller-relative predicates (`PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate`) work. | `ControlledCreaturesCanBlockAsThoughUntappedEffect` | `()` | `TappedBlockPermissionEffect`; STATIC — tapped creatures you control can block as though they were untapped. Returns `PermanentControlledBySourceControllerPredicate` from `tappedBlockMatcher()`, which `BlockLegalityService` evaluates relative to the permanent carrying the effect, so the permission follows control changes rather than sticking to the original controller. | `AttackWithoutTappingPermissionEffect` | `allowsAttackingWithoutTapping()` | floating combat permission: while the effect's source is untapped, creatures controlled by the effect controller do not tap as part of attacking. Read during attacker declaration. Johan |

## Tap / untap

`UntapPermanentsEffect(Subjects.triggering())` untaps the permanent whose event caused the
trigger ("untap that land", Tiller Engine; "untap it", Raggadragga, Goreguts Boss), and its global first-event use rechecks the creature's turn-wide tap history at resolution.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `TapTargetThenUntapAnotherTargetEffect` | `()` | "Tap target permanent, then untap another target permanent." (Ral Zarek +1). Two-position multi-target: `targetIds.get(0)` is tapped, `targetIds.get(1)` is untapped; declare two permanent filters with `minTargets = maxTargets = 2` (the multi-target path already rejects duplicate targets, which is exactly what "another" requires). Each target is looked up independently at resolution, so one having left the battlefield does not stop the other half |
| `TapAndLockOtherPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter)` | stack-resolution effect that taps every permanent matching `filter` except the source, and puts a `DoesntUntapEffect` lock on each one for as long as the source remains tapped (`WHILE_SOURCE_REMAINS_TAPPED`; Kill Switch). |
| `TapAndLockTargetPermanentWhileTappedEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate targetFilter)` | stack-resolution effect that taps the target permanent and prevents its activated abilities from being activated for as long as that target remains tapped; the lock is keyed to the target's tapped status (Braided Net) |
| `TapPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentSubject subject[, PermanentPredicate filter[, int chosenCount]])` | taps permanent(s) as an effect (fires "becomes tapped" triggers); the subject is resolved by `SubjectResolutionService`. `Subjects.target()` (tap target, with mixed multi-target-group handling; `filter` is the targeting restriction), `allTargets()` (every target of the entry), `source()` (tap this permanent, strictly the entry's source), `attached()` (the Aura's or Equipment's host), `triggering()` ("tap that creature"), or a set: `controlledBy(targetPlayer(), filter)` (declares the player target: "tap all lands target player controls"), `controlledBy(eachPlayer(), AllOf(creature, filter))` ("tap all creatures without flying", Deluge), `controlledBy(you(), filter)`; a set's filter gets the source, X, the defending player, the triggering player and permanent. With a set, a positive `chosenCount` lets the controller tap up to N of it (Yosei, the Morning Star). Replaces the former Tap{Target,Self,EnchantedCreature,PermanentsOfTargetPlayer,AllAttackingCreatures,Creatures} records |
| `UntapPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentSubject subject[, PermanentPredicate filter[, int chosenCount]])` | untaps permanent(s) as an effect (no triggers); the subject is resolved by `SubjectResolutionService`. `Subjects.target()` (`filter` is the targeting restriction, e.g. `PermanentIsArtifactPredicate` for Voltaic Servant), `allTargets()` (every target of the entry across its target groups: "untap up to four target permanents"), `source()`, `attached()` (Thornbite Staff's `Triggers.creatureDies(ANY)` untap, Paralyze's pay-to-untap upkeep trigger), `triggering()`, or a set: `controlledBy(you(), filter)` ("untap all lands you control"), `controlledBy(you(), AllOf(creature, Not(IsSourcePermanent)))` (each other creature you control), `controlledBy(targetPlayerDeclaredElsewhere(), filter)` (the player target another effect declares), `controlledBy(eachPlayer(), AllOf(creature, PermanentAttackedThisTurnPredicate))` (creatures that attacked this turn), `controlledBy(eachPlayer(), filter)` (Llanowar Druid: "Untap all Forests"), or `withCreaturesSharingAColor(target())` (Radiance: the target creature and each creature sharing a color with it, untapped like a set; Rally the Righteous). Replaces the former Untap{Target,AllTarget,Self,AllControlled,EachOtherCreatureYouControl,AttackedCreatures,EquippedCreature,UpToControlledPermanents,TargetAndSharingCreatures} records |

The affected player (or the planeswalker's current controller) pays before that step as a CR 116.2c special action: `GameService.payDelayedTriggerCost(sourceCardId, affectedId)` (`AbilityActivationService`), offered via `GameActionAvailabilityService.getAvailableDelayedTriggerPayments` → `GameStateMessage.delayedTriggerPayments` / `PAY_DELAYED_TRIGGER_COST`, and auto-pass stops while it is payable; paying removes the delayed ability (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.payToPrevent`). |

## Control / steal

| `GainControlOfTargetSpellAndCopyWithRandomTargetsEffect` | `(StackEntryPredicate)` | gains control of a target spell, copies it under the resolving controller, then independently reselects every target occurrence on both spell objects at random from targets legal for the now-controlled spell, excluding that controller and their permanents (Chef's Kiss) |

- `GainControlOfAllPermanentsMatchingEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate)` / `(PermanentPredicate, Duration)` / `(PermanentPredicate, Duration, List<CardEffect>)` | non-targeted mass steal; optional synchronous rider effects resolve in order for exactly the permanents gained after all control changes, using each gained permanent as the rider target (Broadcast Takeover)

| `ExchangeControlOfAllMatchingPermanentsWithTargetPlayerEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter[, Duration])` | targeted mass control exchange: the resolving player and target player exchange all matching permanents for the requested duration. Both sides are collected before any control changes are applied, then each permanent receives a per-permanent `GainControlOfTargetEffect` floating control effect. Targets a player; use the target player's current battlefield for subsequent target-player-scoped riders |

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect(Duration.WHILE_SOURCE_REMAINS_TAPPED)` | `()` | control lasts while the source remains tapped, regardless of who controls the source (Vedalken Shackles) |
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect.whileSourceRemainsTappedAndTargetMatches(PermanentPredicate)` | `(PermanentPredicate)` | control lasts while the source remains tapped and the target continues to match the supplied predicate; the control service expires it when the predicate stops matching (Old Man of the Sea, whose predicate holds for a permanent that stopped being a creature) |
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect.whileMatches(PermanentSubject, PermanentPredicate)` | `(subject, maintained)` | "gain control of [it] for as long as it [matches]": permanent control of a permanent that matches as the effect begins (else nothing, CR 611.2b), ended for good once it stops matching. Shield Broker (`targetDeclaredElsewhere()`, `PermanentHasCountersPredicate(SHIELD)`), Kaya, Ghost Haunter's emblem (`target()`, `PermanentIsHauntedPredicate`) |
| `GainControlOfTargetCreatureWhileMonarchEffect` | `()` | gains control of a target creature controlled by the player who became monarch, with a floating layer-2 control effect that expires when the captured player loses the monarch designation. Used by Garland, Royal Kidnapper (FIC 442) |
| `RiskyMoveEffect` | `()` | `Triggers.youGainControlOfThis()`: the new controller chooses a creature they control and an opponent, flips a coin, and on a loss gives that creature permanent control to the chosen opponent; all choices are non-targeting. Used by Risky Move. |
| `TargetPlayerGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect` | `()` / `.triggeringPlayer()` / `.triggeringPlayer(CardEffect thenEffect)` | The player carried on the stack entry gains control of the source permanent. The constructor targets that player; `triggeringPlayer()` is non-targeting for a trigger whose player is already known (Drooling Ogre). The follow-up overload binds the damaged player and source for a combat-damage trigger, then inserts `thenEffect` only after the control change resolves (Kain, Traitorous Dragoon). Also `(PlayerSubject)` gives the source without targeting a player: `Subjects.you()` the activating player (Oft-Nabbed Goat), `Subjects.controllerOf(Subjects.target())` "that permanent's controller" (Starke of Rath, Act of Authority); `(player, Duration, Subjects.attached())` gives the host of the source Aura or Equipment (Assault Suit), `.triggeringPlayer(Duration.UNTIL_END_OF_TURN)` is Slicer's temporary handoff. |
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect` | `(Duration duration[, CardSubtype grantedSubtype][, boolean tapWhenControlLost])`; `.of(PermanentSubject subject, Duration)` (permanents that are no target: `thisWay(CHOOSE)`) / `.ofTriggeringPermanent(Duration)` | gain control of target permanent for the given duration. `Duration{PERMANENT, END_OF_TURN, WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD}`. PERMANENT optionally grants a subtype (Captivating Vampire "It becomes a Vampire") and supports multi-target (iterates `getTargetIds()` for "up to N target" abilities); END_OF_TURN (Threaten, Metallic Mastery � card's target filter handles type restriction) wears off in end-of-turn cleanup; WHILE_SOURCE_ON_BATTLEFIELD (Olivia Voldaren) ends when the source leaves the battlefield or its creator stops controlling it. Every resolution creates a floating `L2_CONTROL` continuous effect (CR 613.2/613.7) via `CreatureControlService.applyControlEffect`; the controller of a permanent is DERIVED from the newest active control effect (`GameData.deriveControllerOf`), so an expiring steal falls back to the next most recent still-active effect, not blindly to the owner. Haste/untap riders (Act of Treason) are composed as separate effects on the card. `tapWhenControlLost=true` (Magus of the Unseen "When you lose control of the artifact, tap it") creates the delayed triggered ability "when you lose control of it, tap it" about the target (`TemporaryGlobalTriggeredAbility.about`, `Triggers.youLoseControlOfThis()`, controlled by the effect's controller), which triggers when that controller loses control, including when the END_OF_TURN effect expires at cleanup|
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect.gainedBy(PlayerSubject)` | `(PlayerSubject gainer)` | another player gains control (permanently or until end of turn, no rider): "target player gains control of up to three target creatures until end of turn" (Domineering Will, `targetPlayer(group)`), "target opponent gains control of all other permanents you control" (Sky Swallower, `of(except(controlledBy(you()), source()), PERMANENT).gainedBy(targetPlayer())`). Every `GainControlOfTargetEffect` records a `StepKind.GAIN_CONTROL` step (the permanents whose controller changed): "draw a card for each one they gained control of this way" is `DrawCardEffect(new AmountThisWay(StepKind.GAIN_CONTROL))` (Coveted Falcon). Its `controlDuration()` is `null` for another gainer (not a steal for the AI) |

Collects matches first, then applies one per-permanent `GainControlOfTargetEffect` floating control effect via `CreatureControlService.applyControlEffect`; optional synchronous rider effects resolve in order for exactly the permanents gained after all control changes (Broadcast Takeover)  Source-relative predicates receive the source context; source-linked durations reuse `GainControlOfTargetEffectHandler` to preserve their duration source. |
| `GainControlOfNextPlayerNonlandPermanentsEffect` | `(PlayerDirection direction)` | non-targeting permanent control rotation: each player gains permanent control of all nonland permanents controlled by the next active player in the chosen left/right turn-order direction, excluding the source permanent. Collects current controllers first, then applies one `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating control effect per permanent. Used by Aminatou, the Fateshifter |
| `GainControlOfTargetEffect.of(source(), PERMANENT).gainedBy(players)` | `(subject, duration).gainedBy(PlayerSubject)` | "[the player with the most life / the most cards in hand / who controls the most creatures / to your right] gains control of this": `matching(eachPlayer(), PlayerHasMostLifePredicate | PlayerHasMostCardsInHandPredicate | PlayerControlsMostCreaturesPredicate([filter]) | PlayerSeatedInDirectionPredicate(RIGHT))` after the card's intervening "if"; "lowest life, you choose among tied" is `ChoosePlayerEffect(matching(eachPlayer(), PlayerHasLeastLifePredicate))` + `.gainedBy(playersThisWay(CHOOSE))` (Ghazbán Ogre, Wild Dogs, Sokenzan Renegade, Wild Mammoth, Thoughtbound Primoc, Hithlain Rope, Bucknard's Everfull Purse, Loxodon Peacekeeper) |
| `GainControlOfNextPlayerNonlandPermanentsEffect` | `(Direction)` | permanent control rotation around `GameData.orderedPlayerIds`; each player gains all nonland permanents controlled by the next player in the chosen direction, excluding the source permanent. | `JuxtaposeEffect` | `()` | Juxtapose: `SPELL`, self-declares a single player target (player-targeting spec, read from `entry.getTargetId()`). Driven by `JuxtaposeSupport`: one type at a time (creatures first, then artifacts on the updated board, so an artifact creature can move in both steps); each type resolves the controller's participant then the target's; a tie for greatest MV prompts that permanent's controller via `PermanentChoiceContext.JuxtaposeTieBreak`; if either player controls no permanent of the current type that exchange is skipped. Swaps controllers permanently via two `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating effects (same swap mechanic as `ExchangeControlOfTargetPermanentsEffect`) |
| `GainControlOfAllPermanentsTargetPlayerControlsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter[, Duration][, List<CardEffect> thenEffects])` | gain control of every matching permanent that the target player controls at resolution (`canTargetPlayer`, with optional temporary duration and per-permanent rider effects; Gilt-Leaf Archdruid = lands; Hellkite Tyrant = artifacts on combat damage; Call for Aid = creatures with untap/haste/sacrifice protection). Applies one per-permanent control effect via the standard control machinery |
| `JuxtaposeEffect` | `()` | Juxtapose: `SPELL`, self-declares a single player target (`canTargetPlayer()`, read from `entry.getTargetId()`). The controller and target player exchange control of the creature they each control with the greatest mana value, then exchange artifacts the same way. Driven by `JuxtaposeSupport`: one type at a time (creatures first, then artifacts on the updated board, so an artifact creature can move in both steps); each type resolves the controller's participant then the target's; a tie for greatest MV prompts that permanent's controller via `PermanentChoiceContext.JuxtaposeTieBreak`; if either player controls no permanent of the current type that exchange is skipped. Swaps controllers permanently via two `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating effects (same swap mechanic as `ExchangeControlOfTargetPermanentsEffect`) |
| `ExchangeControlOfTargetPermanentsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate targetPredicate, boolean requireOpponentManaValueNotGreater[, boolean requireFirstTargetControlledByController])` | generic two-target control exchange; `targetPredicate` is the shape both targets must still match at resolution and `requireOpponentManaValueNotGreater` adds the "equal or lesser mana value" restriction. The power restriction flag provides the analogous power comparison for Spawnbroker. Legerdemain (`anyOf(artifact, creature), false, false, false, true`): `SPELL`, two same-filter `target(...)` groups plus `setMultiTargetConstraint(MultiTargetConstraint.SHARE_ARTIFACT_OR_CREATURE_TYPE)`; the fifth flag `requireSharedArtifactOrCreatureType` maps to `sharedCardTypes = ARTIFACT_OR_CREATURE`, re-checked by `GameQueryService.sharesCardTypeAmong` at resolution (a shared land type alone does not satisfy it); `ANY_CARD_TYPE` is "shares a card type" (Daring Thief), `ARTIFACT_CREATURE_OR_LAND` Gauntlets of Chaos (`forControlledTargetsSharingOneOf(first, types)`). The step records `GAIN_CONTROL` (both permanents, their new controllers) only when the exchange happens: "if those permanents are exchanged this way" is `ConditionalEffect(HappenedThisWay(GAIN_CONTROL), …)` over `thisWay(GAIN_CONTROL)`. `requireFirstTargetControlledByController` defaults to `true` (2-arg constructor) for wordings that pin target `[0]` to the ability's controller; pass `false` for plain "two target creatures" (Switcheroo � `PermanentIsCreaturePredicate(), false, false` with two `target(TargetFilters.creature())` groups, either slot controlled by anyone, exchange only when the controllers differ per CR 701.12b). Political Trickery (`PermanentIsLandPredicate(), false`): a spell with two `target(...)` groups � `[0]` a land you control (`ControlledPermanentPredicateTargetFilter`), `[1]` a land an opponent controls. Puca's Mischief (`PermanentNotPredicate(PermanentIsLandPredicate()), true`): exchange control of the two `targetIds` � `[0]` a nonland permanent you control, `[1]` a nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value ? target [0]. `Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU)`, wrapped in `MayEffect` (resolution-time "may", like Axis of Mortality). The two interdependent targets are chosen at trigger time by a bespoke two-step permanent choice (`StepTriggerService.processNextPucasMischiefTarget` � `PermanentChoiceContext.PucasMischiefOwnTarget`/`PucasMischiefOpponentTarget`, patterned on Capricious Efreet). At resolution re-checks legality (both still on the battlefield, control roles unchanged, MV restriction still holds; CR 701.12a) and, if legal, swaps controllers permanently via two `GainControlOfTargetEffect(PERMANENT)` floating `L2_CONTROL` effects |
| `ExchangeControlOfTargetPermanentsEffect.forTriggeringPermanent` | `(PermanentPredicate targetPredicate)` | trigger-time exchange where the entering permanent is the first exchange participant and its controller chooses the other target; source-relative predicates receive that entering permanent as `FilterContext.sourcePermanentSnapshot` |
| `GainControlOfEnchantedTargetEffect` | `()` | gain control of enchanted permanent (static, Control Magic-style) |
| `GainControlOfEnchantedPermanentEffect` | `(Duration duration)` | non-targeting: gain control of the permanent the **source Aura** is attached to for `duration`. Re-derives the host at resolution from the Aura's `attachedTo` (via `entry.getSourcePermanentId()`), so it works on triggers that carry no target � `Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)` and `Triggers.upkeep(ActivePlayer.YOU)` on an Aura (Wellspring, "gain control of enchanted land until end of turn"). Fizzles silently if the Aura left the battlefield or is unattached. `ControlStealingEffect`. Distinct from `GainControlOfEnchantedTargetEffect`, the activated-ability variant that reads the entry's target and holds control for as long as it remains enchanted (Rootwater Matriarch) |
| `GainControlOfTargetAuraEffect` | `()` | gain control of target aura |
| `GainControlOfTargetSpellEffect` | `([boolean noncreatureOnly])` | gain control of a target spell on the stack; preserves the spell owner. "You may choose new targets for it" is a following `MayEffect(ChooseNewTargetsForTargetSpellEffect.ifItHasTargets(targetSpell()), …)` on the same target. The no-arg form accepts any spell (Aethersnatch); pass `true` for noncreature spells (Commandeer) |
| `ControlEnchantedCreatureEffect` | `([boolean controlledByMonarch])` | control enchanted creature (static); the optional flag makes the current monarch control it instead of the Aura's controller |
| `ClashForControlOfEnchantedCreatureEffect` | `()` | Captivating Glance. Non-targeting `Triggers.endStep(ActivePlayer.YOU)` effect on an Aura: clashes with an opponent the aura's controller chooses (unasked with one; CR 701.30b), then gives control of the enchanted creature to the clash winner � the controller on a win, otherwise the clash opponent (a tie counts as "otherwise"). Uses `entry.getSourcePermanentId()` � aura's `attachedTo` to find the creature; delegates to `performClash` + `CreatureControlService.applyControlEffect` (PERMANENT floating control effect) |
| `SacrificeEnchantedPermanentAndReattachSourceAuraEffect` | `()` | Nettlevine Blight's granted `Triggers.endStep(ActivePlayer.YOU)` ability (`GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect`, `Subjects.attached()`; the your-end-step reader records the Aura as the entry's granting permanent). Resolution: the ability's controller sacrifices its source permanent, then moves the granting Aura (via `Permanent.setAttachedTo`, keeping its controller) onto another creature/land they control. In an Aura's own ability (Breath of Fury) the Aura is the source. Auto-attaches with 0/1 destination; prompts (`PermanentChoiceContext.ReattachSourceAuraAfterSacrifice`, completed in `PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService`) with 2+, deferring the sacrifice so the Aura isn't orphaned mid-choice. No destination � Aura left unattached, removed by `removeOrphanedAuras` SBA |
| `GrantSupertypeUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(CardSupertype supertype, PermanentSubject subject[, boolean gained])` | one-shot layer-4 supertype grant or removal that lasts until end of turn. `Subjects.source()` targets the resolving ability's source permanent; `Subjects.target()` uses the ability target. The two-argument constructor grants; `gained=false` removes. Stored as a floating continuous effect so `GameQueryService.hasEffectiveSupertype` and the legend rule see it |

## Prevention / protection / redirection

| `DestroyTargetCreatureInsteadOfNextDamageEffect` | `()` | activated ability: replaces the next damage event to target creature this turn with a destruction attempt; damage is not dealt. `RemovalEffect` (DESTROY); harmful CREATURE target. The effect itself is the one-shot shield, a floating effect on the creature until end of turn, ended as `DamagePreventionService` uses it for combat or noncombat damage; indestructible and regeneration are respected. Kill-Suit Cultist |
| `RemoveDamageFromTargetLandInsteadOfNextDestructionEffect` | `()` | activated ability: replaces the target land's next destruction this turn by removing all damage marked on it. Benign LAND target. The effect itself is the one-shot shield, a floating effect on the land until end of turn, ended as `GraveyardService` uses it. Pyramids |

`PreventDamageEffect.allToControlledCreatures()` — SPELL: "Prevent all damage that would be dealt this turn to creatures you control" (Divine Light). Adds a turn-scoped flag for the caster and checks the current controller of each creature when damage is dealt.

`PreventDamageEffect.fromChosenColor()` — SPELL: "Prevent all damage that sources of the color of your choice would deal this turn" (Prismatic Strands). Prompts for a resolution-time color, then adds that color to the turn-scoped source-color prevention set used by combat and noncombat damage paths.

| `FlipCoinForEachBlockingCreatureEffect` | `()` | Fighting Chance. At resolution, collects the blocking creatures currently on the battlefield, flips independently for each, and adds each winning blocker to a floating prevention effect for the rest of the turn |

| `PreventNextDamageToTargetAndAddPlusOnePlusOneCountersEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount)` | "Prevent the next X damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn. For each 1 damage prevented this way, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature" (Temper). Benign CREATURE target; X is evaluated on resolution. Its shield is a floating `DamagePreventionShield` with `plusOneCounters` on the creature (`GameData.addPermanentDamagePreventionShield`), used by `DamagePreventionService.creatureDamageSteps`, which immediately adds one +1/+1 counter per prevented damage, for both combat and noncombat damage; cleared at turn cleanup |

| `PreventDamageEffect.allToTargetCreaturesAndAddPlusOnePlusOneCounters` | `(PermanentPredicate victimPredicate)` | "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn. For each 1 damage prevented this way, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature" (Brace for Impact). Benign CREATURE target narrowed by `victimPredicate`; stores an unlimited target-creature shield and adds one +1/+1 counter per prevented damage in `DamagePreventionService.creatureDamageSteps`; cleared at turn cleanup |
| `PreventDamageEffect.allToTargetCreaturesReplacedByPlusOnePlusOneCounters` | `(PermanentPredicate victimPredicate)` | "If damage would be dealt to that creature this turn, prevent that damage and put that many +1/+1 counters on it" (Gatta and Luzzu). Like the Brace for Impact form (a floating `PreventDamageEffect` with this scope on the creature until end of turn), but the counters are put even when the damage can't be prevented |

| `PreventDamageToRecipientsEffect` | `(PermanentSubject permanents, PlayerSubject players, PermanentPredicate sources, PlayerSubject sourceControllers, DamageKind damage, SourceKind sourceKind, boolean sourceOfChosenColor, DynamicAmount amount)` | STATIC: "prevent all [combat / noncombat] damage that would be dealt to [recipients] [by sources]", or "if a source would deal damage to [recipients], prevent N of that damage". Recipients are a static `PermanentSubject` and/or a static `PlayerSubject` (`you()`, `eachPlayer()`); `sources` is judged on the damage source as it is, else last known, else a spell's card, with the effect's permanent as the filter's source (an emblem source never matches a filter, CR 114.3); `sourceControllers` is "sources you control"; `sourceKind` is "spells" / "instant and sorcery spells" (the spell deals the damage itself, not a creature it makes fight); `sourceOfChosenColor` reads the effect permanent's chosen color against the source's colors as a damage source (Ghostly Flame applied); `amount` (evaluated for the effect's permanent at damage time) prevents that much of each source's damage, one option per effect. Judged as each damage event would happen (CR 615.1) by `DamagePreventionService.staticPreventionsOfPermanentDamage` / `staticPreventionsOfPlayerDamage`, read by the `StaticRecipientPrevention` and `StaticRecipientPartialPrevention` rules of each CR 616.1 damage pool. Damage dealt by a source (`dealtBy(filter)`: `toEveryone().from(filter)`) is an option of the recipient's pool too, ordered by the recipient's controller or the player (CR 616.1); a filter judges the card an ability names as the source (Blazing Torch) rather than the permanent the ability is on. A face-up plane's effect is read with the planar controller as "you". Factories `to(permanents)`, `toYouAnd(permanents)`, `toEveryone()`, `dealtBy(filter)`, then `.from(filter)`, `.fromSourcesYouControl()`, `.fromSpells()`, `.fromInstantAndSorcerySpells()`, `.fromSourcesOfChosenColor()`, `.combatOnly()`, `.noncombatOnly()`, `.preventing(n | DynamicAmount)`.
