| `RedirectTargetCreatureNextDamageFromChosenSourceToControllerEffect` | `()` | activated-ability redirect: the next single damage event a chosen source would deal to the target creature this turn is dealt to the ability's controller (you) instead (Jade Monolith). permanent-targeting spec � the ability targets the protected creature; the source is chosen on resolution (prompts a battlefield permanent choice). Stores a next-event `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` (protected creature + chosen source + `NEXT_EVENT` amount + `redirectTargetId` = controller player) which `applyCreatureRedirectShields` redirects in full then consumes, over both combat and noncombat creature-damage paths. Like Oracle's Attendants' `RedirectTargetCreatureDamageFromChosenSourceToTargetEffect.toSource()` but redirects to the controller (a player) and only for the next single event. Cleared at turn cleanup |
| `RedirectNextCombatDamageFromTargetAttackingCreatureToSelfEffect` | `()` | activated-ability redirect: the next combat damage the target attacking creature would deal to the ability's source creature this turn is dealt to that attacker instead (Shield Dancer). The target is benign because it is the damage source; stores a source-specific, combat-only next-event `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` with the attacker as the redirect destination. Noncombat damage from that attacker does not consume the shield |
| `RedirectNextDamageEffect` | `(RedirectRole protectedRole, RedirectRole destinationRole, DynamicAmount amount, TargetPredicate declaredTarget[, PermanentPredicate targetPredicate])` | "The next `amount` damage that would be dealt to X this turn is dealt to Y instead", from ANY source (combat or noncombat), consumed once `amount` damage has been redirected. `RedirectNextDamageEffect.nextEvent(...)` is the next-event variant: it redirects the entire first damage event and then consumes the shield (Mirrorwood Treefolk). `RedirectRole` is `SOURCE_PERMANENT` / `TARGET` / `CONTROLLER` / `ENCHANTED_PERMANENT` (the permanent the Aura source is attached to) and fills both ends: `protectedRole` is whose damage is diverted, `destinationRole` who receives it. Installs an amount-limited or next-event `CreatureDamageRedirectShield` (`damageSourceId=null`) when the protected object is a permanent, or a `PlayerNextDamageRedirectShield` when it is a player (Martyrdom's any-target grant) — the former consumed by `DamagePreventionService.applyCreatureRedirectShields` in both the combat (`CombatDamageService.applyCombatCreatureDamage`) and noncombat (`DamageSupport.dealCreatureDamage`) creature-damage paths, the latter by `applyPlayerNextDamageRedirectShields` in the two player-damage paths. Both cleared at turn cleanup. `targetSpec()` is `harmful` exactly when `destinationRole == TARGET` (the target is the object that takes the damage, so CR 702.16b protection applies) and `benign` when the target is the one being shielded; `null` yields `TargetSpec.NONE`. An `int` convenience ctor wraps `Fixed`. Cards: Mirrorwood Treefolk (next event), Zhalfirin Crusader `(SOURCE_PERMANENT, TARGET, 1, ANY_TARGET)`, Zealous Inquisitor `(SOURCE_PERMANENT, TARGET, 1, CREATURE)`, Personal Incarnation `(SOURCE_PERMANENT, CONTROLLER, 1, NONE)`, Martyrdom `(TARGET, SOURCE_PERMANENT, 1, ANY_TARGET)`, Daughter of Autumn / Hazduhr the Abbot `(TARGET, SOURCE_PERMANENT, Fixed(1)/XValue(), CREATURE, whiteCreature)`, Vassal's Duty `(TARGET, CONTROLLER, Fixed(1), CREATURE)`, Ward of Piety `(ENCHANTED_PERMANENT, TARGET, 1, ANY_TARGET)` |
| `RedirectNextInstantOrSorceryDamageToControllerEffect` | `()` | activated ability: "the next time an instant or sorcery spell would deal damage to you this turn, that spell deals that damage to its controller instead" (Aegis of Honor). The normal-effect handler installs one shield keyed by the activating player; `DamageSupport.dealDamageToPlayer` consumes it only for direct `INSTANT_SPELL`/`SORCERY_SPELL` damage, changing the recipient to `StackEntry.controllerId`. Combat and permanent ability damage do not match. Cleared at turn cleanup and copied with `GameData` for AI simulation. |
| `GrantControllerKeywordEffect` | `(Keyword keyword)` | STATIC marker: the source's controller - the player, not the permanent - has `keyword`. No handler bean; read by `GameQueryService.playerHasShroud` / `playerHasHexproof`, which scan that player's battlefield for a matching grant. Only `SHROUD` (can't be targeted at all) and `HEXPROOF` (can't be targeted by opponents) are accepted; the compact ctor rejects any other keyword, since nothing would consult it. Used by True Believer and Ivory Mask (SHROUD), Leyline of Sanctity, Witchbane Orb, Shalai and Spirit of the Hearth (HEXPROOF) |
| `GrantControllerFlagbearerEffect` | `()` | STATIC marker: the source's controller is a Flagbearer. Read by `GameQueryService` while enforcing the Flagbearer target-choice rule; player targets are considered alongside Flagbearer permanents. Used by Enroll in the Coalition (`MB1` #4) |
| `GrantControllerKeywordUntilEndOfTurnEffect` | `(Keyword keyword[, Duration duration])`, `(keyword, PlayerSubject players, duration)`, `.eachPlayer(keyword)` | one-shot effect: the named players (the controller by default; "players gain hexproof", Everybody Lives!) have `SHROUD`, `HEXPROOF` or `FLYING` (Sarah's Wings' player float) until end of turn; a floating effect on each player, one log line each. `UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN`: "until your next turn" (Blossoming Calm). Used with `GrantKeywordEffect(HEXPROOF, Subjects.permanentsYouControl())` for "you and permanents you control gain hexproof" |
| `PreventOpponentCreatureWardTriggersEffect` | `()` | STATIC marker: ward abilities of creatures the controller's **opponents** control do not trigger (Nowhere to Run). No handler — read at targeting-trigger time via `GameQueryService.preventsOpponentCreatureWardTriggers(gameData, controllerId)`; suppresses printed Ward counter-unless effects and the engine's granted-Ward representation, but leaves unrelated counter-unless target triggers active |
| `IgnoreOpponentHexproofEffect` | `()` (opponents and permanents) / `(boolean opponents, Breadth permanents)`; `.opponentsCreatures()`, `.opponentsAndTheirCreatures()` | your spells and abilities can target [your opponents and] their hexproof [creatures / permanents] as though they didn't have hexproof (Kaya, Bane of the Dead; Glaring Spotlight, Nowhere to Run; Detection Tower floated by `GrantStaticEffectToPlayerEffect.untilEndOfTurn`). Shroud and protection untouched |
| `AllowTargetPlayerToTargetSourceIgnoringShroudEffect` | `()` | until end of turn, the source permanent can be the target of spells and abilities controlled by **target player** as though it didn't have shroud (Autumn Willow). Resolution makes a floating effect on the source naming that player (`GameData.mayTargetIgnoringShroud`), consulted by the shroud gates in `TargetLegalityService.untargetableReason` and `ValidTargetService.isBlockedByHexproofOrGrantedEffect`. Per player � every other player is still locked out � and ends at cleanup. Player-targeting spec (`TargetSpec.benign(PLAYER)`) |
| `CantBeEnchantedByOtherAurasEffect` | `()` / `(boolean auraSpellsOnly)` / `keepingExistingAuras()` | Static Aura restriction. Default prohibits attachment and puts already-attached Auras into the graveyard; `true` prohibits Aura spell targeting while permitting non-targeting attachment (Bartel Runeaxe); `keepingExistingAuras()` prohibits new attachment but leaves Auras already attached (Guardian Beast). Checked by the Aura attachment and spell-target legality paths. |
| `CantBeControlledByOtherPlayersEffect` | `()` | static marker: another player can't gain control of the permanent. No handler; read by `GameQueryService.cantBeControlledByOtherPlayers` at the central control-change gate. Usually granted through `GrantEffectEffect` (Guardian Beast) |
| `CantBeEquippedEffect` | `()` | static marker: the permanent can't have an Equipment attached to it (Goblin Brawler). No handler � read by the equipment attachment legality checks |
| `GrantControllerSpellsCantBeCounteredByColorsEffect` | `(Set<CardColor> colors)` | controller's spells can't be countered by spells of specified colors this turn (one-shot, cleared at end of turn) |
| `GrantControllerSpellsCantBeCounteredThisTurnEffect` | `()` | controller's spells can't be countered this turn (one-shot, cleared at end of turn) |
| `GrantControllerCreatureSpellsCantBeCounteredThisTurnEffect` | `()` | controller's creature spells can't be countered this turn (one-shot, cleared at end of turn) |
| `GrantControllerAndPermanentsHexproofFromColorsEffect` | `(Set<CardColor> colors)` / `chosenColor(PermanentSubject)` / `(colors, controllerToo, permanents, ofChosenColor)` | until end of turn, [the controller and] the permanents named gain hexproof from the colors (CR 702.11d), found once as it resolves; the default is "you and permanents you control" (Veil of Summer); `chosenColor(target() / source())` reads the color an earlier `ChooseColorAtResolutionEffect` chose, fixed as it applies (Mondo Gecko, Skrelv, Sungold Sentinel). Floated copies carry only the colors; read by `GameQueryService.hasHexproofFromColor` / `playerHasHexproofFromColor` |

| `PreventDamageFromTargetSpellEffect` | `(boolean gainLife, boolean instantSorceryOnly)` | targeted resolution effect: marks a spell in `GameData` so all damage dealt by that spell is prevented until turn cleanup. The no-arg form is instant/sorcery-only (Hidden Retreat); `withLifeGain()` targets any spell and has its controller gain life for each damage prevented (Hallow). Benign `SPELL_ON_STACK` target spec; Hidden Retreat further narrows its target with `StackEntryPredicateTargetFilter` |
| `PreventNextDamageToSourceFromCardEffect` | `(UUID damageSourceCardId)` / `()` (no-arg = the granting object, bound at activation) | granted activated ability payload: prevents the next 1 damage the named card object would deal to the ability's source permanent this turn. Used by Torrent of Lava's stack-only global creature ability grant. |
| `TargetedSpellDamagePreventionEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate condition())` | capability for a static effect that prevents damage to its permanent from spells that target it; the optional condition is evaluated against the protected permanent at damage time |
| `PreventDamageToSelfFromTargetingSpellsEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate condition)` / `()` | STATIC marker: prevents all damage dealt to the source permanent by a spell that targets it. The optional condition is dynamic; Bronze Horse uses `PermanentControllerControlsPermanentPredicate(PermanentIsCreaturePredicate, true)` for "as long as you control another creature". Applied in `DamageSupport.dealCreatureDamage`, so damage from abilities or spells not targeting the permanent is unaffected |
| `PreventDamageToTargetCreatureFromTargetingSpellOrAbilityEffect` | `()` | SPELL: protects the target creature for the turn from damage caused by a spell or ability that targets it, including damage dealt by another source. Writes a target-creature ID set consumed by the damage pipeline |
| `ReturnEnchantedCreatureToOwnerHandOnDeathEffect` | `()` or `(String followUpManaCost, String followUpPrompt)` | `Triggers.creatureDies(ObjectRelation.ENCHANTED)`: returns that card (the stack entry's triggering card, in the graveyard stay recorded as the ability triggered, CR 400.7) to its owner's hand. The optional follow-up payment is offered only after the creature was actually returned and, if paid, returns the source Aura from its owner's graveyard to its hand (the entry's triggering card id is then the Aura's). Used by Demonic Vigor and Puppet Master. |
| `RedirectNextDamageEffect.allThisTurn(protectedRole, destinationRole, declaredTarget)` | factory | "all damage that would be dealt to [a permanent] this turn is dealt to [destination] instead": an unlimited creature redirect shield for the turn. Sivvi's Valor `(TARGET, CONTROLLER, creature())` (benign target), Karona's Zealot `(SOURCE_PERMANENT, TARGET, creature())` (harmful target). A redirect to itself installs nothing |
| `RedirectAllDamageToEnchantedCreatureControllerEffect` | `()` | STATIC Aura marker: all damage that would be dealt to the enchanted creature is dealt to its current controller instead (Treacherous Link). The creature-damage paths query the attached Aura dynamically, so the replacement follows control changes and stops when the Aura is unattached or ignored |
| `RedirectAllCreatureDamageToControllerEffect` | `()` or pending damage choice payload | SPELL: this turn, its controller may redirect damage from any creature to themselves. Multiple controllers choose independently. Combat replacement choices preserve source characteristics and finish before state-based actions. Registers floating `RedirectAllCreatureDamageToControllerEffect` effects, cleared at turn cleanup. Used by Blood of the Martyr. |

| `WallOnlyTargetingRestrictionEffect` | `()` | static marker: the permanent cannot be targeted by a spell or ability whose legal targets are restricted to Walls. Enforced by the targeting services from announcement through resolution; modal spells use the union of their modes |

## Mana

Which permanents count and who taps them is the trigger: `Triggers.youTapLandForMana()` ("whenever you tap a land", Crypt Ghast with `.withFilter(new PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SWAMP))`), `playerTapsLandForMana().withFilter(...)` ("whenever a Forest is tapped", Vernal Bloom), `youTapThisLandForMana()`, `youTapCreatureForMana()`.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `AddManaWhenTappedForManaEffect` | `(ManaColor color)` | a tap-for-mana triggered mana ability's "add an additional {C}" / "its controller adds an additional {C}": the player who tapped the permanent (the entry's triggering player, CR 602.2) adds one mana of `color`, resolved at once by the tap-for-mana default (CR 605.4a). Groundchuck & Dirtbag (`youTapLandForMana()`), Crypt Ghast, Nissa, Nirkana Revenant (`youTapLandForMana().withFilter(subtype)`), Leyline of Abundance, Badgermole Cub (`youTapCreatureForMana()`); `ofItsController(color)` is "its controller adds": the tapped permanent's controller adds it (Vernal Bloom, Gauntlet of Might on `playerTapsLandForMana().withFilter(subtype)`; a player tapping another's land through Piracy is not its controller) |
| `AwardManaEffect` | `(ManaColor color, DynamicAmount amount)`, `(ManaColor color, int amount)`, or `(ManaColor color)` (defaults amount to 1) | add mana of the specified color; the quantity is a `DynamicAmount` (see "Dynamic amounts"). Flat: `(color)`/`(color, N)`. "for each X you control": `PermanentCount(filter, CountScope.CONTROLLER)`. "for each charge counter on it": `CountersOnSource(CounterType.CHARGE)` (Shrine of Boundless Growth). "equal to its power": `SourcePower()` (Marwyn, the Nurturer; Molten-Core Maestro). Implements `ManaProducingEffect`. Resolves inline for mana abilities (from the source permanent) and on the stack via `AwardManaEffectHandler` for triggered/loyalty mana (needs the stack entry's `sourcePermanentId`); dynamic amounts produce no mana when they evaluate to ? 0 and track creature mana when the source is a creature |
| `AwardManaToChosenPlayerEffect` | `(ManaColor color, int amount)` | "Choose a player. That player adds N mana of `color`." A mana ability (CR 605.1a) whose recipient may be any player � choosing a player is NOT targeting, so it resolves inline: `doResolveManaAbility` begins a `PermanentChoice` (validPlayerIds = all players) and `PermanentChoiceBattlefieldHandlerService.handleManaAbilityAddToChosenPlayer` routes the mana into the chosen player's pool (tracking creature mana when the source is a creature; Mana Reflection multiplier applied). Used by Valleymaker (`GREEN, 3`) |
| `AwardManaToActivePlayerEffect` | `(ManaColor color, int amount[, ManaRestriction restriction])`, `(ManaColor, DynamicAmount[, ManaRestriction])`; `.to(PlayerSubject recipient)` | "that player adds N mana of `color`": by default the stack entry's active player (recorded when the trigger was pushed), else the `recipient` (`triggeringPlayer()` for Tangleroot's caster, `targetPlayer()` for Jetfire's "target player adds", which declares a benign player target). Not a mana ability (CR 605.1a, 605.1b); an optional `ManaRestriction` routes the mana into its bucket |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` | `(DynamicAmount amount, ManaSpendRestriction restriction, CardSubtype subtype)` — sugar: `()`, `(int)`, `(DynamicAmount)`, `(int, ManaSpendRestriction)`, `(int, ManaSpendRestriction, CardSubtype)` | add N mana of any color (player chooses). Targeted stack abilities distinguish `targetsPlayer` (the effect needs a player target) from `manaRecipientIsTargetPlayer` (that target receives the mana), allowing Carpet of Flowers to count a targeted opponent while awarding mana to its controller and Radiant Lotus to award mana to its target. `restriction` is the CR 106.6 rider on that mana and also decides whether one pick colours the whole batch ("any one color") or the controller picks a colour per mana ("any combination of colors"): `NONE` = ordinary pool; `INSTANT_SORCERY_COPY` = ordinary pool, each unit tagged with `ManaCopyRider.INSTANT_OR_SORCERY_SPELL` (via `GameData.markPendingCopyRiderManaChoice` until the colour is chosen) so the instant/sorcery it pays for is copied once per unit (Primal Wellspring); `INSTANT_SORCERY_ONLY` → `ManaPool.instantSorceryOnlyColored` (Resonating Lute, granted to lands); `ARTIFACT_SPELLS_OR_ABILITIES` → per-color `ManaPool.artifactOnlyMana`, usable to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts (Vedalken Engineer); `FLASHBACK_ONLY` → `ManaPool.flashbackOnlyMana`, read by `ManaCost.canPayFlashback/payFlashback`, colour per mana (Altar of the Lost); `GRAVEYARD_SPELL_ONLY` → `ManaPool.graveyardOnlyMana`, temporarily promoted by `ManaCost.canPayFromGraveyard/payFromGraveyard` (Rootcoil Creeper); `CREATURE_SPELL_ONLY` → `ManaPool.creatureSpellOnlyMana`, read via the `creatureSpellOnlyContext` flag `SpellCastingService`/`GameActionAvailabilityService` set to `card.hasType(CREATURE)`; cannot pay ability costs (Ancient Ziggurat 1, Somberwald Sage 3); `CHOSEN_SUBTYPE_CREATURE` → `ManaPool.subtypeCreatureMana` keyed by the source's `ChooseSubtypeOnEnterEffect` type, read via `Set<CardSubtype> subtypeCreatureContext`; adds nothing when no type was chosen (Pillar of Origins, Unclaimed Territory); `CHOSEN_SUBTYPE_CREATURE_UNCOUNTERABLE` = the same, also recorded in `ManaPool.uncounterableSubtypeCreatureMana` (a marker subset never counted in totals) so spending it produces a `GameData.spellsMadeUncounterable` entry (Cavern of Souls); `SUBTYPE_SPELL` → the same `ManaPool.subtypeCreatureMana` bucket for the effect's own `subtype`, so it cannot pay abilities either; the type is printed on the card rather than chosen as the source entered (Sliver Hive `(1, SUBTYPE_SPELL, SLIVER)`); `SUBTYPE_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` → `ManaPool.subtypeSpellOrAbilityMana` for the effect's own `subtype`, read via `Set<CardSubtype> subtypeSpellOrAbilityContext` (spells **and** activated abilities), colour per mana (Smokebraider `(2, SUBTYPE_SPELL_OR_ABILITY, ELEMENTAL)`). `subtype` is set only for the two printed-subtype restrictions. Implements `ManaProducingEffect`; only the unrestricted Fixed-amount shape reports `estimatedCountsAllColors()`. Resolves inline as a mana ability (`ActivatedAbilityExecutionService.doResolveManaAbility`) and on the stack via `AwardAnyColorManaEffectHandler`; both go through `AnyColorManaChoiceSupport.beginColorChoice` |
| `ManaSpendRestriction.MULTICOLORED_SPELLS` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction.MULTICOLORED_SPELLS)` | routes chosen mana into `ManaPool.multicoloredSpellOnlyMana`; the bucket is exposed only while checking or paying a spell whose effective color count is at least two (Pillar of the Paruns) |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `DEVOID_SPELL` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction.DEVOID_SPELL)` | routes chosen mana into `ManaPool.devoidSpellOnlyMana`; the bucket is exposed only while checking or paying a spell with devoid (Corrupted Crossroads) |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `COMMANDER_COLOR_IDENTITY_WITH_ENTRY_COUNTERS` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction.COMMANDER_COLOR_IDENTITY_WITH_ENTRY_COUNTERS)` | chooses from the activating player's commander color identity and tags the regular mana; when spent to cast a designated commander, the prior command-zone cast count is recorded as additional +1/+1 counters for its battlefield entry (Opal Palace) |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect.ofDifferentColors(int)` | unrestricted mana with a separate color choice for each mana; each subsequent choice excludes colors already chosen | Firemind Vessel |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect.forNonHumanCreatureCounter(int)` | unrestricted mana with a separate mana-pool tag; each tagged mana spent to cast a non-Human creature records one additional +1/+1 counter for that creature's battlefield entry | Animal Attendant |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `LEGENDARY_SPELLS` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction.LEGENDARY_SPELLS)` | any-color mana spendable only to cast legendary spells; routes to the per-color `ManaPool.legendarySpellOnlyMana` bucket. Plaza of Heroes |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `LEGENDARY_SPELLS_UNCOUNTERABLE` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction.LEGENDARY_SPELLS_UNCOUNTERABLE)` | any-color mana spendable only to cast legendary spells, and the spell it pays for can't be countered; routes to `ManaPool.legendarySpellOnlyMana` plus its `uncounterableLegendarySpellMana` rider subset (`ManaRestriction.LegendarySpellsUncounterable`). Delighted Halfling |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `PARTY_SPELL_OR_ABILITY` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction)` | any-color mana spendable only for Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, or Wizard spells and activated abilities; uses the shared `ManaPool.partySpellOrAbilityMana` bucket. Base Camp |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `SPELL_ONLY` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction, boolean anyColorCombination)` | any-color mana with one color choice per mana, tagged in the regular pool so it can be spent only while casting spells; cannot pay activated ability costs. Leyline Immersion (MAT) |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `OUTSIDE_STARTING_DECK_SPELL_ONLY` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction, boolean anyColorCombination)` | any-color mana with one color choice per mana; the bucket is promoted only while casting a spell whose card ID is not in the controller's starting deck. The Mystical Archive (YSOS 30) |
| `AwardAnyColorManaEffect` restriction `SUBTYPE_CREATURE_SPELL` | `(int, ManaSpendRestriction, CardSubtype)` | any-color mana spendable only to cast creature spells of the effect's printed subtype; uses `ManaPool.subtypeCreatureMana` and cannot pay noncreature spells or abilities. The Seedcore (`PHYREXIAN`) |
| `AwardChosenColorManaEffect` | `()` or `(ManaRestriction)` | mana ability: adds one mana of the source permanent's chosen color, read from `Permanent.getChosenColor()`. | `ChooseNumberAtResolutionEffect` | `(int maxNumber)` / `(int minNumber, int maxNumber)`; `Integer.MAX_VALUE` for no upper bound | controller chooses the number during resolution; stored as the resolving stack entry's X value for a following effect (By Invitation Only, Volcano Hellion, Scrying Glass) |

| `AwardManaOfColorsEffect` | `(List<ManaColor> colors, DynamicAmount amount)` (int-amount sugar; default amount 1) | add `amount` mana, each chosen from the fixed `colors` list. Single-element list auto-adds (no prompt); otherwise begins `PendingInteraction.ColorChoice` via `fixedColorCombination` (re-prompts per pick). Implements `ManaProducingEffect`; resolves inline as a mana ability **and** on the stack via `AwardManaOfColorsEffectHandler` (Burnt Offering = `(List.of(BLACK, RED), new XValue())` after `SacrificeCreatureCost(true)`). Manaforge Cinder = `(List.of(BLACK, RED))`; Fire-Lit Thicket = `(List.of(RED, GREEN), 2)` |
| `RemoveCountersForManaEffect` | `(ManaColor color, CounterType counterType)` / `(List<ManaColor> colors, CounterType counterType)` | storage-land mana ability: choose 0..the available counters to remove, then add that much mana of the fixed color or choose each mana individually from the fixed color list. Implements `ManaProducingEffect`; the counter-removal choice is handled by `RemoveCountersForManaChoice`, and the multi-color continuation reuses `ManaColorChoice.fixedColorCombination`. | `ManaCopyRiderEffect` | `(ManaCopyRider rider)` | non-mana rider for a mana ability: tags every unit of mana the ability produces (`ManaPool.addCopyGrantingMana(rider, …)`); the spell (or, for `SPELL_OR_ABILITY`, non-mana ability) a tagged unit actually pays for is copied once per unit when it matches the rider — `SPELL_OR_ABILITY` (Sunken Palace), `INSTANT_OR_SORCERY_SPELL`, `RED_INSTANT_OR_SORCERY_SPELL` (Pyromancer’s Goggles) (CR 106.6a). A land's mana that lands only after a replacement prompt (order or color) keeps the rider: `LandManaEvent.copyRiders` carries it and `LandManaReplacementService` tags it when it lands. Units spent on anything else do nothing; untagged mana is spent first where the rider can't fire. Pair it with an `AwardManaEffect` in the same ability — Pyromancer’s Goggles is `List.of(new AwardManaEffect(ManaColor.RED), new ManaCopyRiderEffect(ManaCopyRider.RED_INSTANT_OR_SORCERY_SPELL))` |
| `AddManaOnEnchantedLandTapEffect` | `(ManaProducingEffect mana)` | on `Triggers.enchantedLandTappedForMana()`: the land's controller (as it is on the battlefield, else the player who tapped it) adds the mana described by `mana` (`AwardManaEffect`, `AwardAnyColorManaEffect`, `AwardManaOfColorsEffect`, `AwardChosenColorManaEffect`), its amount evaluated for that player and the Aura. `ArtifactSpells()` � `artifactOnlyColorless` (Grand Architect � cast artifact spells or activate artifact abilities); `ArtifactAbilities()` � `artifactAbilityOnlyColorless` (Soldevi Machinist � activate artifact abilities only); `SubtypeCreatureSpells(CardSubtype)` routes to the per-subtype/per-color `subtypeCreatureMana` bucket, spendable only on creature spells of that subtype (Gnarlroot Trapper, `(GREEN, 1, SubtypeCreatureSpells(ELF))`; `SubtypeSpells(CardSubtype)` routes to Myr-only colorless mana (Myr Reservoir); `KickedCosts()` � `kickedOnlyGreen` (Elfhame Druid); `XCosts()` � `xCostOnlyColorless` for colorless output or `xCostOnlyMana` for colored output (Rosheen Meanderer; Anina, Natural Parallelist); `ColoredSpellsWithoutX()` � `coloredSpellWithoutXOnlyColorless` (Titans' Nest); `CumulativeUpkeepCosts()` � `cumulativeUpkeepOnlyColorless` / `cumulativeUpkeepOnlyColored` (Adarkar Unicorn). `XCosts()` mana is usable only when the cost being paid contains an {X} symbol (`ManaCost.hasX()`), for any generic portion of that cost � spend logic gates on `hasX()` directly (no context flag), so it works for both X spells and X activated abilities. `ColoredSpellsWithoutX()` mana is usable only while casting a colored spell whose mana cost does not contain {X}; it is promoted into the ordinary colorless pool only for that cast. `CumulativeUpkeepCosts()` mana is usable only when paying a `PayManaCost` with `forCumulativeUpkeep=true` (from `CumulativeUpkeepEffect`) |

## Copy / clone

- `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect.fromAnyGraveyard(CardPredicate, String)` — optional copy replacement that chooses one matching card from any graveyard (Body Double); the chosen card stays in its graveyard.
- `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect.fromAnyGraveyard(CardPredicate, String, boolean entersTapped, Set<CardSubtype>)` — graveyard copy that enters tapped and gains the given subtypes only when it copies (Echoing Deeps).

- `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect.withVanishingIfCopiedPermanentLacksIt(PermanentPredicate, String)` — copy exception that adds vanishing 3, its three time counters, and its upkeep sacrifice trigger only when the chosen battlefield permanent lacks vanishing (Flesh Duplicate).

- `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect(PermanentPredicate, String, CardSupertype, boolean)` — copy exception overload that removes the given supertype and adds a +1/+1 counter to copied creatures and a loyalty counter to copied planeswalkers (Spark Double).

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `CopyPermanentOnEnterEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, DynamicAmount additionalPlusOnePlusOneCounters)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Integer powerOverride, Integer toughnessOverride)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Integer powerOverride, Integer toughnessOverride, Set<CardType> additionalTypesOverride)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Set<CardType> additionalTypesOverride, boolean copyPowerToughnessFromSource)` or `(PermanentPredicate filter, String typeLabel, Integer powerOverride, Integer toughnessOverride, Set<CardType> additionalTypesOverride, List<ActivatedAbility> additionalActivatedAbilities)` | enter as copy of permanent matching filter (Clone-style). Optional P/T overrides for "copy except it's X/Y" (e.g. Quicksilver Gargantuan). `copyPowerToughnessFromSource` uses the entering card's cast-mode P/T instead of the chosen permanent's P/T (Hulking Metamorph). Optional `additionalTypesOverride` for "copy except it's also an [type]" (e.g. Phyrexian Metamorph is always an artifact). Optional `additionalActivatedAbilities` for "copy except it has [ability]" (e.g. Evil Twin's destroy same-name ability). Optional `additionalPlusOnePlusOneCounters` for "except it enters with X additional +1/+1 counters" (Altered Ego) � applied only when the controller chooses to copy; declining leaves a 0/0 with no counters from this effect. Counters are placed in `CloneService` after the copy overwrite (so they survive the characteristics replacement) and before battlefield entry. The `(filter, typeLabel, Set<CardSubtype>, List<Ability>)` overload adds "except it's an [subtype] in addition to its other types and it has '[ability]'" (Phantasmal Image) � both are applied to the final copy in `CloneService`, only when the controller chooses to copy. Its boolean extension omits the copied color (Vesuvan Doppelganger) |

Optional `additionalTypesOverride` for "copy except it's also an [type]" (e.g. Phyrexian Metamorph is always an artifact). Optional `additionalActivatedAbilities` for "copy except it has [ability]" (e.g. Evil Twin's destroy same-name ability). Counters are placed in `CloneService` after the copy overwrite (so they survive the characteristics replacement) and before battlefield entry. The `(filter, typeLabel, Set<CardSubtype>, List<Ability>)` overload adds "except it's an [subtype] in addition to its other types and it has '[ability]'" (Phantasmal Image) � both are applied to the final copy in `CloneService`, only when the controller chooses to copy |

Filter form for `Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)` � carries the filter to restrict which spells can be targeted (e.g. Naru Meha uses `StackEntryAllOfPredicate(StackEntryTypeInPredicate(INSTANT, SORCERY), StackEntryControlledByPredicate())`). For "copy twice if cast from a graveyard" (Increasing Vengeance), add a base `CopySpellEffect()` plus `ConditionalEffect(new CastFromZone(Zone.GRAVEYARD), new CopySpellEffect())` rather than a count parameter. `tokenWithHaste=true` (for copying a **creature** spell): the copy becomes a token, gains `HASTE`, and the retarget prompt is suppressed; with `sacrificeAtEndStep=true` the resulting permanent is sacrificed by a delayed triggered ability for the next end step (Choreographed Sparks). `forTargetSpellController()` makes the copy controlled by the target spell's controller and is used by Meletis Charlatan. ## Enchantment-specific

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `PutAuraFromHandOntoSelfEffect` | `()` | put an aura from hand onto this creature (ETB). Also `(Subjects.triggering())` attaches to the creature the trigger was about (Holy Avenger). |
| `AuraSwapEffect` | `()` | offers to exchange the source Aura with an eligible Aura card in its controller's hand; the chosen Aura enters attached to the source Aura's enchanted permanent and the source Aura returns to its owner's hand |
| `EquipmentSwapEffect` | `()` | offers to exchange the source Equipment with an eligible Equipment card in its controller's hand; the chosen Equipment enters attached to the source Equipment's equipped creature, or unattached when the source is unattached, and the source Equipment returns to its owner's hand |
| `PutAuraFromHandOntoSelfWithinXManaValueOrExileEffect` | `()` | Evershrike: "You may put an Aura card with mana value X or less from your hand onto the battlefield attached to this creature. If you don't, exile this creature." The mana-value cap is the ability's paid X (`entry.getXValue()`); only Aura cards with `getManaValue() <= X` are offered. Declining, or having no eligible Aura, exiles the source (via the `exileSourceIfDeclinedId` field on `PendingInteraction.TargetedHandCardChoice`). Pair after a self-return-to-battlefield `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect` in a graveyard activated ability |
| `ChangeColorTextEffect` | `(boolean colorWordsAllowed, boolean landTypesAllowed, boolean canTargetSpell[, boolean untilEndOfTurn])` | change color words (when `colorWordsAllowed`) and/or basic land type words (when `landTypesAllowed`) in target permanent's text (Mind Bend = `(true, true, false)` / Sleight of Mind-style; Magical Hack = `(false, true, true)`, land types only). When `canTargetSpell` the target may instead be a spell on the stack (Glamerdye = `(true, false, true)`, color words only): the change is recorded in `gameData.spellTextReplacements` keyed by the spell's card id and carried onto the permanent it resolves into by `BattlefieldEntryService` (CR 613.7); on an instant/sorcery it is an inert no-op. Resolution puts a floating `TextChangeEffect(fromWord, toWord)` on the permanent (`GameData.textReplacements` reads them in timestamp order) — a CR 613 layer-3 text change: `TextChangeTransformer` rewrites the words of every effect instance the permanent contributes before layers 4–7 apply them, and its own printed protection/basic land types are seeded rewritten. With no stated duration it lasts as long as the permanent stays on the battlefield (CR 611.2a, 400.7), NOT copiable (CR 707.2). Pass `untilEndOfTurn = true` (Whim of Volrath = `(true, true, false, true)`) to make it an `UNTIL_END_OF_TURN` effect instead. A "spell or permanent" single target is routed by zone inference in `SpellCastingService` (hand + retrace paths) via `TargetLegalityService.isSpellOnStack`. See the layer 3 text changes in `agent-docs/LAYER_SYSTEM.md` for the covered effect types |

## Equipment

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `EquipEffect` | `()` / `reconfigure(TargetPredicate)` | equip to target creature. Prefer using `EquipActivatedAbility(manaCost)` for ordinary equip; `reconfigure` permits an Equipment creature to attach itself while retaining the supplied target predicate |
| `EquipAbilitiesCanBeActivatedAtInstantSpeedEffect` | `()` | STATIC controller-scoped permission: the controller may activate equip abilities of Equipment they control at instant speed. Queried by `GameQueryService`; used by Leonin Shikari |
| `StaticBoostEffect` | `(int powerBoost, int toughnessBoost, Subjects.attachedCreature())` | equipped creature gets +X/+Y (static). See Boost Effects section for full constructor signatures |
| `AttachedBoostEffect` | `(DynamicAmount powerBoost, DynamicAmount toughnessBoost, Subjects.attachedCreature())` | equipped creature gets +X/+Y where the amounts are `DynamicAmount`s (static). Collapsed the `BoostCreaturePer*` family; amounts evaluate against the Equipment's controller (see Boost Effects section). Bonehoard/Runechanter's Pike (`CardsInGraveyard`), Blackblade Reforged (`PermanentCount(PermanentIsLandPredicate, CONTROLLER)`), Lashwrithe (`PermanentCount(PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(SWAMP), CONTROLLER)`), Strata Scythe (`LandsMatchingImprintedName()`) |
| `Triggers.becomesUnattachedFromPermanent()` | trigger | "whenever this Equipment becomes unattached from a permanent": the card's own triggered ability (`UnattachTriggerSupport` puts each such ability on the stack whole, with the permanent it was attached to as the entry's triggering permanent). "Sacrifice that permanent" is `SacrificeSelfEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent()`, "destroy that permanent" `DestroyTargetPermanentEffect(Subjects.triggering())`; the permanent stays until the ability resolves |
| `SacrificeSelfEffect.ofTriggeringPermanent` | `()` / `(boolean currentControllerSacrifices, CreateTokenEffect token)` | `SacrificeSelfEffect` with `Subjects.triggering()`: sacrifice the permanent that fired this trigger (`StackEntry.triggeringPermanentId`), only if the ability controller still controls it (CR 701.21a) and it can be sacrificed. Non-targeting; used by the sacrifice-on-unattach trigger (Grafted Wargear, Stitcher's Graft) |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` / `(CardEffect thenEffect, boolean thenEffectOptionalTarget)` / `(PermanentSubject equipment, PermanentSubject host[, PermanentPredicate targetPredicate])` | the attach verb (CR 701.3a): attaches each Aura, Equipment or Fortification `equipment` names (one, or a set: `controlledBy(...)`, `thisWay(CHOOSE)`) to one host (`source()`, `target()`, `triggering()`, `triggeringOrSource()`, `thisWay(kind)`, `returnedThisResolution()`) or, through `.toPlayer(attachments, player)`, to a player (`equipment` `source()`, `host` `target()` by default; other shapes in the rows below). Legality per kind is `EquipSupport.canAttach` / `canAttachToPlayer` (enchant ability, CR 303.4d; CR 301.5c; CR 301.6; protection, CR 702.16c-d); one that can't be attached, or is already attached to the host, doesn't move (CR 701.3b); a moved one gets a new timestamp (CR 613.7e), and control is reconciled when it carries a control effect. Records `StepKind.ATTACH` (the attachments that moved: "if you do" is `HappenedThisWay(ATTACH)`). When configured, queues `thenEffect` as a reflexive ability only after the attachment succeeds. Used by equipment with "When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control" (Triggers.enters(ObjectRelation.THIS)), including Novel Nunchaku's attach-then-fight rider, or "Whenever equipped creature dies, attach this Equipment to target creature you control" (Triggers.creatureDies(EQUIPPED)). |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect()` on a Fortification | `()` | "Fortify: attach this Fortification to target land you control": the attach verb judges Fortification legality (a land, not itself, not a creature that isn't a land, protection; CR 301.6, 702.16d); the ability's `TargetFilters.landYouControl()` restricts the target (C.A.M.P., Darksteel Garrison) |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect` | `(Subjects.triggering(), Subjects.target())` | attach the Equipment the trigger event was about ("whenever an Equipment you control enters, you may attach it to target creature you control") to the target creature. Sigarda's Aid, Hammer of Nazahn |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect.forTriggeringCreature()` | `()` | attach this Equipment to the stack entry's triggering permanent, not targeted: "whenever a [subtype] creature enters, you may attach this Equipment to it" is `MayEffect(….forTriggeringCreature(), …)` (Cloak and Dagger), the mandatory form bare (Ronin Warclub) |
| `CloakTopCardOfControllerLibraryEffect` + `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect(source(), thisWay(MANIFEST))` | _compose_ | "cloak the top card of your library, then attach this Equipment to it" (Cryptic Coat): the cloak records MANIFEST |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToChosenPermanentEffect` | `()` | non-targeting attachment continuation; reads the chosen permanent recorded on the parked stack entry and reuses standard Equipment legality and attachment handling |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect(source(), returnedThisResolution())` | _parameters_ | "return target creature card ... to the battlefield and attach this Equipment to it" after `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect` (Pre-War Formalwear) |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect()` / `.forTriggeringCreature()` on an Aura | `()` | "attach this Aura to target creature", "[you may] attach this Aura to that creature": the attach verb over the source Aura, judged by its enchant ability with its controller (Detainment Spell, Stasis Cell, Kjeldoran Pride, Felidar Umbra, Bound by Moonsilver; Prison Term and Shielded by Faith in a `MayEffect`, Illusory Gains bare, Brilliant Wings in a `UnlessPaysEffect`); a control Aura reconciles control as it moves |
| `AttachAllAurasToAnotherPermanentEffect` | `()` | targeted ETB (targets any permanent): move **all** Auras enchanting the targeted permanent onto another permanent controlled by the same player that every one of those Auras can legally enchant. On resolution collects the Auras, computes valid recipients (same controller, passes every Aura's enchant filter), and prompts the controller via `PermanentChoiceContext.AttachAllAurasToAnotherPermanent`; each Aura gets a new timestamp (CR 613.7e) and control is recomputed. No Auras, or no legal recipient � nothing moves. Used by Glamer Spinners. |
| `AttachTargetAuraToAnotherPermanentWithSameControllerEffect` | `()` | activated ability: move the targeted Aura to another permanent controlled by the current host's controller. The Aura must be attached to a permanent; the ability controller chooses a different legal destination during resolution via `PermanentChoiceContext.AttachTargetAuraToAnotherPermanentWithSameController`. Used by Simic Guildmage. |
| `CreateTokenAndAttachTriggeringAuraEffect` | `(CreateTokenEffect token)` | Ajani's Chosen: "create a 2/2 white Cat creature token. If that enchantment is an Aura, you may attach it to the token." `Triggers.enters(Triggers.ENCHANTMENT, ObjectRelation.ANOTHER_YOU_CONTROL)`, non-targeting. Creates the blueprint's token, then reads `StackEntry.triggeringCardId` (set as the ability triggers) to find the entering enchantment's permanent; when it is an Aura still on the battlefield that `AuraAttachmentService.canEnchant` accepts for the token (CR 701.3a), it raises the shared attachment prompt (`InteractionState.setPendingEquipmentAttach` + a `PendingMayAbility`, the same flow Auriok Survivors uses), which reattaches with a fresh timestamp (CR 613.7e). Implements `TokenCreatingEffect` by delegating to the blueprint |
| `AttachAurasToSourceEffect` | `()` | non-targeting: the controller picks any number of Auras out of one pool � every Aura permanent on the battlefield (any controller) plus every Aura card in the controller's graveyard and hand � and each pick is attached to the source permanent; graveyard/hand cards enter the battlefield already attached. Only Auras that could legally enchant the source are offered (CR 701.3a) and Auras already on it are skipped (CR 701.3b), so no pick can fail to move. One `PendingInteraction.AttachAurasChoice` prompt (mixed-zone `MultiCardPick`, ids are *card* ids). Battlefield Auras get a new timestamp (CR 613.7e) and control is recomputed after any move. Put on `Triggers.attacks()` + `Triggers.blocks()` for "whenever this creature attacks or blocks". Used by Bruna, Light of Alabaster. `oneAuraOrEquipmentFromHandOrGraveyard()` enables a single legal Aura or Equipment card from the controller's hand or graveyard to enter attached to the source, used by Danitha, Benalia's Hope. |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect` | `(Subjects.target(0), Subjects.target(1))` / `(Subjects.target(1), Subjects.target(0))` | attach target Equipment to target creature; the subjects name the two target groups (Equipment group first, or creature group first: Stolen Uniform) |
| `AttachTargetEquipmentToCreatedPermanentEffect` | `()` | attach the target Equipment to the first permanent created earlier by the same resolution; used by Grip of Phyresis |
| `ChoosePermanentsEffect.exactly(1, Equipment you control).thatCanBeAttachedTo(target())` + `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect(thisWay(CHOOSE), target())` | _compose_ | "you may attach an Equipment you control to it" inside the `MayEffect` (Resolute Strike, Vow to Erebor); "If you do, unattach it at the beginning of the next end step" adds `ConditionalEffect(new HappenedThisWay(ATTACH), RegisterDelayedStepTriggerEffect.aboutAtNext(Triggers.endStep(ANY), thisWay(ATTACH), new UnattachEquipmentFromTargetPermanentsEffect(Subjects.triggering())))` (Unexpected Request) |
| `ChoosePermanentsEffect.exactly(1, Equipment you control).thatCanBeAttachedTo(source())` + `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect(thisWay(CHOOSE), source())` | _compose_ | "then you may attach an Equipment you control to [this creature]" (Yuffie; after a put step returned it, `returnedThisResolution()` in place of `source()`: Winter Soldier) |
| `AttachAnyNumberOfControlledEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect` | `()` / `(PermanentSubject subject)` (a creature that is no target: `thisWay(CHOOSE)`, Armed and Armored) | choose any number of legally attachable Equipment controlled by the effect controller and attach them to the already-targeted creature; uses the shared multi-permanent choice flow and is used by Beatrix, Loyal General |
| `UnattachEquipmentEffect` | `(UUID equipmentId)` / `source()` | non-targeting delayed follow-up that unattaches the remembered Equipment if it is still attached; `source()` resolves the activated ability's source permanent |
| `AttachTargetEquipmentsToTargetCreatureThenEffect` | `(CardEffect thenEffect)` / `(CardEffect thenEffect, int creatureTargetGroup, int equipmentTargetGroup)` | attach every legal targeted Equipment to the targeted creature, then queue the supplied reflexive ability only when at least one Equipment became attached. Used by Thorin, Mountain-king |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect.targetEquipmentToTriggeringOrSource()` | `()` | attach each targeted Equipment to the permanent the trigger event was about, else (its own event) this creature. Kemba, Kha Enduring, Super-Soldier Serum, Sokka and Suki, Amy Rose, Armory Automaton (in a `MayEffect`); `actsOnlyOnItsTargets()` is `true`, so a `MayEffect` wrapping it isn't asked when no Equipment was chosen. `(Subjects.target(), Subjects.source())` attaches target Equipment you control to this creature (Captain America, Cloud, Sokka and Suki) |
| `AttachTargetAuraToAnotherPermanentOfSameTypeEffect` | `([boolean creaturesOnly])` | move a targeted Aura to another legal creature or land sharing the old host's type; `creaturesOnly=true` requires the destination to be a creature (Crown of the Ages), default allows creature or land (Enchantment Alteration); destination is chosen during resolution. |
| `AttachSourceEquipmentToTargetCreatureEffect(Subjects.target(0), Subjects.target(1))` on an Aura | _parameters_ | "attach target Aura you control to target creature" (Aura Finesse), "target Aura or Equipment ... to target creature you control" (Codsworth, Halvar): legality per kind (CR 701.3a) |
| `SacrificeSourceEquipmentCost` | `()` | cost effect that sacrifices the equipment granting this ability (not the equipped creature). Used for equipment-granted abilities like Blazing Torch's "{T}, Sacrifice Blazing Torch: ..." where the creature activates the ability but the equipment is sacrificed. The source equipment is identified via `ActivatedAbility.grantSourcePermanentId`, which is set automatically by the static bonus system |
| `ExileSourceEquipmentCost` | `()` | cost effect that exiles the Equipment granting this ability (not the equipped creature). The source equipment is identified via `ActivatedAbility.grantSourcePermanentId`, which is set automatically by the static bonus system |
| `TapGrantingEquipmentCost` | `()` | cost effect that taps the Equipment granting an activated ability, identified via `ActivatedAbility.grantSourcePermanentId`; pair with the activating creature's normal tap cost when both permanents must be tapped (Fishing Pole) |
| `UnattachSourceEquipmentCost` | `()` | cost effect that unattaches the equipment granting this ability. Used for equipment-granted abilities like Blinding Powder's "Unattach Blinding Powder: ..."; the source equipment is identified via `ActivatedAbility.grantSourcePermanentId` and remains on the battlefield unattached |

`SpellsAndLandsWithSpecifiedNamesCantBePlayedEffect(Set<String> cardNames)` is a symmetric STATIC restriction for a fixed roster: spells and lands with listed names can't be cast/played, including basic lands (City in a Bottle). It uses the shared `CardNameRestrictionEffect` permission path.

## Static restrictions / taxes

`GrantNoMaximumHandSizeEffect(duration)` is the one-shot hand-size grant for the resolving
controller, `PERMANENT` or `UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN`. It is distinct from `NoMaximumHandSizeEffect`,
which is a static permanent effect lasting only while its permanent is on the battlefield.

| Effect | Constructor | Intent |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| `CantCastSpellsWithSameNameAsExiledCardEffect` | `()` or `(boolean opponentsOnly)` | prevents casting spells with the same name as a card exiled with or imprinted on the source permanent. When `opponentsOnly=false` (default), restricts all players (Exclusion Ritual); when `opponentsOnly=true`, only opponents of the source's controller are restricted (Ixalan's Binding, Godsend) |
| `SpellsWithChosenNameCantBeCastEffect` | `()`, `(boolean opponentsOnly[, boolean landsToo])` or `spellsAndLands()` | spells with the name(s) chosen on the source permanent (`chosenName`, `secondChosenName`) can't be cast (static); `landsToo` also stops land plays with those names (Null Chamber, read by `CastingPermissionService.isLandPlayForbiddenByChosenName`). Default (`opponentsOnly=false`) restricts every player, incl. the controller (Nevermore); `true` restricts only the controller's opponents (Gideon's Intervention). Enforced in `CastingPermissionService.getForbiddenCardNames` |
| `SpellsAndNonbasicLandsWithNontokenPermanentNamesCantBePlayedEffect` | `()` | static, symmetric: spells and nonbasic lands can't be cast/played when their name matches any nontoken permanent on the battlefield (Cornered Market). Names are recomputed from the battlefield; token names and spells on the stack do not contribute. The cast side uses `CastingPermissionService.getForbiddenCardNames`; the land side uses `CastingPermissionService.isLandPlayForbiddenByChosenName` because land plays bypass spell filters |
| `IncreaseSpellCostEffect` + `CardHasSourceChosenNamePredicate` | `(2, CostModificationScope.OPPONENT)` | STATIC; opponents' spells whose name equals the source permanent's chosen name cost two generic mana more (Anointed Peacekeeper) |
| `PlayerHasProtectionEffect` | `(Quality from)` | static "you have protection from [quality]": `EACH_OPPONENT` (Absolute Virtue: every object an opponent controls, and every object an opponent owns that no player controls, CR 702.16k) or `CHOSEN_NAME` (Runed Halo, with `ChooseCardNameOnEnterEffect()`: the source's name; a face-down source has none). Printed, it protects the permanent's controller, never the permanent; floated by `GrantStaticEffectToPlayerEffect`, the player it is on. Read with every other player protection by `GameQueryService.playerProtectionFrom` (targeting, Aura attachment, damage prevention) |
| `ProtectionFromChosenPlayerEffect` | `()` | static: the source permanent has protection from the player chosen as it entered (True-Name Nemesis). The selected player ID is the permanent's `chosenPlayerIds`; the shared protection query covers targeting, damage, combat, and Aura attachment. Pair with `ChoosePlayerOnEnterEffect()` |
| `PreventDamageFromNamedPlanesToControlledPermanentsEffect` | `(String planeName)` | resolving planar ability: for the rest of the game, prevent damage from face-up planes with the given name to permanents controlled by the ability's controller. Stored per player and checked against the `StackEntry`'s `PlanarObject` source. Used by Mount Keralia. |
| `ReduceSpellDamageEffect` | `(int amount)` | static replacement effect: "If a spell would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage minus `amount` to that permanent or player instead" (Benevolent Unicorn). Global � any permanent carrying it reduces every spell's damage regardless of controller. Applies to all spell stack-entry types dealing damage as themselves; combat damage, activated/triggered abilities, and fight/bite damage from a permanent `damageSource` are unaffected. Not gated on `isDamagePreventable` (replacement, not prevention). Multiple instances stack. Queried by `GameQueryService.getSpellDamageReduction` from `DamageSupport.dealCreatureDamage` / `dealDamageToPlayer` |
| `ReplaceInstantOrSorceryDamageToControllerEffect` | `(int threshold, int replacementDamage)` | static replacement effect: qualifying damage from an instant or sorcery source (the spell, or an ability of an instant or sorcery card) to the carrying permanent's controller becomes `replacementDamage` instead. Damage to permanents, combat damage, and damage caused by a permanent are unaffected. Queried through `PlayerDamageReplacementEffect` by `GameQueryService.applyDamageReplacementEffects`; Forethought Amulet uses `(3, 2)` |
| `CantCastSpellTypeEffect` | `(Set<CardType> restrictedTypes)` / `(Set<CardType> restrictedTypes, boolean appliesToAllPlayers)` | can't cast spells of the specified types (static). Default (`appliesToAllPlayers=false`) restricts only the source's controller (Steel Golem: "You can't cast creature spells"); pass `true` for a symmetric restriction affecting every player (Aether Storm: "Creature spells can't be cast"). Enforced in `CastingPermissionService.getRestrictedSpellTypes` |
| `OpponentsCantCastSpellsMatchingPredicateEffect` | `(CardPredicate predicate[, PlayerSubject players])` | static: the players `players` names can't cast spells matching `predicate` (default `eachOpponent()`; `eachPlayer()` Archon of Valor's Reach; `controllerOf(attached())` Brand of Ill Omen's enchanted creature's controller); evaluated through `PredicateEvaluationService` with the source context and enforced in every cast-permission path (Llawan, Void Winnower; `CardHasSourceChosenColorPredicate` Iona; `CardMaxManaValuePredicate(3, true)` Brisela). The chosen X counts; before X is chosen an {X} spell is stopped only if every X would be. A `CardManaValueAtMostAmountPredicate` amount (under `CardNotPredicate` for "greater than") is evaluated for the casting player (Angel of Eternal Dawn, Lavinia). |
| `CantCastSpellsSharingColorWithMostRecentSpellEffect` | `()` | symmetric static restriction: players can't cast spells sharing a color with the most recently cast spell this turn; colorless spells share no colors. The most recent spell's colors are the ones it had as it was cast (`GameData.getSpellColorsWhenCast`, recorded by `SpellEvents.cast`). Enforced in `CastingPermissionService` |
| `CantCastSpellsSharingCardTypeWithTopCardEffect` | `()` | symmetric static restriction used by a plane: players can't cast spells that share a card type with a card on top of any library. Land plays and empty libraries are unaffected. Enforced in `CastingPermissionService` |
| `NoncreatureSpellsCantBeCastEffect` | `(int minManaValue, boolean restrictXSpells)` | global/symmetric: no player (incl. controller) can cast a noncreature spell with mana value >= `minManaValue`, or (if `restrictXSpells`) a noncreature spell with `{X}` in its cost. Gaddock Teeg uses `(4, true)`. Enforced via `CastingPermissionService.isNoncreatureSpellCastRestricted` at the hand/exile/library-top playable sites |
| `CantSearchLibrariesEffect` | `(PlayerSubject players, boolean payableToIgnore)` / `(boolean payableToIgnore)` / `()` | the named players (`you()`, `eachPlayer()` default, `eachOpponent()`: Stranglehold `(eachOpponent(), false)`) can't search libraries (static). `payableToIgnore=true` (no-arg default, Leonin Arbiter): any player may pay {2} to ignore it until end of turn; `false` (Mindlock Orb) is absolute. "Players can't search libraries this turn" (Shadow of Doubt) is `GrantStaticEffectToPlayerEffect(new CantSearchLibrariesEffect(you(), false), eachPlayer(), UNTIL_END_OF_TURN)` (a floated copy reads "you" as its player). Read by `LibrarySearchRestrictions.find` |
| `OpponentSearchesTopCardsInsteadEffect` | `(int count)` | static: when an opponent of this permanent's controller would search ANY library, they search only the top `count` cards of that library instead (Aven Mindcensor, `count=4`). Passive rules-modifier (like `CantSearchLibrariesEffect`) � no `NormalEffectHandlerBean`; read at search-initiation time in `LibrarySearchSupport.sendLibrarySearchToPlayer`, which narrows the candidate list to the top-N of the searched library (owner = `params.targetPlayerId()` else searcher) and, if that becomes empty, ends the search with nothing found + shuffle. A player's own copy never limits their own searches |
| `OppositionAgentEffect` | `()` | static: while an opponent searches their own library, the source controller controls the search and chooses the found cards. Those cards are exiled face up and the source controller may play them for as long as they remain exiled, using mana of any type for spells. The shared search interaction is redirected to that controller; repeated finds preserve the target library and permission, and the latest battlefield timestamp wins when multiple Agents apply |
| `PlayersCannotDrawCardsEffect` | `()` | players can't draw cards (static, Omen Machine, Maralen of the Mornsong) |
| `OpponentsCanDrawOnlyOneCardEachTurnEffect` | `()` | the source controller's opponents can't draw more than one card each turn (static, Narset, Parter of Veils); uses `DrawRestrictionEffect` source-controller scoping and the actual per-player `GameData.cardsDrawnThisTurn` count. Also `(Subjects.eachPlayer())` is "each player can't draw more than one card each turn" (Spirit of the Labyrinth). |
| `DrawPerSourceCounterThenDamageEffect` | `(CounterType counterType)` | Triggers.drawStep(ActivePlayer.OPPONENT): the draw-step player (`entry.getTargetId()`) draws one extra card per `counterType` counter on the source, then the source deals that much damage to them. Also a `DamageDealingEffect` (`CountersOnSource`, players only). Malignant Growth (`CounterType.GROWTH`) |
| `LimitSpellsPerTurnEffect` | `(int maxSpells, SpellLimitScope[, CardPredicate spellFilter])` | the players selected by `scope` can cast at most N matching spells per turn (static). A null filter counts every spell; otherwise only matching spells count. `SpellLimitScope`: `EACH_PLAYER` = every player globally (Rule of Law, Arcane Laboratory, Deafening Silence); `CONTROLLER` = only the source's controller (Colfenor's Plans, "You can't cast more than one spell each turn"); `ENCHANTED_PLAYER` = only the player enchanted by the source Aura (Curse of Exhaustion). Enforced in `CastingPermissionService.isSpellLimitReached`; unfiltered limits are also exposed by `getMaxSpellsPerTurn` for aggregate callers |
| `LimitControllerToOneMoreSpellThisTurnEffect` | `()` | spell effect that limits its controller to one additional spell for the rest of the turn; the absolute cap is recorded on resolution and combines with other caps by taking the lowest |
| `SkipDrawStepEffect` | `()` / `(SkipStepOrPhaseKind kind)` / `(kind, PlayerSubject players)` | "skip your draw step" (Colfenor's Plans, Necropotence), "players skip their upkeep steps" (Eon Hub, `UPKEEP_STEP`, `eachPlayer()`), "players skip their untap steps" (Stasis, Sands of Time, a plane's too: The Eon Fog; `UNTAP_STEP`, the whole step with its phasing, read by `UntapStepService.playersSkipUntapStepApplies` for the active player); hellbent in a `ConditionalEffect` (Gibbering Descent). Floated on a player (`GrantStaticEffectToPlayerEffect`, Fatespinner's chosen `DRAW_STEP` / `MAIN_PHASE` / `COMBAT_PHASE` this turn; `SkipNextEffect`'s combat form) it is that player's, read by `GameData.skipsStepOrPhase`. Static reads skip face-down and ability-less sources |
| `SkipNextEffect` | `(SkipKind kind, PlayerSubject player)` or `(SkipKind kind)` (= `you()`) | the whole one-shot "skips their next …" family: makes one floating effect on each player the subject names (`Duration.PERMANENT`) that the turn engine uses up as it applies (`GameData.applySkipNext`; tests count them with `skipNextCount`). Skipping proceeds past the turn/step/phase as though it did not exist (CR 500.11 / 614.10) and stacks rather than collapsing (CR 614.10a). `SkipKind`: `TURN`, used up in `TurnProgressionService.advanceTurn` when that player's turn would begin (pending Mindslaver waits per CR 724.1b) — Chronatog, Meditate; `UNTAP_STEP`, used up in `advanceTurn` when that player next becomes active, so phasing doesn't happen either (CR 702.26m) and no untap-restriction choice (Storage Matrix, Static Orb) is offered — the same path Sands of Time's `SkipDrawStepEffect(UNTAP_STEP, eachPlayer())` uses — Yosei, the Morning Star; `DRAW_STEP`, used up in `StepTriggerService.handleDrawStep` (whole step: no turn-based draw, no draw-step triggers) — Ivory Gargoyle; `COMBAT_PHASE`, used up by `TurnProgressionService.advanceStep` when that player leaves precombat main so they jump straight to postcombat main — Blinding Angel, False Peace, Empty City Ruse, Stonehorn Dignitary. `player`: `you()`, `triggeringPlayer()` ("that player" of a combat-damage trigger, no targeting; Blinding Angel), `eachOpponent()` (Brine Elemental), `targetPlayer()` (the only one declaring a benign `PLAYER` spec). Distinct from the static marker `SkipDrawStepEffect(SkipStepOrPhaseKind, PlayerSubject)` (lifetime = source on the battlefield) and from `SkipNextUntapEffect`, which marks individual permanents while the untap step itself still happens |
| `TargetPlayerChoosesOneEffect` | `(List<ChooseOneOption> options)` or `(List<ChooseOneOption> options, boolean targetsPlayer)`, `villainousChoiceFacedBy(players, options)` = each of them faces it in turn (CR 701.55d), "that player" in an option being `targetPlayerDeclaredElsewhere()` | resolution-time modal choice made by the stack entry's `targetId` when present, otherwise its controller; `forTargetedPlayer(List<ChooseOneOption>)` marks the chooser as a targeted player for cast-time targeting. The options are reused by the shared mode-choice interaction. `forTargetedPlayerVillainousChoice(List<ChooseOneOption>)` (canonical form `(options, targetsPlayer, villainousChoice)`) makes that player face a villainous choice so villainous-choice repetition (The Valeyard) applies. Fatespinner, Risk Factor, Damocles Base, Sword of Kang |
| `IslandSanctuaryEffect` | `()` | static draw replacement (`MaySkipDrawReplacementEffect` with `drawStepOnly()`, never resolved). `StepTriggerService.handleDrawStep` offers the controller a may-ability to skip the draw-step draw; accepting stamps an `UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN` player-scoped `CreaturesCantAttackControllerUnlessPredicateEffect(PermanentAnyOfPredicate(flying, islandwalk))` floating effect. Used by Island Sanctuary. The attack shield is checked in `CombatAttackService.isCantAttackDefenderDueToRestriction`, which scans both defender static abilities and player-scoped floating effects |
| `FastingEffect` | `()` | static draw-step replacement (`MaySkipDrawReplacementEffect` with `drawStepOnly()`, never resolved). Its may-ability replaces the controller's entire draw step; accepting gains 2 life and suppresses draw-step triggers, while declining performs the normal draw. Used by Fasting |
| `IncreaseSpellCostEffect` | `(CardPredicate predicate, DynamicAmount amount, CostModificationScope scope)` / sugar `(predicate, int amount, scope)` / `(predicate, String manaCost, scope)` | spells matching the predicate cost the evaluated amount of additional generic mana or the fixed mana cost. The amount is evaluated against the source permanent, so `PermanentCount(PermanentIsArtifactPredicate(), CONTROLLER)` models Hum of the Radix's per-artifact tax. The string overload preserves colored requirements (Derelor uses `"{B}"`). The tax-side mirror of `ReduceCastCostForMatchingSpellsEffect`, sharing its `CostModificationScope`: `ALL` = every player; `SELF` = only the source's controller; `OPPONENT` = only the controller's opponents. Because the predicate runs through `CardTypePredicate` (`hasType`), a multi-type spell is taxed by any of its types. Handled by `IncreaseSpellCostEffectHandler` `(predicate, int amount, PlayerSubject players)`: whose spells is a static player subject judged as each spell is cast (`enchantedPlayer()` for Curse of Silence, `except(eachPlayer(), activePlayer())` for Defense Grid's "except during its controller's turn"); a resolution's "until your next turn" tax is this effect floated by `GrantStaticEffectToPlayerEffect.untilYourNextTurn` (Elspeth Conquers Death, Tax Collector). It also taxes an alternative cost (CR 118.9d). |
| `MinimumSpellCostEffect` | `(int minimumMana)` | static battlefield floor on a spell's mana component, evaluated after ordinary cast-cost modifiers and active only while the source permanent is untapped (Trinisphere uses `3`). Handled by `MinimumSpellCostEffectHandler` |
| `IncreaseCostOfSpellsTargetingThisSpellEffect` | `(int amount)` | Static ability (`addStaticEffect`) of a spell card: while that spell is on the stack, spells that target it cost `amount` more to cast (symmetric, both players; spells only, never activated abilities). E.g. Kaervek's Torch, 2. Read by `CastingCostService.getTargetingStackEntryTax` from the STATIC effects of each targeted stack entry's card � no handler bean, it is target-dependent like `getTargetingSubtypeTax` |
| `IncreaseOwnCastCostUnlessRevealSubtypeEffect` | `(int amount, CardSubtype subtype)` | spell-self cost modifier (`addStaticEffect`): this spell costs `amount` more to cast unless the caster holds a card of `subtype` (other than the spell itself) to reveal from hand. Models the Lorwyn "reveal a creature-type card or pay {N}" additional cost (e.g. Goldmeadow Stalwart, Kithkin/{3}); auto-reveal is game-state-equivalent since revealing never removes the card. Handled by `IncreaseOwnCastCostUnlessRevealSubtypeEffectHandler` |
| `IncreaseOpponentCostForTargetingControlledPermanentEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate, int amount[, boolean taxesActivatedAbilities])` | opponent spells/abilities that target a permanent matching the predicate you control cost N more (static; two-argument form taxes both, while `false` taxes spells only; source-relative predicates use the taxing permanent as source; e.g. Kopala with `PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(MERFOLK)`, 2, and Boreal Elemental with `PermanentIsSourcePermanentPredicate()`, 2). `perTargetedPermanent(PermanentPredicate, int)` charges a spell-only tax once per distinct matching target, for permanents that each have the tax ability (Callaphe, Beloved of the Sea) |
| `ReduceOpponentCostForTargetingControlledPermanentEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate, int amount[, boolean affectsController])` | opponent spells that target a permanent matching the predicate you control cost N less; the three-argument form also affects your spells (static; source-relative predicates use the reducing permanent as source; e.g. Accursed Witch uses `PermanentIsSourcePermanentPredicate()`, 1) |
| `ReduceTargetedCostEffect` | `(int amount)` | all targeted spells and activated abilities cost N less generic mana, once per spell or ability; symmetric static reduction that can make an activated ability free. Used by High Troller (MB1 #54) |
| `IncreaseActivatedAbilityCostEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate, int amount)` | activated abilities of permanents matching the predicate cost N more generic mana to activate, for all players (static, symmetric; e.g. Gloom with a white-enchantment predicate, 3). Implements the `ActivatedAbilityCostIncreasingEffect` capability interface; `CastingCostService.getActivatedAbilityActivationTax` sums matching taxes and `AbilityActivationService` folds the result into the activation's generic-mana cost |
| `IncreaseLoyaltyAbilityCostEffect` | `(PermanentPredicate predicate, int amount)` | loyalty abilities of matching planeswalkers you activate cost N additional loyalty counters (static, controller-scoped; e.g. Carth the Lion).
